༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i phyi yi bka' 'bum

nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi kha skong bzhugs so// ༄༅// bka' brgyud gong mar gsol ba 'debs pa sbrang char zim bu ma// 778) dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// deng sang dus kyi rdo rje gdan// 'bri se ba byang chub kyi gling gong na// yab 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal snga nas// nged bu slob rnams la 'di skad gsung*// ji ltar bung ba mkhas pa yis// me tog padma'i rigs shes nas// phyi me tog gi mdangs la ma gnod par// nang sbrang rtsi blangs nas mkha' la 'phur// de bzhin thub pa'i sras rnams kyis// 'gro ba'i lus ngag yid gsum la// nyes pa'i skyon rnams ma gzigs par// yon tan mthong nas rnam par grol// ri khrod dang gangs khrod 'grim pa tsho// bdag rkyen dang gzhan rkyen gang gis kyang*// thugs skyo ba byung na glu 'di longs// ༈ //dpal chos dbyings kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la// chos mtha' dbus med par kun la khyab// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdungs bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// shar za hor yul du lho sprin 'thibs// byin rlabs ban ma bun ma byung*// tilli shes rab bzang po yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdungs pas gsol 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// byang puṣpa ha rir glog dmar 'khyug /chos phyir dka' ba bcu gnyis spyad// mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdungs bas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// lho gro bo lung du g.yu 'brug ldir// snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa bod la bsgyur// sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// 'brog la phyi gangs la sbrang char babs// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag mtsho ltar 'khyil// dpal bzhad pa rdo rje yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// shar dwags lha sgam por dog sa brlan// 'od gsal gyi chab la rgyun chad med// rje sman pa'i rgyal po yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// dpal phag mo gru ru myu gu 'khrungs// zab mo gsang sngags kyi gter kha bye// rje rang byung sangs rgyas yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// byang 'bri gung gi phyogs su 'bras drug smin// 'bras drug gis 'gro drug yongs la khyab// drin can chos rje khu dbon yang yang dran// sems rtse gcig gdungs pas gsol ba 'debs// bla ma khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// zhes char 'bebs dus zhus rten 'brel gyi lo tog phun sum tshogs pa smin pa'i rgyu rkyen gang dgos kyi dper sbyar nas bka' brgyud gong mar gsol ba 'debs pa sbrang char zim bu mar grags pa/

bdud rtsi zhig por gnang nas dbyangs su gyer bcug par bshad// // 779) ༄// smon 'jug don dam sems bskyed kyi cho ga yid bzhin nor bu// oṃ swa sti/ bde chen byang sems dbyer med rang bzhin sku// thub mchog de sras 'khor 'das dge legs kyi// gter dbang rgyal po bla ma rin chen la// phyag 'tshal bstod de 'gro mgon de nyid kyis// sems bskyed cho ga'i rim pa phal cher dus// bdag la'ang mngon par bka' bstsal de yi sgros// blo gsal yul min bdag min 'on kyang ni// de lta'i drin brten 'dir gsal yi ger 'bri/ 'di ltar 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dbye ba med pa'i ngo bo tshad med pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis 'dres pa'i rang bzhin/ mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa/ thams cad bde ba chen po'i sa la nges par 'god pa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga gsungs pa ni/ 'di ltar/ de yang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa zhig zhu 'tshal/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum po dge ba la bkol snyam du bsam/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung ste/ sang nyi ma da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum po dge ba la bkol snyam du bsam/ de nas thams cad thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag nas/ chos gsan par zhu 'tshal/ thugs dam yang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gal shin tu che ba lags te/ de yang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhang zhung gis glang ri thang du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom du ma bcug par byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par mdzad pas/

dge 'dun 'ga' re grongs chad du gyur pa yin/ de yang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'di ltar du sgom pas/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen dang bar chad zlog pa dang*/ mthun phyogs thams cad bkra shis dang bde legs 'byung ba yin pas thugs phun sum tshogs pa ma yengs par sgom par zhu 'tshal/ yul ris dang rgyal khams 'di thams cad jo bo thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku shin tu che ba zhig bsgom/ de'i thugs khar rje btsun khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba bzhugs par bsam/ de'i thugs khar khyed rang so so'i yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa wal gyis bsgom/ de theg pa chen po gsang sngags su bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang 'di las zab pa med pa yin/ de nas thugs dam de'i ngang la ma yengs par mdzad nas chos gsan pa zhu 'tshal lo// de la 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma'i rin po che'i zhal mnga' nas/ nged rang thams cad 'jig rten 'dir yun ring po mi sdod mi rtag pa yin/ de la dam pa'i chos rin po che ma gtogs pa gang gis kyang mi phan pa yin te/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs ma rgyas par song na bde ba gtan med pa yin pas/ sangs rgya bar byed pa'i rgyu nges pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che lags te/ rgyu de med par song na 'bras bu sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba yin pas na/ med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras bgyi ba lags pas/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed par byed pa gal che ba lags so// 'o na de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems gang la gsung snyam par song na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa/ yul dgra mtha' bya bar byon pa'i dus su/ rta chag gsol dgos pa byung ba yin par gda'/ de'i dus na 'phags pa kun dga' bos/ bu mo zhig la rta chag drur bcug pa la/ bu mo de na re/ 'phags pas gtam bag te ster na ngas rta chag dru bya ba/ sangs rgyas bya ba ci la zer ba yin zhus pas/

de la 'phags pa'i dgongs pa la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku che ba'i lo rgyus bshad pas ni mos mi go// 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i che ba'i yon tan bshad par song na go ste 'ong dgongs nas bshad pa yin par gda'/ de nas btsun mo rin po che bshad pa'i skabs su/ mo na re chag drus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas/ btsun mo rin po che gyur cig /zhes smon lam btab pas/ de phyis kyi dus na bcom ldan 'das kyis gsan nas/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo la khyod kyis ma legs pa byas/ de'i dus na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku che ba'i yon tan bshad par song na/ mo de la mos pas sangs rgya ba yin pa la/ khyod kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i lo rgyus bshad pas/ mo de la smon pas/ de'i jo mor 'ong 'dug gsung skad/ des na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku che ba'i yon tan bshad par song na/ de la smon pas/ des rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar song ba la/ byang chub kyi sems bgyi ba lags so// de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de sangs rgyas la brten pa dang*/ chos la brten pa dang*/ dge 'dun la brten pa gsum yin gsungs/ de la thog mar sangs rgyas la brten pa bgyi ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la/ rdza mkhan gyi bu khye'u snang byed ces bya bas mchil lham dang sa sna lnga'i 'gron bu dang*/ gdugs tshod la sogs pa drangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*/ 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*// de bzhin mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'i smon lam btab pas/ phyis kyi dus su mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa bcom ldan 'das bstan pa'i bdag po 'di nyid yin par gsungs pas/ de sangs rgyas la brten pa lags so// da ni dge 'dun la brten bgyi ba lags te/ dge bsnyen chen po li tsa byi dri ma med pa bya ba de snyung ba'i dus na/

rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa thams cad snyun dri la byon pa yin par gda'/ de'i dus na me tog gi char bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bab pa'i me tog de dag /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ma sprugs kyang sku lus la mi 'go la/ nyan thos rnams kyis ni sprugs kyang 'byar nas byung ba yin par gda'/ de la khyim bsrungs kyi lha mo rnams kyis khyed nyan thos rnams kyis ni/ me tog phar sprugs kyang lus la 'go ba'i rgyu mtshan 'dod pa la 'jigs pas de ltar 'byung ba yin zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ma sprugs kyang mi 'go ba'i rgyu mtshan 'dod pa la mi 'jigs pas/ de ltar du 'byung ba yin bya ba zer ba la/ 'o na khyed rnams la yang mi 'go ba 'dug pas/ khyed rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' yin zer skad/ nged rten gyis gang zag 'di lta bu brten pa la byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pa 'os ci yod bya ba gsungs pa yin par gda'/ de dge 'dun la brten pa lags/ de nas chos la brten pa la gsum yin gsung*/ lug rdzi lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rje dpon lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ gnyan pa lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang gsum las/ dang po ni sems can thams cad sngon la rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas/ rang nyid phyi nas sangs rgya bar 'dod pa de la gsung ba yin te/ de yang dper na gang lta bu yin snyam na/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi thugs dgongs sam smon lam dang 'dra ba yin te/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyis sems can thams cad sngon la rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du bdag sangs rgya bar ma gyur cig snyam pa'i smon lam btab pa de lta bu yin te/ de lug rdzi lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems lags/ gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid sngon la rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas nas/ sems can thams cad phyis nas sangs rgya ba 'dod pa de la gsungs pa yin te/

de rje dpon lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems lags/ de nas gnyan pa lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems ni rang gzhan thams cad dus mnyam du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar 'dod pa de la gsung ba yin te/ da lta nged rang gis dus rgyun tu phyag len la 'debs pa'i rim pa 'di la gsungs pa yin/ de bas na de bskyed pa'i bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin phung thams cad kyis mchod/ lus longs spyod/ khar rje dbang thang*/ yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad kyis mchod nas/ gsol ba btab bo// me tog re phyag tu bzung nas rjes zlos mdzad pa zhu 'tshal/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ ji ltar thugs rin po che bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du slob dpon gyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes la/ slob dpon gyis thabs yin zhes pa dang*/ yul gyis legs so zhes brjod la/ me tog re 'thor du bcug ste me tog gtor ba thams cad kyang*/ bla ma dam pa'i dbu'i thog tu gtor bas/ me tog gi gdugs chen po re rer gyur par bsam nas/ rang gis mgo thog na yar 'thor ba yin te/ de ltar yang*/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog las/ me tog gang gis khyod la mngon gtor bas// phyogs bcu kun tu de dag gdugs gyur te// dus kun bde ba'i 'byung gnas zhing du ni// rkang gnyis gtso bo'i dbu la gdugs su shog /ces gsungs pa'o// da rung lan grangs mang du 'tshal bas so bdun re mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de skye bar byed pa'i phyir du dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/

mdor bsdus na bzhir 'dus pa yin te/ bsod nams kyis tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa las byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang*/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can byas pa las skye ba dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi la blo sbyangs pa las skye ba dang*/ rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed pa las byang chub kyi sems skye ba dang bzhi yin/ de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa bya ba bgyi ba lags te/ 'dir 'bras bu rgyus dpog na gong du bsod nams kyi tshogs ma bsags par song na/ da ltar yang sems bskyed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rna lam du yang thos par dka' ba yin no// de ltar yang*/ sangs rgyas rnams la bkur sti byas// de las dge ba'i rtsa ba kun// dge ba'i bshes kyis mgon byas pa// 'di nyan pa yi snod yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ kha ba can na yod pa'i skyes pa dang bud med shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la dad pa rnams ni/ phyir mi ldog par lung bstan te/ de thams cad nga'i 'khor gyis dkyil 'khor 'di nyid na yod pa rig par bya'o// ces gsungs pas/ des na bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags pa lags/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can bya ba lags te/ de yang gong du skyabs su 'gro ba ma byas par song na/ da lta lha dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra rna lam du yang thos par mi 'gyur ba yin pas/ des na skyabs su 'gro ba yang dpag tu med pa byas pa lags/ tshad med pa bzhi la blo sbyangs pa 'di shin tu dka' ba yin te/ 'on kyang bod theg pa chen po'i rigs can yin pas/ jo bo thugs chen pos byin gyis brlabs pa ci rigs pa mnga' ba yin pas/ rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed pa rnams la ji lta ba bzhin du mnga'/ mi mnga' yang bskyed par zhu 'tshal/ de ltar rgyu bzhi po khyed la tshang*/

rkyen bla ma dam pas byas nas/ rgyu rkyen gyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'dzoms pa las/ khyed la byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa yin gsung*/ de yang bsod nams kyis tshogs gsog pa la/ spyir bsod nams kyi tshogs mtha' dag gsog dgos pa lags/ sgos bye brag tu 'di ltar sgom par zhu 'tshal/ khyed rang thams cad kyi mdun 'dir mtsho shin tu bsngo ba/ 'jam pa 'bol ba dwangs pa/ yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa de lta bu zhig bsam/ mtsho de'i nang na padma'i sdong po chen po/ rgyu bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis las grub pa/ nor bu rin po che'i sdong po yal ga dang lo 'dab thams cad rdo rje rin po che las grub pa/ rtsa ba ye shes kyi rdo rje dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi man chad na mar la tal gyis sleb pa'i padma'i sdong po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig skyes par bsam/ padma'i sdong po de'i dbus kyi lte ba la/ gdan gzhi brtsigs kyi steng na 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che bzhugs par bsam/ de ci 'dra na mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu/ 'od 'dom gang ba/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das bstan pa'i bdag po de ltar bzhugs pa bsam/ bla ma rin po che'i mdun drang po'i padma rnams la/ yi dam gyi lhar gyur tshad thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma rin po che'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gyi padma rnams la 'das ma byon da ltar dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang bcas pa thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma rin po che'i sku phrag pa yan chod kyi padma rnams la/ khyed rang so so'i mkhan po slob dpon du gyur tshad thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma rin po che'i spyi bo yan chod kyi padma rnams la/

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams bzhugs par bsam/ 'og gi padma rnams la/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po dpal ldan mgon po dang*/ dpal lha mos gtso byas pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'phrog ma ma bu'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdor na chos skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes tshad thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ de ltar 'das ma 'ongs da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs de rnams thams cad la/ rang nyid kyis shes rab kyi mig gam/ yid kyis cer gyis lta ba lags/ de ltar yang bzang spyod las/ rdul cig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon po la// ces gsungs pas/ de sku blta ba'i mchod pa bgyi ba lags/ rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul nas/ phyag dpag tu med pa 'tshal bar bsam/ de ltar yang de nyid las/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seṅge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// zhes gsungs pas de la phyag 'tshal ba'i mchod pa bgyi ba lags/ de nas dbyangs dang bstod pa dpag tu med pas bstod par bsam/ de ltar yang*/ dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces gsungs pas/ de bstod pa'i mchod par brjod pa lags/ lus kyi mchod pa 'di rnams thams cad rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ yun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong gi bar du 'byung ba las dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad mchod pa/

sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byed pa'i yon chab kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas kyang mchod rtsol cig de bzhin du me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ snang gsal dang*/ dri chab dang*/ byug pa dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ sil snyan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas kyang mchod rtsol cig /de yang de bzhin gshegs rin chen snying po la/ rgyal po rtsibs kyis mu khyud kyis/ rin po che dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa phul bas/ phyis kyi dus su mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med par gyur par gsungs pa yin pas/ 'o na 'od zer la de lta bu 'byung la/ gzhan la de ltar mi 'byung ngam snyam na/ gzhan dag la de kho na bzhin du byung ba yin/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal mnga' nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag na/ spos kyis sems can gyi don byed pa dpag tu med pa yin gsung skad/ de yang*/ spos gcig pu la de ltar du 'byung la/ gzhan la mi 'byung ngam snyam na/ 'dir ji ltar bshams pa'i mchod pa 'di rnams/ re re la yang de kho na bzhin 'byung ba yin/ de 'byung bar byed pa la yang da ltar gyis mchod pa 'di dag thams cad byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas phul bas 'byung ba yin pas/ thugs ma yengs par mdzad nas/ ngas ji ltar spor ba bzhin du 'bul ba zhu 'tshal/ gzhan yang*/ bdug pa dang*/ gzhan yang gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ bla re dang*/ rol mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas kyang mchod rtsol cig gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa/ nyes pa'i skyon med cing*/ legs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas gang ba dpag tu med pas kyang mchod rtsol cig /gzhan yang 'chi ba med pa'i zhal zas kyi bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pas kyang mchod rtsol cig /gzhan yang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis las grub pa'i nor bu rin po che'i tshogs dpag tu med pa las rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bab pa dpag tu med pa bsams la yang mchod rtsol cig

/gzhan yang phas kyi rgol ba ngan pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku dpag tu med pa soms la yang mchod rtsol cig mchod pa de rnams thams cad la kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lam/ sprin phung gis mchod pa bgyi ba lags/ de yang rnam 'phrul ni dngos po gcig la yang*/ de'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rigs mi 'dra ba dpag tu med pa bsams nas 'bul ba la zer ba lags la/ sprin phung ni de'i dngos po de la yang sprin gyi phung po ltar dpag tu med pa bsams nas 'bul ba la zer ba lags/ mdor na chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par bsams nas 'bul ba yin te/ de ltar yang*/ kun tu bzang po'i lus ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin te// thams cad zhing la mi gnas de bzhin nyid la gnas// zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings kyi bklas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas btugs pa thams cad na/ bdag pos yongs su bzung ba med pa'i yon chab kyi tshogs ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad kyis kyang mchod rtsol cig /de bzhin du/ me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ snang gsal dang*/ dri dang*/ byug pa dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ rol mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad kyis kyang mchod rtsol cig gzhan yang gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ bla re dang*/ rol mo'i tshogs ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad kyis kyang mchod rtsol cig gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa/ nyes pa'i skyon dang bral ba/ legs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas gang ba la sogs pa ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad kyis kyang mchod rtsol cig gzhan yang 'chi ba med pa'i zhal zas kyi bdud rtsi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis kyang mchod rtsol cig gzhan yang rin po che'i ri bo/ nyi ma dang zla ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog phu chu'i rgyun sgra/

ar mo li ka'i rdo leb dang*/ mnan na nem gyi byed pa/ btegs na spar gyis byed pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa chen po/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po la sogs pa thams cad kyang*/ 'dir rang nyid kyis bdag tu bzung la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i yon du phul rtsol cig gzhan yang rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ de dang nye ba bdun la sogs pas kyang mchod stsol cig mchod pa de rnams thams cad la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba la/ bdag pos yongs su bzung ba med pa'i mchod pa bgyi ba lags/ gzhan yang*/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag na lha dang mi rnams kyis mchod pa'i bye brag dga' ba dang dgod pa dang*/ rtsed 'jo'i bde ba'i bye brag ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad kyis kyang mchod rtsol cig de bzhin du gzugs sdug gu sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim po/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam po'i tshogs ji snyed yod pa thams cad kyis kyang mchod rtsol cig gzhan yang khyed rang so so'i yi dam gyi lha bsgoms pa'i thugs kha nas/ yon chab kyi lha mo rin po che'i bum pa dang gzhong pa yon chab kyis bkang ba la sogs pa/ phyi'i mchod pa lngas kyang mchod rtsol cig nang gi mchod pa gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas kyang mchod rtsol cig gsang ba'i mchod pa bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gyis kyang mchod rtsol cig de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa'i don gyis kyang mchod rtsol cig mchod pa de rnams thams cad la theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyis mchod pa brjod pa bgyi ba lags/ da ji ltar bshams pa'i yon chab la sogs pa mchod pa'i tshogs 'di dag thams cad kyang phul rtsol cig gzhan yang*/ mchod khang gong 'og thams cad na sku gsung thugs kyi rten ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/

mchod pa'i rten bkod pa ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad khyed rang so so'i bdag tu bzung la/ 'dir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i yon du phul mdzod cig gtor ma skabs 'dir yang lan gcig bsngo/ bdun 'di yang chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma chen po rnams la 'bul ba zhu 'tshal lo// de rdzas rim par bshams pa'i mchod pa lags/ da khyed rang gi lus bla ma dkon mchog la bran dang g.yog tu phul mdzod cig lus la mkho ba'i kha rje dang dbang thang*/ yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad kyis kyang mchod rtsol cig de lus dbul ba'i mchod pa bgyi ba lags ste/ mchod pa de rnams ni kun bzang spyod las gsungs pa yin/ mchod pa rnam pa bdun dag bya/ zhes pa'i don lags/ da sdig pa bshags pa zhig bgyi bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rgyal bu dge mthong mi sum stong dus gcig tu sdig pa bshags pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ rgyal rigs dra ma legs so legs so// rang nyid kyi sdig pa bshags pa'i thog tu gzhan thams cad kyang sdig pa dang bral ba byas pas/ khyod ni rgyal rigs dra ma'o// khyed rnams thams cad sdig pa bshags pas/ da ni byang chub sems dpa' ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan pa dang 'dra bar nged rang thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du lus ngag yid gsum la brten nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa thams cad shin tu ma legs so// snyam nas 'gyod pa drag po bskyed pa zhu 'tshal/ de sun 'byin par byed pa'i stobs lags/ de thams cad so sor bshags pas so sor bshags so// snyam du bshags pa re mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ de bshags pa'i stobs lags/ da phyin chad lus dang srog la bab kyang sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mi bya'o// snyam du dam bcas par zhu 'tshal/ de sor chud par byed pa'i stobs lags/

sdig pa mi dge ba'i las mi bya ba'i steng du bla ma dang dkon mchog la brten par bya'o snyam du bsam/ de rten gyi stobs bgyi ba lags te/ de ltar stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rtsa ba nas 'dag pa yin te/ ma dag snyam na gnyen po la the tshom zos pas nyes pa shin tu che ba yin/ dam pa'i chos 'dul bar dge 'dun gtso ste/ bshags pa dang las thams cad dge 'dun gyis spyan sngar byas pas 'dag pa yong ba yin/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags su sangs rgyas gtso ste/ zhing bsam pa dngos po gcig tu byas nas bshags pas 'dag pa lags/ 'dir chos gtso ba yin te/ byang chub kyi sems rin po ches rang gi rgyud sbyangs par byas pas/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad 'dag pa dang 'byang bar 'ong ba yin te/ de ltar yang spyod 'jug las/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams// skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed// ces gsungs so// rjes su yi rang ba re bsgom par zhu 'tshal/ 'phags pa thams cad dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mdor na 'khor 'das ma lus pa thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad la rjes su yi rang bas/ rjes su yi rang ngo*// snyam du rjes su yi rang ba rgya chen po de bsgom par zhu 'tshal/ de yang*/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal mnga' nas/ rjes su yi rang 'di ltar du bsgoms pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs mnyam par thob pa yin gsung*/ de dper na gang lta bu yin snyam na/ bdag cag gis gang byed kyang longs mnyam par spyod pa ste/ rjes su yi rang ba'i 'bras bu yin gsung skad/ des na bdag la bdag gi khyad par tsam ma gtogs pa'i longs spyod pa la khyad par med pa yong lags pas/ des na gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mthong na/ de la chags sdang gi bsam pa phrag dog mi bya bar/ dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ba re byed dgos lags/

de yang dge ba'i rtsa ba la ji ltar byung ba bzhin tu/ mi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba byas kyang*/ de gong bzhin 'byung ba yin pas/ nyes pa shin tu che ba lags pas/ de lta bu'i bsam pa mi skyed pa gal che ba lags/ de nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar/ rang nyid tshangs pa'i rgyal por byas nas/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ bzo bos ma byas pa/ lhun gyis grub pa lag na thogs/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad ni khrid/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bskul ma 'debs pa lags/ 'dis rang nyid tshangs pa'i rgyal por gyur nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ma 'debs pa'i rgyu lags/ yang rang nyid tshangs pa'i rgyal por byas nas 'chi ba med pa zhal zas kyi bdud rtsi ni lag na thogs/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad ni khrid/ mchod pa'i sprin phung thams cad kyis mchod nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams/ yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol/ zhes pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ 'dis rang nyid kyi 'chi ba med pa'i zhal zas kyis bdud rtsi thob par byed pa'i rgyu lags/ skabs 'dir yon mchod thams cad thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba re mdzad pa zhu 'tshal/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyi dus gsum du bsags pa dang*/ yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces lan gsum dang*/ de kho na bzhin gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod do// de rnams kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa las byang chub kyi sems skye ba bgyi ba lags/ skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas pa las byang chub kyi sems skye ba bgyi ba lags te/

de yang yul dang*/ dus dang*/ ched du bya ba gsum gyis khyad par du byas pas na khyad par lags la/ thun mong gi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum lags/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang bral ba tsam la bzhed pa lags/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa lta bu la bzhed pa lags/ sprul pa'i sku nyan thos mchog zung lta bu la bzhed pa lags/ lung gi chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ rtogs pa'i chos 'gog pa dang lam gyi bden pa la bzhed pa lags/ dge 'dun gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa yan chad/ skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag ya gyad man chad la bzhed pa lags te/ de thams cad mthar thug gi skyabs gnas ma yin// ces gsungs ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir// med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir// chos rnam gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// gtan gyi skyabs mchog ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// dus ji srid 'tsho'i bar du skyabs su 'gro la/ ched du bya ba rang nyid zhi bde 'dod pa'i bsam pas skyabs su 'gro ba lags so// khyad par ba'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku ni dag pa gnyis ldan dri med chos sku bgyi ba de la 'dod pa lags/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni zhing khams snang zhing*/ zhing khams thams cad du skus khyab pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad lta bu la bzhed pa lags/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa lta bu la bzhed pa lags/ skye ba sprul pa'i sku/ stag dang ri bong la sogs pas ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa la bzhed pa lags/ mngon par rtogs pa'i chos mya ngan las 'das pa bgyi ba lags/ dge 'dun dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rigs gsum mgon po lta bu la bzhed pa lags/ de thams cad mthar thug gi skyabs gnas su gsungs te/

yang de nyid las/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug yin// ces gsungs/ dus sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro la/ ched du bya ba rang gzhan thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas/ sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sangs rgyas la ston pa bya/ dam pa'i chos la lam zhu/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i grogs su bya snyam du bsam nas/ thams cad kyis mchod nas/ me tog re phyag tu snoms la/ rjes bzlos mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes pa/ dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba don dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog sa chen po la rab tu zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum bya'o// thabs yin no legs so// zhes brjod do/ de ltar skyabs su song ba'i phan yon thub pa'i gsung rab tu dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ jo bo rjes mdor bsdus nas brgyad du gsungs te/ nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud pa'i phan yon dang*/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa thams cad zad par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin gyis gnod pas mi tshugs pa'i phan yon dang*/ bsam pa'i dngos po thams cad 'grub pa'i phan yon dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen por 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/

shi nas ngan song dang ngan 'gror log par mi 'gro ba'i phan yon dang*/ lam khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skye ba'i phan yon no// de yang skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur pa khyad par can byas na/ rang nyid rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba dag a chang che ste/ gzhan thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba'i phan yon bgyi ba lags te/ phan yon phun sum tshogs pa de rnams 'byung bar byed pa la/ bslab bya 'di rnams la slob dgos te/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog la skyabs su song na/ lha gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal ba dang*/ chos dkon mchog skyabs su song nas/ sems can la 'tshe ba spong ba dang*/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la skyabs su song nas/ grogs mu stegs can la mi bsten pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gus pa bsgrub cing*/ mi gus pa spang ba dang*/ drug po so so'i bslab bya drug bgyi ba lags/ da ni thun mong gi bslab bya rnam pa lnga lags te/ srog dang bya dga'i ched du lha dkon mchog gsum mi spang ba dang*/ dgos pa gal po che la yang thabs gzhan mi btsal ba dang*/ dus dang dus kyi mchod pa la bslab par bya ba dang*/ phyogs gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang de'i lha la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba spel zhing sbyang ba la bslab pa dang lnga lags te/ mdor na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song na/ khyod ci shes nga de shes su blo khel ba zhig dgos pa lags pas/ zhe thag pa nas blo khel ba'i bsam pa de lta bu zhig yod par song na/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen dang bar chad nad dang gnod pa la sogs pa thams cad kyang*/ 'di 'ba' zhig gis 'dag par byed pa 'ong te/ 'di tsho re 'ga' las mi gsung*/ sngon gyi dus na dge ba'i bshes gnyen khams pa lung pa bya ba de la khams gzhi tshan chen po byung nas/ slob ma rnams kyis da ni slob dpon yang mtshams bcad ran pa 'dug bya ba zer ba la/ nga shi na yang skyabs su 'gro bas shi/ phan na yang skyabs su 'gro bas phan gsung nas/

skyabs su 'gro ba 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ khams dwangs pa yin par gda'/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen yer pa zhang btsun bgyi ba de la/ khams gzhi byung ba la gong ltar slob ma rnams kyis slob dpon la mtshams ran 'dug byas pa yin gda' ba la/ nga phan yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bas phan la/ shi na yang skyabs su 'gro bas shi bya ba gsung nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ re shig gi dus gdung ba'i shugs kyis/ bdag yer pa zhang btsun zhes bgyi ba/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'chi'o// zhes brjod pas/ khong gi spyi bo na yar srog chags ring mo'i gzugs chen po zhig bud nas/ bdag zur phud rgyun thal zhes bya ba yang*/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'chi'o// zhes bya ba zer skad/ de nas tshegs ma byung bar de rang gis sangs dwangs pa yin par gda'/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jad bgyi ba de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dum bu rings de brtag pa la shin tu mkhas par yin par gda' bas spyan sngar phyin nas/ gzigs su phul bas/ mtshams bcad dgos par 'dug gsung ba la/ de'i rgyags med nas/ lha sa na mar phyin nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba byed kyin jo bo la bskor ba byas pas/ de nas zla ba phyed lon pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa'i spyan sngar yar phyin nas/ yang gzigs su phul bas/ khyod kyi de'i bar la ci byas pa yin/ da mtshams bcad mi dgos pa 'dug zer skad/ de bas na skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo khel bar byed pa gal che ste/ zhe thag pa nas blo khel ba'i bsam pa de lta bu yod na/ gzhan dag gi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa la yang*/ me ris me lha mi thub pa dang*/ mda'i dra bas 'byung po mi thub pa la sogs pa zer ba de yang*/ gong gi bsam pa de yod na thub pa yin te/ mda' dang me thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me legs par 'ong ba yin// de lta bu'i skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par ba dang*/ thun mong gnyis kyi khyad par de gong du snyan du gsol ba de rnams dag a cang yang che ste/

spyir thun mong ba bya ba de skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum yul mthun pas na thun mong ba yin la/ khyad par ba'i go ba/ rang gzhan thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa des khyad par du byas pas khyad par ba bya ba yin gsung*/ de skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas pa las/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba bya ba lags/ da tshad med pa bzhi la blo sbyang ba la byang chub kyi sems skye ba bgyi ba lags pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi ma yin snyam du bsam/ de byams pa yin/ ma 'di dag khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pas/ snying re rje snyam du bsam pa de snying rje yin/ snying rje ba'i ma 'di dag bde ba dang ldan na dga'/ sdug bsngal dang bral na dga' snyam du bsam pa de dga' ba yin/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mar gyur pa la nye ring med par sems snyoms pa de btang snyoms bya ba lags/ da rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed pa las/ byang chub kyi sems skye ba bgyi ba lags ste/ de yang jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ bla ma la so so skye bo'i 'du shes skyes par song na/ byang chub kyi sems gtan nas mi skye/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'du shes skyes na/ skye'am mi skye the tshom za te mi skye/ de bas na/ bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes zhe thag pa nas skyes pa zhig dgos pa lags pas/ bdag gi bla ma 'di nges par yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas yin par 'dug ang snyam du bsam/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod/ lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang*/ yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad kyis mchod nas/ skabs 'di sems bskyed pa'i yon du dmigs pa'i me tog 'dra yod na yang 'bul bar zhu 'tshal/ yang bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin phung thams cad kyis mchod nas gsol ba 'debs pas/

me tog re phyag tu bsnams nas rjes bzlos mdzad pa zhu 'tshal/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpas bdag byang chub sems dpar bzung du gsol/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod do// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhal mnga' nas/ spyir chos 'di go dgos pa yin/ go rgyu'i chos de gang yin snyam par song na/ nged rang thams cad 'jig rten 'dir yun ring por mi bsdod/ mi rtag pa yin te/ de ltar yang 'dus byas g.yo ba'i rang bzhin la'ang rtag pa med/ chos kun rnam par 'jig pa blo dang ldan pas shes// ces gsungs pas/ sang dang 'chi ba gang snga mi shes/ gnang dang 'chi ba gang snga mi shes par gnas pa yin pas/ sang tsam 'chi ba su yis shes// de ring nyid du bstun te bya// 'chi bdag sde chen de dang ni// bdag ni bshes pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ des na nam 'chi cha med/ tshe la long med par cis kyang 'chi nges pa lags/ shi nas pha rol du skye'am mi skye snyam na skye ba lags/ skye na lus skye'am sems skye snyam na/ lus 'byung bzhi'i brdos bcas 'di/ tshu rol du thams cad kyi mdun nang du 'jog pas/ gang gis kyang skye bar mi 'dod pa lags/ sems rtag na skyer mi btub/ chad na skye rgyu med pa 'ong ba yin te/ de yang*/ sa lu ljang pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas rtag pa ma yin/ chad pa ma yin/ 'pho ba ma yin/ rgyu chung ngu las 'bras bu chen po 'byung ba/ de dang 'dra ba'i rgyud du rtogs pas/ ces gsungs/ de yang rtag pa ma yin pa gang gis shes snyam na/ sngon gyi dus su/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po ngam stag ra klu gong bya ba de shi ba la/ bon po rnams kyis de'i bla bkug pas/ kho'i chas ji lta ba bzhin der byung ba dang*/ mnga' bdag gis slob dpon padma la zur ngom byas nas/ bon pos kyang 'di 'dra yong bar 'dug zer skad/ slob dpon gyis zhal nas ngas khyed rgyal blon gnyis la/

dbang bskur ba'i dus kyi gsang mtshan gang yin kho la dris dang bya ba gsung nas dris pas de nga la cha med zer skad/ 'o na de'i dus na khyod gar yod byas pas/ de'i dus na khyed kyis me ri dang*/ rdo rje'i ra ba bsgoms pas/ nga nang du ma chud zer skad/ 'o na khyod su yin pas/ nga phu 'di'i brag btsan yin zer skad/ 'o na khyod 'di ltar du byed pa ci yin byas pas/ nga la bon po rnams kyis rngan pa byin nas/ 'di ltar gyis zer bas/ 'di ltar byas pa yin zer skad/ blon po chen po gar skyes byas pas/ de nga la cha med/ lug gi shan pa lug rung ba byed pa la dbang kyang*/ rnam par shes pa gar song cha med/ nga'i de yang de dang 'dra mod zer skad/ slob dpon gyis zhal nas/ 'o na khyed rang gi rang gzugs ston cig gsung nas/ se gol zhig gtogs pas/ rgad po mgo se te le ba zhig tu song ba yin par gda'/ de nas mnga' bdag gis/ slob dpon la blon po chen po gar skyes zhus pas/ stod lung gi mda' pha gi na/ sbur pa zhig tu skyes nas yod gsungs/ der slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ mnga' bdag 'khor dang bcas pa phyogs der byon pa dang*/ slob dpon ltag cig tu bzhugs nas/ mnga' bdag la smad de'i lji ba de yar khog dang gsungs/ de nas yar btegs pa dang 'di na khung bu zhig min pa gzhan ci yang mi snang bya ba zhus pas/ khung bu de na mar/ blon po chen po blon po chen po gyis la gsung thong dang gsungs/ de ltar btang ba dang*/ sbur pa chen po ra zing zing ba zhig byung nas/ sngar gyi rgyal blon gyi dran pa sad nas zhe sa dang sdug babs la sogs byed du byung ba yin par gda'/ da 'di nas tshe 'phos nas gar skye zhus pas/ mir skye ba 'dug zer skad/ de la mnga' bdag gi zhal nas/ 'o na 'di ngas bsod pa yin zer ba dang*/ bsad pas mi phan sbur par skye ba'i las de zad pa dang*/ tshe 'phos nas gzod mir skye bar 'dug gsungs/

der mnga' bdag dkon mchog gsum la mos gus khyad par can thob nas/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la 'bul ba yin gsung nas/ gter yig thams cad slob dpon la phul bas/ da lta gter yig thams cad bsam yas na yod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ de bas na rtag pa ma yin te/ res mir skyes la res sbur par skyes pa lags/ chad na skye rgyu med pa yin/ 'o na gang skyes snyam na rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i rnam par rtog pa de'i rang gzugs su skye ba dang 'khor ba yin pas/ rnam par rtog pa gang skyes pa de stobs su gyur pa las/ pha rol du yang de'i rang gzugs su skye ba de la bsam pa'i rang gzugs bya ba yang de la gsung pa yin/ des nyon mongs pa gsum lta bu la goms shing 'dris par byas/ shi khar yang des mtshams sbyar bar song na 'khor ba dang ngan song gi gnas gsum yin la/ da lta las dge ba bcu lta bu la goms shing 'dris par byas/ 'chi khar yang des mtshams sbyar nas/ pha rol du lha dang mi'i go 'phangs thob pa yin te/ spyir 'chi kha ma'i mtshams sbyor 'di gnad shin tu che ba yin te/ sngon gyi dus na rgyal po mya ngan med bgyi ba de/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la khong las che ba med pa yin par gda'/ rgyal po na ba la nang gi g.yog mos bsil g.yab kyi yu ba shor nas thugs khar phog pas/ rgyal po g.yog mo la zhe sdang skyes pa des mtshams sbyar nas grongs pa la/ khong rang gis bla mchod dgra bcom pa zhig gi dgongs pa la/ rgyal po 'dis 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la ni khong las che ba med pa yin pas/ de gar skyes na snyam pa'i mngon shes kyis gzigs pas/ 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor g.yog mo la zhe sdang skyes pa des byas nas/ khong rang gi pho brang gi mdun na mtshe'u zhig yod pa'i nang na srog chags sbrul zhig tu skyes nas 'dug skad/ de kha gdangs nas srog chags mang po zos pas/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba 'dug pas/

de thugs kyis ma bzod nas/ mtshe'u kha der byon nas/ rgyal po chen po rgyal po chen po zhes gsung btang bas/ sngar gyis dran pa sad nas mgo btegs gis byung ba yin pa gda'/ rgyal po chen po zhal tshums zhes gsungs pas/ kho kha btsums nas sems can ma zos pas/ de nas tshe 'phos pa dang*/ lha'i skye gnas su skyes pa yin gsungs pas/ bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems rin po che la goms shing 'dris par byas/ 'chi khar yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che la brtan pa gsal btab pas des mtshams sbyar nas/ pha rol du rang gzugs su rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba yin te/ de ltar yang*/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang du 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de yang g.yo sgyus byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yang*/ sangs rgya bar gsungs te/ de yang dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das la bdud sdig can gyis bar du gcod pa brtsams pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhags pas 'ching ba rnam pa lngas bcings pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi spyod yul las yang dag par 'das pas/ sdig can khyod byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gyis dang*/ bcings pa las grol bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ khos bcings pa las grol bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ sems bskyed pas bcings pa las grol ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal nas/ sdig can khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan pa la khos shags btab/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sems las ni las/ las las las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa zhes gsungs nas/ ngas zhe thag pa nas sems bskyed pa ni ma yin/ bcings pa las grol bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa g.yo sgyus sems bskyed pa yang*/ sangs rgya bar lung ston pa mi rigs bya ba zer ba la/

bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal nas/ sdig can khyod du ma zad ma 'ongs dus na/ khyod 'dra ba sha stag byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa thams cad phyir mi ldog par nga nyid kyis lung ston par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// g.yo sgyus sems bskyed pa yang sangs rgya bar gsungs na/ nged rang thams cad zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas sems bskyed pas/ sangs mi rgya ba'i don med pa yin pas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya snyam du bsams nas me tog phyag na bsnams nas rjes bzlos mdzad pa zhu 'tshal/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i dge ba'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis thugs rin po che bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes pas kyang*/ sems bskyed par bgyis te/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma dgrol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma byung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod do// byang chub kyi sems bsrung bar byed pa la/ bslab bya 'di rnams la slob dgos te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa la bslab pa dang*/ phan yon mthong zhing rjes su dran par bya ba la bslab pa dang*/

spel zhing sbyangs pa la bslab pa dang*/ sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab pa dang*/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i chos bzhi nyams su blang ba la bslab par bya'o// de yang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa 'di/ smon pa skye bar byed pa'i rgyu/ 'jug pa sdom pa'i ngo bo/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi dam tshig sangs rgyas nas sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol bar byed pa de bsod nams kyi tshogs las byung ba yin pas/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ ser sna la sogs pa'i drug spangs nas/ sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su len pa yin/ de bsod nams kyi tshogs yin pas nyams su blang bar bya ba la bslab pa bgyi ba lags/ de yang phyag rgya chen po ni 'dir pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi dngos po shin tu phra ba khab skud dam/ nas rdog lta bu yin na yang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang byas pas/ byang chub kyi sems de la rgya ci tsam yod pa dngos po de la yang*/ rgya de tsam du 'byung bar 'ong bar lags so// des na phan yon mthong zhing rjes su dran par bya ba la bslab pa ni/ spyir byang chub kyi sems la phan yon dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ mdor bsdus na thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba gsum du 'dus pa yin te/ de yang thog mar dge ba tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum thams cad kyang byang chub kyi sems las byung ba yin no// de ltar yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten na yod na// lha dang mi sogs 'jig rten na yang yod// ces gsungs/ bar du dge ba sa dang lam gyi yon tan dang*/ bde skyid thams cad byang chub sems las byung ba yin te/ byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na// 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung*// zhes gsungs/

tha mar dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba yang*/ byang chub kyi sems las 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bus// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan bzung*// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ da lta byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas rnam pa gsum byas pas/ 'bras bu sku gsum thob pa yin te/ da lta smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa byas pas/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa yin/ da lta 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa byas pas/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa yin/ da lta don dam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa byas pas/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob 'ong ba yin te/ de phan yon mthong ba bgyi ba lags/ rjes su dran pa bgyi ba yin te/ goms pa 'degs pa dang*/ 'jog pa'i bar thams cad du yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che mi brjed par goms par byed pa la zer ba yin no// de nas spel zhing sbyang ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su 'chi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur thob shog ces pa 'di la nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum la sogs pa ci nus tshad la 'bad pa lags te/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems rin po che spel ba'i dus na/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad/ dper na tshwa reg dang grang reg ltar lhan cig tu mi gnas par 'gal ba yin pas na 'dag pa dang 'byang bar 'ong ba de la spel zhing sbyang ba la bslab pa bgyi ba lags/ de nas sems can blos mi spong ba la bslab pa ni/ gzhan gyis mi 'thad pa'i las byas pa lta bu la brten nas/ ngan pa 'di dang gtan du mi 'phrad dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa bskyed par song na/

de sems can blos spang ba bgyi ba lags te/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ don go sha tsha btang nas khyod rang bzang na yang re 'dod med/ ngan na yang re 'dod med snyam pa de yin/ des na de lta bu'i bsam pa nyin zhag phrugs cig gi drug cha la skyes na/ de'i nyes pa phog pa yin te/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ gzhan gyi lam sna 'dren mkhan la sogs pa yin na/ de lta bu'i yul mthong ba'i dus su/ sems can 'di 'dra ba la bla ma nga 'dra ba dgos pa yin snyam du go cha chen po dgos nas de'i don byed dgos pa yin/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ des gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya ba'i ched du dus ring thung rnam pa gsum du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'god dgos snyam pa de yin gsung skad/ des na dman pa dang ma rungs pa de lta bu mthong na/ de la brtse ba'i sems kyis de'i don byed dgos pa yin te/ de nyams su blang ba la bslab pa yin/ de nas nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing*/ dkar po'i chos bzhi nyams su blang bar bya ba la bslab pa lags te/ de yang bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa mgo skor na nag po'i chos yin pas de spang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la bsnyen skur dang zhabs tog byed pa de dkar po'i chos yin pas nyams su blang bar bya ba la bslab par bya la/ bslab pa la gzhan yang sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gi tshigs su bcad pa brjod par song na/ de nag po'i chos yin pas spang la/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang bsngags pa brjod pa lags/ de dkar po'i chos yin pas nyams su blang bar bya ba la bslab pa lags/ gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la 'gyod pa skyes na/ de nag po'i chos yin pas de spangs la/ gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rangs byed dgos pa yin/

de dkar po'i chos yin pas nyams su blang bar bya ba la bslab pa lags/ sems can g.yo dang sgyus mgo bskor na/ nag po'i chos yin pas de spangs la drang po'i chos kyis sems can la phan pa dang*/ bde ba bsgrub pa lags/ de dkar po'i chos yin pas nyams su blang bar bya ba la bslab pa lags te/ de ltar yang*/ drang po'i chos kyis 'jig rten kun tu bde// g.yo dang sgyus ni mdza' bshes phung bar byed// ces gsungs so// de lta bu'i nag po'i chos bzhi po de thun tshod las 'das nas spyad na/ byang chub kyi sems nyams par gzhan nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshan re bzhed pa yin par gda' ste/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ brjed pa'i rgyus brjed pa ma gtogs pa nyams pa'i rgyu ma yin gsungs/ de lta bu yang shes par bya/ de nas skabs 'dir yan lag bdun pa tshar re mdzad par zhu/ des smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'i go rim thams cad tshar ba lags/ da 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yin pas/ 'di la dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshan re khas blangs ni che/ nyams len ni chung bas/ be'u sbrel g.yang la lhung ba'i dogs yod bya ba zer nas/ shin tu gtsigs pa yin par gda' te/ de la chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byas pa dang*/ chos kyis byas pas be'u sbrel g.yang la 'gril dgos med pa lags/ 'o na gang lta bu zhig 'gro snyam na/ rnal 'byor pa phan tshun nang du rtsod pa'i las byas na de lta bur 'gro ba yin te/ de ltar yang rnal 'byor rtsod pa byung ba'i tshe/ */gcig lan gcig gis byas pa ni/ */be'u sbrel g.yang la lhung ba ltar// gnyis ka ngan pa lhung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa yin skad/ des na sems bskyed pa byas pa na/ bya rgod gyi spu gseb tu pha wang nyal ba bzhin du/ gung rgyud dang yang rgyud du 'ong ba yin te/ sngon gyi dus su byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying pos 'khor lnga brgya la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa mdzad pas/

'khor de rnams kyi bslab bya nyams pa'i nyes pas/ rta lnga brgyar skyes pa yin pa gda'/ de la byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying pos/ rta de rnams kyi nang du rta cang shes shig tu bsams bzhin srid pa nye bar blangs pa yin par gda'/ de'i dus na yul phyogs de na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa der byon pa la/ rta cang shes la chag bre do do yod pa'i bre re bcom ldan 'das la drangs/ rta lnga brgya po la chag bre re re yod pa'i phyed phyed 'khor lnga brgya po la drangs nas/ dbyar zla gsum du sdig pa bshags pas/ de rnams de nas tshe 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes pa yin par gda'/ de nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par gsungs/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen don stengs pa bya ba/ des thams cad la 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa mdzad pa la/ khong gis slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen ya gad pa bya ba'i zhal nas/ khyod su snang snang la 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ma yin gsung skad pa la/ ngas 'di ltar byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig byung ba yin pas/ nub cig rmi lam na/ rje btsun byams pas srid pa'i 'khor lha ma srin sde brgyad la sogs pa dpag tu med pa zhig la chos gsung zhing gda' ba la/ nga'i mgo na lcam pa'i me tog ngan ne ba tshan cig gda' ba de/ rje btsun gyi dbu thog na yar gtor ba dang*/ me tog gi gdugs chen po zhig tu gyur ba de la dga' ba zhig skyes pa dang*/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyod kyis thams cad la 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gyis shig dang*/ thams cad phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas/ ngas de ltar du byas pa yin zer skad/ der khong gi slob ma rnams dang*/ slob dpon ya gad pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis zhus pa yin par gda'/ de lta bu'i 'jug pa byang chub kyis sems skye bar byed pa ni gnyis ste/

smon pa brtan pa dang*/ bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed pa dang gnyis las skye ba yin pas/ bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod/ lus longs spyod/ kha rje dbang thang*/ yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad kyis mchod nas/ me tog re phyag tu bsnams nas rjes bzlos mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon khyed las bdag byang chub sems kyi tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par len par 'tshal gyis/ gnod pa ma mchis na myur du stsal cing gnang bar rigs so// thabs yin no// legs so/ zhes so// yang bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin tshogs thams cad kyis mchod nas/ sdom pa la bskul ma gdab pas/ me tog re phyag na bsnams nas rjes bzlos mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon gyi bdag la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar myur du stsal du gsol/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod do// rigs kyi bu khyod byang chub sems dpa' lags sam/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la bslab bam/ slob bam/ de yang*/ khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam bya ba ni/ gong du smon pa la sogs pa sems bskyed pa yin nam zhes bgyi ba lags/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam zhes pa ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub tu bsngos sam zhes pa lags/ dge ba chos bsdud/ sems can don byed/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims la de snga phan chad bslab bam/ da phyin chad slob bam bgyi ba lags/ des bar chad med pa lags/ de nas bdag gi bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mi zad pa'i gter mdzod/ tshul khrims rin po che yun ring po mi thogs par myur du thob par 'dug ang snyam du dga' ba dang*/

spro bder skyed par zhu 'tshal/ de nas yang bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skye/ lus longs spyod/ kha rje dbang thang yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad kyis mchod nas/ me tog re phyag tu bsnams nas/ rjes bzlos bya mi dgos pas/ thugs ma yengs par gsan par zhu 'tshal/ rigs kyi bu khyed kyis/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa thob par 'dod dam/ zhes pa dang*/ yul gyis 'dod lags/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes la/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ de la khyod kyis thob rgyu'i sdom pa de/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang gsum gyis thob pa lags/ yang*/ bla ma la yang dag par sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin tshogs thams cad kyis mchod nas/ me tog re phyag tu bsnams nas/ rjes zlos bya mi dgos pas/ thugs ma yengs par dung nge gsan par zhu 'tshal/ de yang ngas khyod la lan gsum phog khyod kyis lan gsum blangs pa'i rjes la sdom pa thams cad thob pa yin/ thob pa la thob par shes par 'tshal ba lags/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims gang yin pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims gang yin pa dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi slob par mdzad pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi gang dag dang*/ tshul khrims gang dag dang*/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams bslab pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis slob pa dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis slob par mdzad pa'i gzhi gang dag la/

dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims thob par 'dod dam/ zhes pa dang*/ 'dod lags zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod do// de yang dge ba chos bsdud/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag byed pa'i sdom pa dang*/ sems can don byed kyi sdom pa/ 'tshams po la 'tshams po/ rgyal po la dkar yol/ sprang po la pha 'bab/ mdor na sems can la phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub pa'i sdom pa dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ so so thar pa rigs bdun/ yon bdag pa rnams kyi bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa dang*/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa sna gcig bsrung ba dang*/ sna 'ga' bsrung ba yan chod nas/ gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa man chad thob pa lags te/ de ltar yang*/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sdom pa las/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// zhes so// de ltar ngas khyod la sdom pa phog cing*/ khyod kyis blangs pa'i skabs der/ bla ma rin po che dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sngon gyi thugs rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas bzhugs pa lags/ de ltar byon nas bzhugs par yang bsam pa'i srin lag brkyang ba dang*/ nged rang gis srin lag sbrel bar bsam nas/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las yar langs par bsams la/ snyim pa nas kyi bkong*/ thal mo sbyar la/ nga'i rjes bzlos mdzad cing yar bzhengs par zhu 'tshal/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stong par ma gyur gyi bar du/ bla ma rin po che dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las dbugs 'byin par gyur cig

ces brjod cing*/ rang gis kyang yar langs la/ de nas 'di ltar bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa/ lan gsum gyis bar du blangs pa las 'phags pa'i chos lkog tu gyur kyang*/ rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi khams na/ chos thams cad lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo// zhes brjod cing*/ rang gis kyang phyag bya zhing gzhan rnams la yang phyogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal bar bsams nas/ phyag 'tshal du gzhug de ltar lan gsum bya'o// 'dir ji ltar bshams pa'i mchod pa thams cad/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi pho brang dang gshegs shul thams cad du/ 'ja' tshon 'khrugs pa dang*/ spos kyi ngad ldang ba dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba yin par gda'/ de'i dus sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi spyan sngar/ so so'i byang chub sems dpa' zhu bar dbang ba des/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs/ bla gos phrag pa cig tu bzar nas/ ltas de lta bu byung bar byed pa'i rgyu ci lags/ rkyen ci lags/ zhes zhu ba yin par gda'/ de la bcom ldan 'das des/ mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i gnad kas/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni mi mjed kyi khams na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di zhes bya bas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams la/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa byin pa'i ltas yin/ de rnams thams cad la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras dam par dgongs/ byang chub sems dpa' de rnams ni spun drung por dgongs bgyi ba yin par gda' ste/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ de tshe de la dge ba'i phyir// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// dge ba'i thugs kyi rgyas pa dang*// bu sdug lta bur dgongs par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas khyed rnams thams cad kyis/

sangs rgyas thams cad la pha yi 'du shes 'jog pa lags/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni spun drung po'i 'du shes 'jog byang chub kyi sems rin po che la mi zad pa'i gter mdzod kyi 'du shes bskyed dgos pa yin/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo bya ba yang khyed rang rnams la zer ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po bya ba yang khyed rang rnams la zer ba yin gsung*/ des na sems bskyed na byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig yin/ chos rje rin po che'i spyan sngar/ mkhan slob rnam pas dbu mdzad dge ba'i bshes bsnyen 'ga' tshogs pa'i dus cig na/ mkhan po rin po che'i zhal nas/ sgom chen pa 'di rnams rab sangs rgyas/ 'bring byang chub sems dpa'/ tha ma nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas bya ba yin gsung ba la/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ mkhan po rin po che pa de skad ma gsung cig /nga'i 'di na ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas med pa yin no gsung*/ de yang gang la dgongs na/ sems ma bskyed na ma bskyed/ skyed phyin chad byang chub sems dpa' mtho dman 'bring gsum ma gtogs pa gzhan med pa yin pas/ de ltar du shes par bya/ gzhan yang sngar smon pa'i skabs su/ bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes med par song na/ byang chub kyi sems mi skye bas/ nges par sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyed dgos par gsungs pa dang*/ 'dir 'jug pa'i skabs su/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' zhes pa nas/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' ba 'byung ba gnyis 'di 'gal lam snyam na/ smon pa 'bras bu la dam bca' ba yin pas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes nges par dgos pa yin la/ 'jug pa rgyu la dam bca' ba yin pas na/ 'dir de ltar byung ba yin gsung*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dis gzhan bsrung bar byed pa gal che ste/ gya tshom du ma bsgrag gsung bas/ gzhan ma dad pas thos nas sdig pa gsog pa'i dogs yod pas/ de bas bsags par song na byang chub kyi sems la phan yon ci tsam yod pa de tsam du sdig pa bsags na/

nyes byas kyang de tsam gyi che ba yin pas/ gzhan ma dad pa rnams la gsang bar byed pa gal che/ des 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'i rim pa thams cad tshar ba lags so// da ni don dam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yin pas/ 'di theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi dbang bzhi pa'i don yin/ 'di yi dus su bla ma la sangs rgyas gcig pu'i 'du shes kyis mi phan pas/ chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed dgos pa yin te/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma la ji ltar mthong ba bzhin du rang nyid la yang de'i yon tan skye ba yin pas/ bla ma la sprul pa'i skur mthong na rang nyid kyis gzhan don 'grub par 'gyur la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mthong na 'dod pa'i don 'grub la/ chos kyi skur mthong na rang nyid la rtogs pa skye ba yin gsung skad/ des na chos rje rin po ches btsun chung zhig la khyod kyi nga la chos skur mthong ngam gsung pa la/ rin po che dag a chang yang che ste/ nga rang yang chos kyi sku yin zer ba la mnyes pa yin par gda' te/ bla ma la chos kyi skur mthong na rang nyid la yang de'i rtogs pa skye ba mthong chos yin te/ de bas na dbang de yang mtshan nyid bla ma rin po che lta bu zhig las thob dgos pa yin te/ de thob pa la rtogs pa skyes pa zhig dgos pa yin/ de ma rtogs pa cho ga'i dbang de ni gzhan las yang thob pa yin/ de bas na 'di bskyed pa'i bla ma la/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes dang*/ yon du gser phul ba dang*/ mar me mdzad kyis kyang phyag 'tshal dgos pa yin/ de yang yon du gser bya ba yin te/ khyed rang thams cad kyis 'bul ba zhabs tog dang*/ zhabs 'bring bgyis pa 'di dag thams cad las lhag pa med pa de la gsungs pa lags/ mar me mdzad kyis kyang phyag bya ba lags te/ bcom ldan 'das mar me mdzad la bram ze'i khye'u sprin zhes bya bas/ ral pa gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu gdan la bting*/

byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par gsungs pa dang 'dra bar/ nged rang thams cad kyis bla ma rin po che'i zhabs kyis pad mo la btugs nas phyag dpag tu med pa 'tshal bar bsam/ de yang sa gul la shong na dngos su 'tshal dgos pa lags/ gzhan yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sku mkhar gyi steng du/ shel gyi mchod rten khru gang pa gcig mu dra'i phyag rgya sla nga tsam gcig pang kong phyag rgya gcig dang gsum byon pa 'di ltar du mtshon lugs rnam pa gsum/ mtshon pa'i brdar byon pa yin te/ shel gyi mchod rten khru gang ba de sems nyid dri ma med pa'i brdar byon pa yin la/ de thabs gang gis mngon du 'gyur snyam pa la/ mu dra'i phyag rgya sla nga tsam pa lags te/ nged rang gi mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya 'di la gsungs pa lags pas/ 'dis ji lta ba bzhin du mngon du 'gyur ba'i gnad kas de'i brdar byon pa yin/ sangs rgyas ci tsam zhig la phyag 'tshal mos gus byas pa yin na/ sems kyi rang bzhin mthong snyam pa la/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa la phyag byas mos gus byas na mthong zhes pa'i brda la/ pang kong phyag rgya pa byon pa yin/ des de lta bu'i sems nyid dri ma med pa de rtogs shing*/ mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa la/ bla ma dam pa dgos pa yin/ de ltar yang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes pa dang*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs padmor 'dud// ces gsungs pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs bsdus pa'i bdag nyid bla ma dam pa yin pas/ yang bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod/

lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang yul ris rgyal khams thams cad kyis mchod nas/ me tog re phyag tu bsnams nas/ mchog gi skyabs 'gro bgyi bas rjes bzlos re mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong gi bar du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung la skyabs su mchi'o// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i thugs la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs yin no// legs so zhes brjod/ da khyed rang so so'i lus yi dam gyi lha gang yin par wal gyis bsgom/ yi dam lha ngos bzung med pa kun jo bo thugs rje chen por bsgom par zhu 'tshal/ de ltar yi dam gyi lha sgom pa'i dus/ yi dam gyi lha gang nas kyang 'ongs pa med cing*/ tha mal pa'i lus gang du yang song ba med cing*/ de sgom pa'i dus na/ yi dam gyi lha'i skur snang la/ tha mal pa'i lus su bzung ba'i dus/ tha mal pa'i lus gang nas kyang 'ongs pa med cing*/ yi dam gyi lha gar yang song ba med par song na yang der bzung ba'i dus/ tha mal pa'i lus su snang ba yin pas/ byed pa po gzhan med par rang gi sems yin te/ sems kyi gar btags pa dang bzung bar snang ba yin no// de ltar yang*/ rang bzhin gcig tu ma nges pas// gang ltar btags pa de ltar snang*// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin de lta bu'i nges pa'i shes pa zhig yod par song na/ nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad thams cad zlog par byed pa la tshegs med pas/ da ltar nad dang gnod pa mang ba 'dug pa 'di yang rang nyid tha mal pa'i lus su bzung bas lan pa yin/

de ltar ma yin pa bla ma dam pa'am/ yi dam gyi lhar bsgom pa'i dus na/ de'i sku la nyes pa de dag gnas pa'i sa med pas myur du 'dag pa yin no// sngon dpal ldan phag mo gru pas tshogs chos gyes nas yar la bzhud dus cig la/ sngags bu mi gzhon zhig gis skad btang nas/ bla ma rin po che nga la thugs la 'dogs par zhu bya ba zer ba la/ zhal phyir la gzigs nas kho bo bsgom gsung skad/ de la de'i dus na/ sngags bu de khams gzhis zin pa zhig yin par gda' ba de spyil po zhig tu phyin nas/ dpal phag mo gru pa sgom zhing bsdad pas/ nam srod la kho la gnod byed de byung nas/ 'di na ni bla ma chen po de gda'/ nga'i nad pa de gar song na bya ba zer skad/ khos de phan par rigs nas brtson 'grus bskyed nas bsgoms pas/ nam phyed kyi dus na yang byung nas mdun phyogs la sogs par 'ong mi phod par byas nas gong ltar zer skad/ de bas kyang shin tu phan pa rigs nas/ 'bad 'bungs ston nas sgom pas/ nam tho rangs kyi dus na ma ki yar chab gtsang po'i 'gram na yar 'gro mar 'gro byed kyin ngu zhing dgon pa na yar lta yang mi phod par gda' skad/ des nub cig po de rang gis nad dang gnod pa thams cad des dag pa yin par gda'/ de yang sngar gyi sngags bu'i lus gang du yang song ba med la/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i sku gang nas kyang 'ongs pa med kyang*/ der sgom pa'i dus na/ de'i skur gyur pas nad dang gnod pa 'dag pa yin la/ sngar sngags pa'i lus bzung ba'i dus na/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa gar yang song ba med cing*/ sngags bu'i lus gang nas kyang 'ongs pa med pa/ der bzung ba'i dus su sngags bu'i lus su snang nas nad dang gnod pa de ltar du byung nas/ sems kyis gang bsam pa de'i lus su 'ongs nas/ sems kyi lus dang*/ lus kyi snang ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ sems lus lta bu dang*/

lus sems lta bu dang*/ sems tshig tu brjod pa lta bur bskyed cig ces gsungs pas/ sems gang yin par song na lus lta bu dang*/ lus gang yin par song na sems lta bu dang sems tshig tu brjod pa'i ngag de lta bur brjod cig /ces gsungs pa yin pas/ yang bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes skyed/ mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod/ lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad kyis mchod nas/ me tog phyag tu bsnams nas/ rjes bzlos mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched dang*/ bzung ba dang*/ 'dzin pa thams cad rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid du thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs yin no// legs so zhes brjod/ de yang ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid du thugs ji ltar bskyed pa de bzhin du/ nged rang gis kyang de ltar du sems bskyed pa yin no// de ltar yang*/ dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing*// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs so// des sems bskyed pa rnam gsum gyis dngos gzhi tshar ba lags// //da de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gsum dang*/ de bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma rin po che dang mi 'bral ba'i smon lam btab pas/

bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin tshogs thams cad kyis mchod/ lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang*/ yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad kyis mchod nas/ me tog re phyag tu bsnams nas rjes bzlos mdzad par zhu 'tshal/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ nam zhig tshe rabs thams cad du/ byang chub kyi sems mi gtong zhing*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma rin po che dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs yin no// legs so zhes brjod par bya'o// des byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'i go rim thams cad tshar ba lags/ da dus rgyun gyi sgom rgyu dang*/ lag len la 'debs rgyu 'di lags pas/ ngas ji ltar sprod pa bzhin du thugs ma yengs par bsgom par zhu 'tshal/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya'o snyam du bsam/ de smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dus rgyun chad med par sgom rgyu dang lag len la 'debs rgyu lags/ de'i ched du spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum po 'di dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung nas nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du/ yang lus ngag yid gsum po dge ba la bkol snyam du bsam/ de 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dus rgyun chad med par sgom rgyu dang lag len la 'debs rgyu lags/ de nas khyed rang so so'i lus yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa bsgom/ yi dam gyi lha ngos bzung med pa rnams/ jo bo thugs rje chen po wal gyis bskyed/ de'i thugs kha na 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che bzhugs par bsam/ de nas rang gi sems rig rig tur tur po/ rnam par rtog pa mi skye dgu skye/

bsam mno mi byed dgu byed kyi sems 'di la nang du gcer lta ba lags/ sems de la de ltar bltas pa'i dus na/ bltas tsam nyid la cir yang grub pa med par gnas pa lags/ de la mtho dman dang bzang ngan gyi rtogs pa gang yang ma skyes par ci gnas gnas kyi bar skyong ba lags/ de don dam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i sgom rgyu dang lag len la 'debs rgyu lags/ thugs ma yengs par de ltar bsgom pa zhu 'tshal/ ngas gtor ma 'di dag chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma chen po rnams la phul bas khyed rnams kyis gdong grogs mdzod cig pa'i bka' sgo bgyid 'tshal/ de nas dril bu bsil zhing*/ gtor ma phul nas bka' sgo byas pa'i rjes la/ yi ge brgya pa tshar bdun bdun tsam bgrang bar zhu 'tshal/ de ltar 'bri gung gnas bzhugs 'gro mgon gyis// der 'dus rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs dbus su// zab cing rgya che byang chub sems bskyed pa'i// mkha' ltar mtha' ni mngon par mi nus te// 'on kyang bdag gis thob par phal cher dus// ci zhig bka' stsal rim pa de nyid kyi// gsung la lhag par gus sogs de dag gis// dran pas bskul byed zin tsam yi ger bris// 'di la nor 'khrul nyes skyon ci mchis pa// rab 'byams bka' dang de yi dgongs 'grel dang*// bla ma'i drin dang yangs pa'i shes rab kyi// dam chos spyan ldan rnams la bzod par gsol// 'di bris dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs// bral sogs yon tan mtshan dpe kun mnga' zhing*// mtshan thos mi ldog sar 'god thub dbang mchog /tshe 'dir myur thob bstan pa rgyas byed shog byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ bla ma rin po che'i zhabs kyis rdul la reg cing*/ de nyid kyi rigs su gtogs pa ban sdom dpal gyi ming chen gyis// rang gzhan gyi don du zin bris su bkod pa'o// rdzogs so// //dge'o//

780) ༄// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan rtogs pa'i mgur/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// byams dang snying rje rta pho la// gzhan phan gyi dkyus thog ma bcad na// khrom lha mi'i 'or che mi 'byung bas// sems sngon 'gro 'di la nan gtan mdzod// rang lus lha sku'i rgyal po la// gzhi 'gyur med kyi brtan sa ma zin na// ma mkha' 'gro'i 'khor 'bangs mi 'du bas// lus yi dam gyi lha la nan tan mdzod// bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la// mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas// sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod// sems nyid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la// rnam rtog gi sprin tshogs ma dengs na// mkhyen gnyis kyi gza' skar mi bkra bas// sems mi rtog 'di la nan tan mdzod// tshogs gnyis yid bzhin nor bu la// smon lam gyis byi dor ma byas na// dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas// rjes bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces phyag chen lnga ldan gyi rtogs mgur bya ba skyob pa nyid kyis mdzad/ ༈ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' drin gyis// mi bdag la bde ba'i nyams shig shar// byang chub kyi sems la gdeng zhig thob// chos lta ba dang sgom pa spyod pa gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// thun mtshams kyi dge sbyor bya rgyu med// bdag byar med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// bla ma dang rang sems sangs rgyas gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// bcos ma'i mos gus bya rgyu med// bdag byar med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// pha ma dang yi dam 'gro drug gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// gzhan phan gyi 'gro don bya rgyu med// bdag byar med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// bka' dang rgyud sde bstan bcos gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// yig nag gi dpe chas bya rgyu med// bdag byar med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor bya rgyu med// bdag byar med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du// mos gus gdung shugs drag po yis// mtshan ldan rje dang 'bral ma myong*// bdag 'bral med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'// nyams dga' ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// bde mo drug gi dbyangs chung 'di// dpal stag lung thang pa'i snyan du 'bul// bla ma bsten yun thung snyam bdag la med// gdams ngag gnang zhes bya ba thugs la btags// zhes bde mo drug gi mgur bya ba/

byang nam ri'i blag mor bzhugs dus/ dpal stag lung thang pa la gsung po'/ོ ༈ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs la 'dud// dpal phag mo gru pa'i bka' drin gyis// rang gi sems la nges shes skyes// byang chub kyi sems la gdeng zhig thob// bdag rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon par 'grim// nga la nyams rtogs shig yod pa chos skad du song*// snod ldan gyi slob ma dam pa la// nyams dang rtogs pa dka' mor gda'// bdag rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon par 'grim// nga la yon tan zhig yod pa zang zing du song*// ka ca 'di chags sdang skye ba'i rgyu// bdud kyi phye gtor 'gams pas phung*// bdag rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon par 'grim// nga la nye gnas shig yod pa ya bor song*// phyir 'khrid kyi grogs ngan dgos rgyu chung*// chags sdang gi spyod pa rgyun mi 'chad// bdag rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon par 'grim// nga la grwa pa zhig yod pa bem por song*// 'di phyi'i dgos pa bsam mkhan med// 'khor bu slob mang po bskyangs pas phung*// bdag rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon par 'grim// nga la spyod lam zhig yod pa tshe 'dir shor// mi chos kyi 'dun ma bsgrubs bsgrubs nas// dad ldan gyi slob ma bslu bslu 'dra// bdag rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon par 'grim// sgyu ma'i skyes bus smig rgyu'i chu las brgal// nam mkha'i padmo rmi lam bung bas 'jibs// mo gsham bu yis sgra snyan glu dbyangs len// zang zing spros pas don dam rtogs so zhes// nyams rtogs med pa'i byis pas de skad zer// rang sems dri med dkar po 'di// dam pa'i chos dang zhu gtug gyis// gnyis su med pa'i ri bo la// bde ba chen po'i nags tshal rgyas// dran pa yengs med kyi ri dwags 'phyo// bde gsal mi rtog gi rtsa chu za// dgon pa zhig mdzad na de na mdzod// bdag rnal 'byor pa ri khrod kyi dgon pa 'grim// zhes pa 'bri gung du dge 'dun tshogs pa gtos ches grags pas thugs cung zad sun pa'i rnam pa byung nas ri khrod mdzad par bzhed de tsha 'ug tu byon nas bzhugs dus gsungs pas tsha 'ug rdzong 'brom ma che bar grags//
