de yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rmang rdo yin pa dang*/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa rnams nyams su len pa rnams la lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che dang bral ba'i gdams ngag gis yon tan skyed par mi nus te/ phub ma brdungs pa dang khyad med par dgongs shing bstan pa'i phyir/ rje sa skya pa chen po dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i chang ljags la ma bstar cing*/ bu ram la rung chu btab nas gsol ba dang*/ gdams ngag rnams kyi rang spyod tha dad pa rnams la gang gis kyang g.yo ba med pa/ rdo rje'i ri lta bur bzhugs pa lags so// de ltar byas pas sku btsun pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab pas/ rje sgam po pa rje btsun mi la'i zhal slob tu song bas/ dgong mo bdud rtsi sba phor re gsol ba yin par gda'/ de gsol ba'i dus su dge bshes khams pa e 'byon ltos shig gsung nas/ sgo drung sum rim 'jog pa yin par gda'/ nyin gcig gsol zhal sba phogs gang phyag na bsnams nas yod pa la/ bde bar gshegs pa shad kyis byon pa dang*/ bred pa ltar mdzad nas/ dge bshes khams pa 'di re 'di re gsung nas/ gsol zhal gang po de gnang bas thang la ma bzhugs par zhabs gnyis kyang bgrad nas gsol bas/ mkhan po rin po che spyan sngar yod pas/ slob dpon khams pa'i btsun tshugs de la de ring song rgyu zhig yin gsungs pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal nas/ rje rin po che nyid kyi zhal zas kyi bdud rtsi de ring myong ba lags par gda'/ mos gus che ba'i thag des chod/ rje sgam po pa la gsol ja bas gsol ja 'dren pa'i dus su/ gsol lhag gsol skyan gyi nang du blugs nas/ spyan sngar yod pa'i mi chen po rnams la drangs pas/ mkhan po zhang gi thugs dgongs la/ rnal 'byor pa la zhad yod/ 'bags btsog re yang mi shes snyam pa dang*/

bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs la/ theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags su dngos grub bgo bsha' bya gsung ba de 'dir dgongs pa byung gsung*/ yang nyin gcig bde bar gshegs pa/ rje sgam po ba la zhu ba gang byed kyang sku skyed nas maṇḍal zhig bsnams nas/ de phul nas zhu ba lags par gda'/ nyin gcig maṇḍal phul nas/ kho bo bla ma rin po che la zhu rgyu zhig yod zhus pas/ dge bshes khams pa ci 'dod pa zhus gsung*/ zla ba gcig la rab gnas kha gsum du mdzad gsung ba de bden nam zhus pas/ de los bden/ de la tshegs ci yod/ rtog pa kha gsum du gtad pas chog pa yin gsung*/ de mi dgos sems can re re'i mdun du sprul pa brgya brgya 'gyed nus pa yin gsung*/ dge bshes khams pa de la mtshar rgyu ci yod gsung*/ de sngan chad gsung la zin ris byed cing yod pa/ zin ris kyi mtha' chod par mi gda'/ bla ma 'di la mos gus byed dgos par dgongs nas/ de phyin chad zin bris kyi 'phro chad/ thugs dam 'ba' zhig tu mdzad do// bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ rin po che mtshur phu ba dang*/ gsal stong sho re dang gsum spyil po gcig tu bzhugs pa la/ gsal stong sho re dus rgyun du chang gsol dgos par gda'/ slob dpon sgom pas chang gi bca' khrims mdzad pas las pa khong rnam gsum can du 'ongs pas/ bde bar gshegs pas mkhyen nas/ gsal stong gi chang gsol rgyu bum pa yod pa khong rang la sbed sa gcig yod pa der sbas nas bzhag las pa rnams kyis khong rnam pa'i khog ma dang snod tsho bcag chang sbas pa de ma rnyed/ gsal stong byung bas khams pa tsho'i zhabs 'dren byas/ khyad par du khyed rnam gnyis kyi zhabs 'dren byas/ da nga rang 'gro ba yin/ do nub kyi 'thung rgyu gcig kyang ma lus zer/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal nas/ khyod rang gi sbed sa de na do nub 'thung rgyu yod zer/ thugs la btags thugs la btags zer nas kho dga'/ phyis kho 'gro zer/

khyod gcig pu song bas gar phan/ thel 'di na khams pa mi gsum du grags pa yin/ khyod kyis lan na yang gsum ga 'gro dgos gsung nas/ khres po byas nas gsum ga mar byon/ rje sgam po pa yang dgon steng na bzhugs pas/ khres po khur ba gsum song ba su yin gsung*/ khams pa mi gsum yin zhus pas/ gar 'gro ba yin gsung*/ gsal stong gis chang gi bca' khrims las 'gal ba byas pas/ khong las pa tshos snod rnams bcag pas ko long byas nas 'gro ba yin zhus pas/ kho bo ni khong gsum skyong ba yin/ kho bo yang gzim chas sgrogs shig gsung nas mar byon pas/ der thams cad kyis sgam po pa la zhu ba phul/ khong rnam pa gsum la bzod gsol mdzad/ khong rnam gsum zhal dam re mdzad pa la/ bde bar gshegs pas/ nags tshal zhig tu ras pa lnga brgyas skor ba zhig byed pa yin gsung*/ rin po che tshur phu bas rin po che byon tsam na snang ba thams cad 'ur ba zhig byed pa yin gsung*/ gsal stong gis grong ltag cig na/ dgon chung zhig byed nas/ ya ki na slaub dpon pa bzhugs pa yin zer nas/ sgom ma sbyin pa tsho tshegs che bas chang ban thang khur ba zhig byed pa yin gsung*/ khong rnam pa gsum gyis zhal gdams thog tu song ba yin par gda'/ rje sgam po ba'i spyan sngar zhu ba tshig gsum gyis rang byung gi ye shes thugs la shar nas/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kyi don thag kyang der chod/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa thams cad phyi shun dang sbun par song*/ bla ma btsal sems kyi spros pa yang der chod/ gdams ngag btsal sems kyi re 'dod yang der zhi/ bla ma la sangs rgyas su yang der mthong*/ bya byed kyi spros pa yang der chad pa lags te/ de ltar yang nyams myong la zhen pa ma mchis na// dpe cha la chags pa ga la mchis// ji snyed kyi grong khyer ma zad na// bza' rgyu la zad pa ma mchis pas// ltogs kyis dogs pa ga la yod// 'chi sa brla sgang 'dra ba la// yul phyogs la dmigs pa ga la yod// ces pa dang*/

dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzom na/ bsten yun ring thung med par yon tan gang byo'i tshul du 'ong ba yin no// zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ rje sgam po ba la lo gnyis bsten nas/ de nas yar byon/ 'on gyi spang chung du dgon pa btab nas der bzhugs/ grwa pa brgyad cu tsam byung ba la chos gsungs/ de rnams khrid tshar bar mdzad/ de nas rgya sgom mig ras kyis nga'i dgon pa 'dir 'byon par zhu/ zhal gyis bzhes nas lo mang bar song*/ da cis kyang 'byon par zhu zer nas/ zhu ba drag po phul bas gnas brtan bden/ gnas brtan gyis gsung ba bzhin du byed dgos gsung*/ de nas mar byon pa la chibs med nas gnas brtan la rta rgod ma zhig yod pa de g.yar bas/ de la chibs tsa na/ sug bzhi ka ba btsugs pa bzhin song nas gom pa spo rgyu ma byung*/ de nas khams pa sa smad pa chos skyabs bya ba la/ rta nag bzang po zhig yod pa g.yar bas/ nga la chibs sga ba 'chol na g.yar/ de min na mi g.yar zer/ chibs sga ba bcol bas chog gsung nas mar byon/ tshag po g.yung drung dgos bya ba zhing gi chu 'chu zhing 'dug bde bar gshegs pa'i yon bdag yin par snang*/ yon bdag la tshur shog gyis gsungs nas/ yon bdag tshur byung ba la/ yon bdag kho bo ma ta 'di na don bsnyegs pa zhig la 'byon pa yin gsung*/ yon bdag gis skyel ma byed dgos gsung*/ yon bdag na re/ ngas khyim nas ral gu blangs nas 'ong zhus pas/ ral gu mi dgos/ 'di rang gis chog yon bdag gis sna drongs gsung*/ yon bdag gis lcags skyem phrag la khur nas mdun na mar song ba'i phyi na mar bde bar gshegs pas byon/ sngo 'jongs thang na mar phyin pa'i dus su/ chibs sga bas chibs drag tu btang bas/ kho bo yo/ kho bo yo gsung*/ de nas tsha rong na btsad po 'od lde mgon bya ba yod pas/ btsad po jo bo ba de'i sgo khar byon nas/ jo bo ba la sgor mdzad pa gyis gsung*/ jo bo sgor byon pa la dar sham zhig gi phyag rten btang nas/

jo bo ba la zhu na/ 'on gyi spang chung na yod pa'i khams pa ston pa de nga yin/ kho bo'i sa khul ma ta 'di na phag mo gru zer ba'i dgon pa zhig yod par 'dug de na kho bo ci rigs pa zhig sdod pa yin pas/ jo bo bas spyan ras kyi rtsa ba dang thugs la 'dogs par zhu gsungs pas/ de kho na bzhin zhu/ gdugs tshod la nang du 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ kho bo rgyal po'i pho brang du mi 'byon pa'i dam bca' yod gsung nas/ nang du 'byon ma nyan nas/ phag mo gru'i rong 'di na yar byon/ bya wang zhig kang ka rad kang ka rad zer nas/ phyag phyi ba rnams la bya wang 'di ci zer e shes gsung*/ mi shes zhus pas/ bya wang 'di na re/ dge bshes khams pa khyod phu nas phyir mi ldog zer/ kho bo 'dir bzhugs pa 'ong bar 'dug gsung*/ mang khar sgang 'dir byon nas gzigs pas/ gnam la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ sa la pad ma 'dab brgyad/ nags khrod dben pa bsten dbang gis/ phrad cing rang dbang bsten mdzad gsol/ kho bos gsol ba btab pas thebs pa yin/ stod kyi shing chen 'di cung nyung tsam gsung nas mnyes pa yin par snang*// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyang*// nags khrod byang chub shing drung du// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas shing*// me tog zla mdzes la sogs pa// bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyang*// nags khrod dgon par don chen sgrubs// dpal gyi ri dang bhe ta'i tshal// grub thob gong ma thams cad kyis// nags khrod dgon par dngos grub brnyes// rjes su 'jug pa'i slob ma rnams// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs par// nags khrod dgon pa yin no zhes// yang dang yang du bka' bstsal gsung*/ de ltar gnas phun sum tshogs pa nags khrod kyi dgon pa rgyal byed kyi tshal de lta bu rnyed nas/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pas 'khor rgya mtsho chen po lta bu skyong ba'i thabs 'di ltar bya'o// zhes bstan par bzhed pas slob ma'i rgyud smin pa dang*/

yon tan rin po che'i tshogs zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel ba dang*/ bkra shis pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ legs pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i dus yin pa dang*/ mtshams bcad cing sgrub pa nyams su len pa rnams zla ba'i sgron mes gsal bar gyur pa la sogs pa tshu rol mthong ba'i rten gyi gang zag rnams kyis kyang phan pa mang po 'byung bar nyams su myong pas 'grub pa dang*/ mar ngo'i zla ba phyed la thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i yon tan rin po che nyid kyis ji ltar bzhed cing gsung ba thams cad nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyang smra ba la dga' ba'i nyes pa spang bas bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa tha dad pa la mnyam par gzhag pas/ sngar slob ma'i rgyud smin par byas pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs de/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyis smin par byas pas tshogs gnyis 'phel zhing mi zad pa'i gter chen po thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ rang gi yon tan la bogs dpag tu med pa 'byung ba dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa la gsol ba 'debs pa rnams dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis rlob par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su dus shes pa la sogs pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa la dgongs nas/ mar ngo la sku mtshams mdzad pa dang*/ de la zla ba yar ngo'i dus su sku mtshams shin tu dam par mdzad cing*/ phyi dro'i dus su sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad pa de yang*/ rjes su 'jug pa rnams dang*/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs spyi dang 'gro ba thams cad la yang gdams pa mdzad pa lags te/ de yang 'dir nged sems can rnams kyi 'dug lugs kyis ni gzhan dag legs par gnas shing*/ bde ba dang skyid pa'i dus su ngo dga' dang phye gtor dgos pa med cing mi 'dod kyang byed/ shi shi chad chad du phan pa dang bde ba bsgrubs kyang*/

sdug cing phongs nas nyam thag pa'i dus su nyes pa brjod cing spong bar 'gyur ba chos nyid du 'dug la/ skyes bu chen po de nyid ni/ brtse ba chen pos kun la bu bzhin gzigs// phongs par gyur na shin tu mi gtong zhing*// gnod pa byas na thugs rjes bder yang 'brel// nga 'o zad pas 'khor gsum yongs su dag /ces pa lags te/ yul yang mi dgos pa'i dus su ngo dga' dang kha gsag dang gzhogs slongs dang*/ thob kyis 'jal ba la sogs pa mi mnga' zhing*/ phongs shing dgos pa'i dus su bde zhing bde bar mi gyur ba ni gcig kyang med/ bdag nyid kyi skyid pa thams cad kyang dang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rjes nas khur du bsnams par mdzad do// de nas mang khar gyi phug pa ma gir lo gnyis bzhugs/ nub kyi pha gir lo bzhi/ ding sang gi gzims spyil 'di khams pa sa smad pa zhig la yod par gda'/ khams pa des bde bar gshegs pa gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal nas/ spyil po bde yang yang gsung*/ nga'i 'di la mnyes na 'bul bar zhu zhus pas/ kho bo shin tu yang mnyes so/ kho bo'i gzims chas da lta rang khyer la shog gsung nas/ de nub nas der bzhugs/ de nas nye gnas rnams kyis spyil po 'di la bcos zhig byed par zhu zhus pas/ bcos byed pa rten 'brel gtan mi btub/ nyin gcig gis tshar na btub gsung*/ de nas bla ma nyag ses lcang lcug mdud pa dgos pa tshun chad bsags nas/ mi mkhas pa mang po bos nas phyir bshigs/ dgong mo zhal la tshun chod tshar ba yin par snang*/ de la mnyes nas nyag se ni bsams pa tsam gyis grub/ bsam grub ras chen du thogs gsung*/ spyir yon tan rin po che skye ba'i dus tho rangs yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang tho rangs byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa chos nyid yin/ thabs lam gyi yon tan thams cad kyang tho rangs kyi dus su mi skye kha med yin gsung zhing*/ tho rangs shin tu gdams par mdzad cing*/

de'i thugs kyis dgongs pa zab mo rnams sras kyi dam pa rnams la shub thabs su mdzad cing*/ tshogs su seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs pa dang*/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyis mngon sum du mdzad pa dang*/ thub pa chen po bstan pa'i bdag po sku 'khor dang bcas pas kyang*/ gdugs tshod la ma babs phan chod du thugs dam la mnyam par gzhag cing*/ gdugs tshod la babs pa'i dus su/ snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol zhing lhung zed bsnams te bsod snyoms bzhes nas phyag bcabs nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gang zag re re la sogs pa'i khrid kyi spros pa chod par mdzad cing*/ dgong ja thon pa'i dus su yul bar lan gcig mdzad pa'i rjes la/ slob ma snod dang ldan pa rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo skor te nyi ma'i gung ni yol/ sa'i khams dang tshad pa ni dwangs/ ser bu'i ngad bsil ba ni ldang*/ khams dang dbang po ni brtas/ grib chung bsil le grib chen 'ubs se'i dus der/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya chen po 'dus pa la/ mtha' dang bral ba'i seng ge'i khri la dbu mar gnas pa'i rin chen gyi gdan bshams nas sku dgye dgu med par drang por bzhugs shing dkyil krung legs par bcas nas ni/ shin tu zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis ni legs par shod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'phrul gyi spyan gyis dge 'dun gyi tshogs la gzigs/ dung gi tshems bar nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas/ seng ge'i rgyal po'am/ bya ka la ping ka'am/ 'brug gi sgra'am/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar zab cing snyan pa'i gsung ha cang mang ba yang ma yin pa dang*/ ha cang nyung ba ma yin zhing*/ lung dang bcas pa rigs pa dang bcas pa/ man ngag dang bcas pa nyams su myong ba'i gnad zab mo dang bcas pa tshogs kyi chos dang dpag gi chos dang*/ zab chos rnams gsungs pas tshim par mdzad pa dang*/ khams dang bag la nyal dang bsam pa'i gnad mngon du gyur cing*/ tshim par ston pa'i gsung gi sgro 'dogs dang*/

the tshom gyi spros pa chod nas/ 'jig rten yi rang zhing gsungs pa la mngon par bstod/ zhes gsungs par gyur pa lta bu lags so// gzhan yang chos don du gnyer bas gzhan gang yang don du gnyer ba ma yin pa dang*/ mdzad pa shin tu rnam par dag pa la mi chos kyi 'dun mas dgos pa med par bstan pa'i phyir/ zhing khams de na 'dus pa'i gtso mdun med// sa gzhi nyid kyis dbang ba ma bzung zhing*// 'dod pa'i yon tan spangs pa shin tu bde// so nam gnas gzhi spangs pa rgyal ba'i sras// 'tsho ba bya tshol byed pa'i bsod snyoms pa// sa phyogs gcig tu yun ring ma bzhugs na// skyes chen de la mdun mas ci zhig bya// dbang gi rgyal po dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar// bde ba'i 'byung gnas chos kyi rgyal po la// lha klu gnod sbyin chos skyong bsrung ma rnams// yul dang phyogs su bcas pas srung bar byed// mi zad gter chen dgos 'dod char pa yis// yul khams thams cad bde skyid dang ldan na// su yi mdun mas de la ci zhig bya// 'das dang ma 'ongs dus gsum mkhyen pa yi// mngon par shes pa thob pa'i mthu med kyang*// thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab dam chos kyi// rjes su 'brang zhing chos dang bstun pa la// nyes pa med na mdun mas ci zhig bya// thub pa'i gsung dang 'gal ba med pa yi// rgyal ba'i sras rnams gang du phyin na yang*// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za'i gnas kyang rung*// gang du phyin kyang kun gyis bkur ba dang*// srung zhing bkur bsti chen pos bkur gyur na// gcig tu zhen pa'i mdun mas ci zhig bya// zhes pa la sogs pa'i mdun ma mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dpag tu med pa slob ma rnams la bstan pa lags so// yang khrid mdzad nas/ zla ba phyed po 'di la kho bo yang bsgom pa yin/ khyed rang yang bsgom la kho bo'i mdun du yon tan ngo so dang bcas pa khyer la shog yang skyon re khyer la shog gsungs pas/

mi mthun po re dogs 'jigs gsum yod par ni song*/ mnyes dang mi mnyes pa mtho dman dbang chen po ni 'dzin/ legs nyes kyi gsung gcig gis gtan gyi so nam yod med du ni 'gro/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' bas/ rang la bya ra dgos pa rnams skul ma btab pas/ yon tan rin po che mi skye dbang med 'gyur ba dang*/ yang dus re shig thugs kyis dgongs pa la brag zhun bzhed pa zhig byung bas/ pho rog gcig gis brag zhun zhig bskyal/ de la mnyes pa yin par snang*/ rje sgam po ba'i dbon chung sgom chung 'dir byon pa la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal nas/ slob dpon gyis kho bo la chos 'brel zhig zhu gsung nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i chos khri dkar po'i kha la/ bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyi bzhugs gdan bshams nas/ slob dpon sgom chung bzhugs bcol/ chos khri'i mdun du g.yang shun zhig bting ba'i kha la bde bar gshegs pa bzhugs nas/ phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na spos zhig bsnams nas chos zhus pas/ nyam mi nga bar gsungs pas shin tu mnyes skad/ rje phag mo gru pas/ dge bshes bu slob khams su 'gro ba rnams la rdzong pa gser srang gang*/ phrug phyam gcig la la ni de'i kha la to pi zhig dang*/ bum tshe zhig gnang ba lags par gda' ba/ nye gnas kyis khams pa tsho la 'di tsam mi gnang bar zhu/ mi tshos 'bar yin 'dug zhus pas/ rje rin po che byon nas khams pa tsho la ma byin gsung yang*/ maṇḍal zhig phul nas de mi gsung bar zhu/ 'di tsho la kho bo min pa bsam rgyu med/ sa thag ring po nas 'ongs/ sprin dkar po la tshad ma ni btsugs/ tshe 'di la da lan min pa e mjal ni mi shes/ de mi gsung bar zhu/ gnang bar zhu/ thag bcad pa'i gsung byon pas de phyin chad zhu mi ma byung bar gda'/ grwa pa rnams kyis yar la tshigs bcad byas par gda'/ dge bshes khams pa'i spyan snga 'dir// khams 'gro'i lus su ma skyes na// chos dang zang zing gnyis ka med// kye ma kyi hud ji ltar bya// zer ba yin par gda'/

yang dus re shig mkhan po ba la 'o cag gnyis skye ba snga ma rgya nag tu rgyal blon gnyis su skye ba bzhes pa yin gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa rgyal po yin/ kho bo blon po yin gsung*/ de'i dus su ra ma dkar mo zhig yod pa bzhos shing*/ 'o skol gnyis ja'o byas pa yin/ ding sang gi gtsang bu ra skad pa 'di yin gsung*/ 'o cag gnyis kyis gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs pa la bar chad byung nas 'phro lus pa yin/ da dge ba'i bshes gnyen pas gtsug lag khang zhig bzhengs gsung*/ mkhan po bas gtsug lag khang mi 'grub zhus pas/ cis kyang bzhengs dang 'grub gsung*/ rje rin po che'i sku zhig kyang bzhengs/ kho bo'i sku zhig kyang bzhengs gsung*/ de nas mkhan po bas ngang rkyal lha khang bzhengs par gda'/ mkhan po slob dpon tog tse pa'i sku'i skye ba yin gsung*/ mkhan po ba la phyis mngon par shes pa mnga' bas/ nga 'bu rgyal po yin gsung ba der mi 'dug khong rang rgyal por 'dug nga 'bu blon por 'dug slob dpon da bzhugs na zhu rgyu mang po yod gsung*/ stag lung thang pa yar byon dus chab kyis gdan drangs pas 'om bu'i phung po zhig 'dug pa phyag gis bzung bas ma grongs/ de nas spyan sngar byon pa'i dus su/ 'om bu'i phung po kho bo yin gsung*/ chos rje rin po che khams nas yar byon pa'i dus su/ bde bar gshegs pa la phyag rten ja rtse mo srang dgu bcu/ zi phol zho gsum/ zab chen pho long ras yug gcig thud kyi rkyal khrig rnga 'dra ba gcig phyag gis mi bzhes pas/ de rnams spyan snga na yar bzhag stag lung ba sku thang rkyang ba gcig dang cum me bzhugs nas snang ba la/ 'o dngos grub len dgos/ khyod kyis 'di tsho tshur snur gsung*/ da dbu sngas kyi kong tse der chug gsung*/ chos rje'i thugs dgongs la chags med 'dzin med zhig re ba la/ kong tse dang yang mnga' bar 'dug snyam pa byung*/ bde bar gshegs pas ja rtse mo de shangs la zhig bsnams nas/

ja bzang che ge mos/ mang ge mos gsung nas/ brgya bcu tsam spyan sngar gral byas nas/ ja zhim po byas nas drangs/ chos kyi gsung gleng mang po mdzad/ bde bar gshegs pas ja ma gsol gong skam krog ge bzhugs pa tsug 'dug ja gsol ba dang gzi brjid che ba'am/ byin brlabs che ba bzhin/ chos rje'i thugs dgongs la mi bya ba a pho rang yin/ ngas dka' ba dang sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byas pas bla ma 'di 'dra rnyed dgongs na mos gus dung dung byung ba dang*/ 'o dge bsnyen khyod mi bya ba a pho rang yin/ ngas dka' ba dang sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byas pa/ bla ma 'di 'dra zhig rnyed snyam na/ de khyod kyi mthu min/ kho bos khyod kyi phyir dka' ba dang sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byas pa yin gsung ba dang*/ yang chos rje rin po che zhu ba zhig yod pas/ nam zla sos ka gcig zangs gcig yod pa de se ba'i me tog gis bkang nas phul ba la/ zangs gzhong 'di nga rang gi gtor snod du dgos snyam pa thugs la khrel ba byung*/ da phul la thongs snyam nas spyan sngar phyag tu phul nas/ mdang zhag mos gus la ltem rkyang zhig byung ba sing sgom gyi tshig gcig la brten nas sor chud/ da mi nyams par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhus pas/ sing sgom gyi kha la gtad pa ci yod/ se ba'i me tog de rta rgyab na phar gtor/ zangs gzhong de sgom pa rang la gtod/ gtor gzhong dgos gsung nas phyir gnang ba dang*/ ting na phar gtor/ rkyang phu ba tshul khrims rgyal gyis me 'jal du 'ongs pa la/ grum pa zhig khung rtugs su song ba gsod dgos snyam nas gsod tshis byas tsa na/ khong gi spyan sngar 'gro bas da lta gsod pa mi 'thad/ tshur lam gsod dgos snyam nas rdos rdzangs yags byas nas bzhag spyan sngar phyin nas phar 'gro tsa na/ yon bdag da ci'i srog chags de ma gsod la thongs ang gsung bas/ yon bdag skyengs nas mgyogs par song nas gtong dgos bsam tsa na kho rang yang thon ma thag tu 'dug skad/

yang tshogs na chos gsung ba'i skabs na/ dge 'dun rnams thel 'di'i shing la rung ba ma byed/ rung ba byas na kho bo'i phyag mdzub bcad pa dang khyad med gsung*/ shing 'di med na bye ma'i ri zhig tu 'gro ba la tshegs med gsung*/ rung ba gtan ma byed gsung skad/ chos rje rin po ches skam po nyag ma gcig bcag tsam na/ shing de la rlon pa zhig byung bas shing de la phar bcings nas dar thod gcig gi bzod gsol mdzad par gda'/ 'a zha ston pa yon tan dpal bya ba kho zhu sna gdong nas gsol zho len cing yod pa/ nyin gcig 'jang 'phrang na mar yongs tsa na gnyis der song bas/ ston yon gyi rtog pa la de rang yin snyam pa zhig byung*/ de nas spyan sngar phyin tsam na/ ston pa yon tan dpal gyi rjes su yi rang 'bul ba'am gsung yang dus re shig stag lung thang pa'i zhal nas/ dbu sngas kyi phyag mdzod de'i nang na/ byi ba dang sre mo gnyis lhan gcig tu tshang bcas nas snang zhus pas/ de 'dra na ni kho bo yang ci zhig yin par 'dug de 'dra na ni kho bo yang ci zhig yin par 'dug gsung nas mnyes par snang*/ ba zi rin chen 'od kyi tsha 'jal du 'ongs pa la/ khu bos dar sngo dmar kha do skur ba la/ 'di slob dpon la 'bul ba bas nga rang gi gzhu mchog la btags na snyam pa byung ba la/ spyan sngar phyin nas dar phyag tu phul ba la/ yon bdag rang gzhu mchog la thogs gsung nas phyir gnang ba dang*/ spyan sngar dmyal ras kyis bcom ldan 'das bde mchog gi mngon rtogs zhus pas/ khyod 'dod pa de 'di min nam gsung*/ dmyal ras kyis ltas pas bcom ldan 'das dngos su bzhugs nas snang*/ gzhan yang slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ nang par snga mo shar du gzigs nas/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ḥ oṃ aḥhūm̐ gsungs pa dang*/ yang nub gling du gzigs nas oṃ aḥhūm̐/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ gsung nas rgyud byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ gzhan yang rten 'brel gyi go ra chen po mdzad/

mkhan po ba spyan sngar 'gro snyam nas byon pas/ mkhan po ba'i mdun du thal ba gtor/ thal skom de rdobs/ the les thob gsung*/ de tsug byas pas mkhan po ba log nas song*/ mkhan po ba la yar byon/ rten 'brel yin byas pas/ rten 'brel rang yang mang thal ba yin/ rten 'brel rang yang mang thal ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la rten 'brel bcu gnyis las mi 'dug gsung nas yar byon pa yin 'dug yang tshogs gyes nas spyan snga nas yar byon pa zhig la/ sing sgom/ kho bo'i rdzas de kun yar phyogs shig de nas yar la su ma btang gsung*/ chos rje rin po che de na tshur byon pas/ kho yar thongs gsung*/ sing sgom na re/ kha re nas lce brgya brgya/ res ma btang res thongs/ ngas khyod kyi gces sprug 'di kun mi thub zer skad/ bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal nas/ stong gsum stong gi pha rol na// shar phyogs stong gi pha rol na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal na// kun kyang badzra he ru kaḥ sing sgom yar shog gsung nas sku 'gag gong pa nas khab cig bton nas snang*/ gzhan sgom ma thebs pa la rten 'brel spyi chos mdzad pa dang*/ bka' gdams pa ngom sgom la sgom ma skyes pa la tshogs 'di na mar la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi spyan snga 'dir/ bka' gdams ngom sgom sgom pa yin gyis la/ phyam tshe phyed tshal gyis la yar 'gro mar 'gro gyis la/ rgya ston 'jol mo bswo/ me sgom dmar mo bswo// zhugs yas dkar mo bswo// bka' gdams ngom sgom bswo/ bswo bswo bswo/ 'dre pa ta ha ri'i lha chung pa bswo gyis gsung nas/ yar 'gro mar 'gro bcol bas sgom skyes pa dang*/ ngom chung pa khyod bla ma 'di kho bo 'dra ba dang mjal nas ma chung a gsung*/ yang gcig la sgom ma skyes pa la phag mo gru skor la shog gsung*/ skor bas sgom skyes pa dang*/ yang bla ma nyag se dang rgyal 'byung gnyis bla yer 'dzoms pas/ rgyal 'byung gis bla ma nyag se la phyag mdzad/

bla ma nyag ses kyang phyag lan mdzad/ phyag mdzad zin pa dang rgyal 'byung gi thang ba'i rnel gzhi bkug nas tshig mang po la sku mnyel ba ma lags par gdugs la sku khams bde bar bzhugs sam zer skad/ nyag ses thang pa'i rnel gzhi la bkug nas/ dmigs pa sum brgya drug cu la sku mnyel ba ma lags pa sku khams bde bar bzhugs lags sam zer/ rgyal 'byung bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan sngar 'ongs nas/ dmigs pa mang pa de mi dga' lags sam zhus pas/ su na re zer gsung*/ ston rin 'di skad zer zhus pas/ ston rin kha la gtad pa ci yod/ rigs 'dzin rgad po kha la shor ba yin gsung*/ 'o na yang kho bos khyed la sgom thebs pa dka' bar byung ba yin/ dge bshes ye dil mgo pa'i gzhis kha khyed kyis phrogs nas yod par snang bas/ da 'di nas bu ram ltang tse gcig dang rtags gcig khyer la bzhud/ ye dil mgo mthong ba'i sa nas phyag byed cing bzhud/ bu ram de sgor la sgo gang gyis la/ ye dil mgo pa la drongs/ gnas gzhi de'i lde mig rtags de'i thog tu zhog la phul/ bzod gsol gyis la yar shog dang kho bos sgom gdab gsung*/ de nas sgom btab pas skyes pa lags par gda'/ yang dus shig gi tshe/ sba sgom bya ba la skran byung pas tshogs su dge 'dun gyi nang du nyal bcol bas/ btsun chung 'ga' la phar 'gong tshur 'gong bcol bas/ khyod kyi nad phan nam gsung*/ nad lta phan te de ring nga bsad zer/ kho bo'i nad phan/ bsam yas phu'i btsad po la mdze byung bas/ bde bar gshegs pa la zhus pas/ jo bo ba zhag 'ga' kho bo'i gtor g.yog gyis/ kho bo'i bzhugs khri'i zhabs su zhag 'ga' gzims dang mi sto gsungs pas/ jo bo'i sku khams dwangs pa yin par snang*/ yang tshogs grol bdo zhig la/ rtsa thu bag pa'i sngags phran mdze mgo bdo zhig byung pas/ pan ne pun ne byung nas/ bla ma rin po che nga ci tsug byed/ bla ma rin po che nga ci tsug byed zer bas/

kho bo bsgom/ kho bo bsgom da mar song gsungs pas/ khos mos gus bya mos lud pa thob pa bzhin du song nas bsgoms pas/ 'di na ni bla ma chen po de 'dug nga'i mi de gar song zer/ 'jing la yang de skad zer/ tho rangs yang de skad zer/ des kho'i mdze de sing bde/ yang gcig gi mgo na ba la spyan sngar phyin nas nga mgo na zhus pas/ mgo na ci mi sto ste/ gsham na mar rwa 'dom pa bco brgyad skye bar 'dug gsung*/ da phar song gsung*/ rwa skye ste 'ong snyam nas/ 'phongs ba mar myang ring myang thung byas/ phyi nyin spyan sngar phyin pa las/ khyod kyi mgo bde'am gsung bas/ mgo na bar myang byas nas mgo phan zin zer/ ljang phu 'di na mal ka ba can bya ba dge bshes chen po'i grub thob kyang yin pa/ khong khams cher ma bde bas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan sngar nye gnas btang bas/ nga'i khams 'di ma bde/ khyed kyis byin brlabs dang dmigs pa thugs la 'dog par zhu zhus pas/ 'o kho bo bsgoms gyis gsung*/ nye gnas kyis ya kir de skad byas pas/ de snga zhal ma mthong bas ji ltar sgom mi shes zer/ yang spyan sngar zhur phyin pas/ kho bo btsun pa sha che be re ba gcig bsgom gyis gsung*/ de nas bsgoms pas sku khams dwangs pa yin par snang*/ yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis/ bla ma rin po che nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lugs shig 'gro chos su zhu zhus pas/ kho bo la yon tan gyi rnam par thar pa bshad rgyu med/ tshe 'di yi rnam rtog skye ma myong*/ kho bo thos bsam gyi grwa sar yang thun bzhi yi rnal 'byor ni ma chag par byed pa yin gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen smrar ston 'jam dang chung po grogs kyi dpon slob yin pas/ bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas yin byas pa la/ sangs rgyas min na tha mal pa gcig sgrubs kyang*/ brtson 'grus dang 'bad rtsol byas na yon tan gyi tshogs shin tu yang yong dgos/

la la thag ring por gshegs bzhud mdzad/ 'o brgyal thang chad/ la la gzhan thams cad ro nyal byed pa'i dus su/ mtshan ring po tsog pu mdzad nas gdan gyi sog ma rnams phye mar song skad/ zhal snga nas/ kho bo bla ma zhu yas lta bu ldom bu ba zhig byed snyam pa la/ dus deng sang 'di 'dra zhig tu song gsung nas/ thugs ma rangs pa'i bka' bstsal gsungs te/ yang don gyis na sems can thams cad kyi don du sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa 'ba' zhig gis zhe bcad kyi sgrub pa rus su thon pa'i dus su/ 'dag rgyu nyon mongs pa lnga ni rang sar dag byams pa dang snying rjai byang chub kyi sems rang la 'khris med pa'i stobs ni thob/ gtong ba dang yongs su gtong ba dang*/ gtong ba chen pos 'gro ba smin par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa/ bdag dang bdag gi zhes pa dang*/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i spros pa ni chad/ rang gzhan ma lus pa thams cad rang nyid dang gnyis su med pa phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig tu rtogs pas phrag dog gi me ni zhi/ ci dang ci byas pa thams cad sgrub pa byas pa'i 'bras bus/ rang don dang gzhan don 'byung ba'i dus su/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lung bstan ni byung*/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros ni byin gyis rlob/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ sems can gyi don mi byed pa'i rang dbang med pa zhig 'ong bar bla ma dam pa dang mdo rgyud thams cad du gsungs/ rje rin po che nyid kyis kyang de ltar lags pa'i bka' mang po gsungs pa lags so// rug pa'i tsha ba zhig gsol ba zan spags kyi char song dgongs nas/ dge slong bzhi sde la bshags pa mdzad pa dang*/ rta dang phyugs ma la sogs pa thams cad la 'dzin pa mi mnga' ba la sogs pa mdor na bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ba'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa dang*/ rab tu gshegs shing mya ngan las ma 'das kyi bar du/ 'gro ba mtho dman med pa thams cad kyi khur du khur zhing*/

skyes bu dam pa thams cad bkur bas yon tan rin po che bum pa gang byo'i tshul du 'ong zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'grub par dgongs nas 'gro ba thams cad bu lta bur mdzad cing*/ dka' ba'i khur bu thams cad bsnams pa la drin brtsi ba dang lan bgrang ba med pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyis khur bu bsnams shing dka' ba dang du bzhes pas/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che lta bur rgyan du gyur pa dang*/ tshil lu btab pa'i skyo tsha yang mi gsol ba dang*/ sku 'gag rje ba'i dus ma gtogs pa sku rag 'grol ma myong ba dang*/ sku 'gag rnying pa dkrus nas gsol ba dang*/ snying nye ba'i nye gnas kyis zas nor gyi dngos po ni 'di tsam zhig yod/ so ma re gsol bar zhu zhus pas/ khyod kyis kho bo la ci yod pa mthong*/ kho bo dge 'dun gyi tshogs skyong dgos pa yin gsung*/ phun sum tshogs pa ji ltar mnga' ba thams cad kyis yod pa la phyug snon mi 'debs/ med pa ltogs grir mi gsod/ yon bdag gi snam phrag mi 'gengs/ 'bul ba la thebs lan mi mdzad/ ma bsngos par chud zos su mi gtong ba dang*/ sgom chen pa rnams la mos gus a cang yang che ste/ khyi yan chad la mos gus mthar thug pa mdzad cing*/ nye gnas dang*/ gral dpon thams cad la bla ma dam par bkur ba dang*/ spyir yang dge 'dun thams cad ni ston pa dngos dang 'dra bar mdzad cing*/ bslab pa bgres pa thams cad la phyag mdzad/ gzhon pa'i dge slong bzhi sde la phyag 'tshal/ dge 'dun bzhi sde la ni ldang ba/ chos tshig gcig yan chad gsung ba la ni bsu ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi sku 'bag la ni skad gcig kyang mi 'bral bar mdzad pa lags te/ bde bar gshegs pa mnyes pas spong dag mdzad pas/ lha bzo 'ong nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i skya ris btab pa la/ 'od zer ni tshur 'byon pa yin/ de tshe skya ris 'debs e dgos zhus pas/ ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'dis/

snyigs ma'i zhing 'di bzung ba bka' drin che ba yin/ skad cig kyang 'bral gar phod gsung bar gda'/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya mtha' dag dang ma bral bar gyis shig par bstan/ de yang thub pa chen po dang*/ yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen por chu bo thams cad 'bab pa dang*/ pad ma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba bzhin du slob ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rnams 'dus/ skyong bar mdzad pa'i tshul lugs gsol rgyu'i ngos nas/ thab chung ske chung g.yos chung la sogs pa zhim zhim po dang*/ mngar mngar po zhig kyang mi mdzad pas/ dge 'dun gyi dkyus ma ji ltar gsol ba de ka las gzhan du mi mdzad pa dang*/ grwa sar bzhugs pa'i dus su nga rgyal dang khengs pa spangs shing*/ gdol bu lta bur mdzad nas/ dman pa dang mchog gi bya ba thams cad dang du bzhes pa/ chab gdan 'dren pa dang*/ thal ba gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyi bshos lhag rung ba mdzad nas legs par gsol ba dang*/ tshan po che'i stobs rab tu brnyes pas dman pa dang*/ mchog rnams kyi khres po chen po bsnams shing gshegs pa la mngon lkog dang skyo dub med par mdzad pa dang*/ thub pa'i bstan pa thos bsam sgom gsum don du gnyer ba rnams kyis sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs nyams su ma blangs par/ jag chom po/ tshong khe skyed/ zhing rmo rko/ 'brog pa'i lug skyong bas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan mi 'byung bar dgongs nas/ bsod snyoms chen po sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par mdzad pa dang*// so nam gnas gzhi spangs pa rgyal ba'i sras// 'tsho ba bya 'tshol byed pa'i bsod snyoms pa// sa phyogs gcig tu yun ring mi bzhugs na// skyes chen de la mdun mas ci zhig bya/ yang tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor na chos gsung ba'i skabs na/ dge 'dun rnams dbyar gyi dus na ko stan re tshags gyis/ rlan gyi nad 'di 'jug par ni sla/ 'don par ni shin du dka' ba yin gsung*/

dgun gyi dus su me cha re tshags gyis/ me phar slong tshur slong gi dus su nags tshal chen po 'di la me shor na/ khyed rnams rkang lag bde ba'i legs par 'ong ste/ kho bo 'o brgyal ba yin gsung*/ dge 'dun rnams skyo bsangs la ma dga'/ khar sang gi shing phung de/ de ring yang de rang yin mod gsung ba dang*/ brtson 'grus chen po bskyed la bsgom/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di shin tu 'jigs/ ye sgom ma nus pa kun gyis kyang tsha tsha skor ba la 'bungs/ de rnams kyang ma nus na kho bo'i spyil po la rdo re rgyob gsung*/ yang khams pa 'gron po zhig gi ja rin chags pas/ kho bo'i grogs song nas kho 'gro rings pas/ rta rgyab kyi sgo la 'phred nyal byas pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i spyan sngar zhus pas/ stag lung pa khyod kyis phyags ma zhig zung la/ spyil po'i nam mkha' la gser shog gyis phyogs la/ de nas da sa gzhi 'di phyogs la e snang ltos dang gsung bas/ sa gzhi phyags nas bltas pas/ kho yi gser zho bcu gsum chags pa de ma chad ma lhag pa zhig byung bar gda'/ nye gnas kun la/ pha nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa ngo mtshar che snyam pa byung bar gda'/ yang dus re shig na/ kho bos ngam shod kyi gtsang po 'di gyen la ldog na yang nus pa yin gsung*/ yang dus re zhig 'das mchod la kho bo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid yin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po nas lung bstan nas yod gsung bas/ kho sem me 'dug pas/ khyod yod mi chos mi dgos zhu sna gdong na ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo zhig yod/ der ltos dang gsung*/ de na mi snang zer/ da rung ltos dang yod gsung*/ ltas pas mi gda' zer/ de la khyod yid mi ches mi dgos/ kho bo yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid yin/ mdo ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po 'di byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa la gtad pa yin/ kho bo dang rje sgam po ba gnyis kyang yon tan kho bo che ba yin/

skye ba snga ma la rgya gar na paṇḍi ta mi che ba gnyis su sku skye ba bzhes pa yin/ sgra zhig la rtsod pa byung bas/ bla ma rin po che'i sku'i skye ba 'di'i snga ma'i paṇḍi ta de rgyal/ der kho bos thun gcig gsan pas/ da lan 'dir slob dpon du gyur pa yin gsung*/ sras kyi thu bo stag lung pa la kho bo sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig yin gsung ba dang*/ mi bskyod rgyal po sman gyi lha yin gsung ba dang*/ yang dus re shig mkhan po rin po che dang*/ khyed rang mi chen rnams gros gyis la/ kho bo yun ring ba gcig bzhugs pa ni 'ong*/ phrin las ni chung*/ yang yun ni thung*/ phrin las ni che bar 'ong*/ de khyed rang rnams 'doms gsung*/ sus zhu nus pa ma byung*/ mkhan po ba'i zhal nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la 'phrin las ma byung na yud med gsung*/ de nas de la bzhag par snang*/ yang dus gcig u rgyan gyi rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi gsum byon pa yang kho bo yin gsung*/ ind+ra bo dhi dang po'i bla ma ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid yin/ chos ni gsang ba 'dus pa/ ind+ra bo dhi bar pa'i bla ma ni slob dpon chen po dza lan dha ra pa/ chos ni bde chen 'khor lo sdom pa/ ind+ra bo dhi tha ma'i bla ma ni/ slob dpon rta mchog chos ni dgyes mdzad kyi grub thob yin gsung*/ yang dus shig na 'ol kha'i phu 'di na/ mtsho mi che ba gcig yod/ de'i nang na pha bong zhig yod/ pha bong de la gos dkar pos bkab nas mtsho de'i nang du ltas na/ grong khyer chen po sham bha la mthong gsung*/ kho bo sbas su sku skye ba lan gsum bzhes/ bka' gdams kyi dge bshes spyan snga rin po che yang kho bo yin gsung*/ slob dpon sgom ma'i slob ma gcig rlung 'gran du byung pas/ khyod kyis kho bo'i drung du rlung thun gcig gnon dang gsungs pas/ khos rlung mnan nas mig nam mkha' la bgrad pas/ a tsi tsi a tsi tsi/ de tsug byas na mig nam mkha' la 'jur gyis 'bud/

en zhig mar phob gsung bas/ phyag rgya chen po rgyud la skyes nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma byed pa zhig byung par gda'/ bde bar gshegs pa la rgyas pa tshar phyed dang gsum byung ba la/ bde bar gshegs pa dang mkhan po ba gnyis la rgyas pa tshar gcig phul/ phyi nang mkhan po ba'i dbu sngas su bde bar gshegs pa byon nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa'i rgyas pa phyed de ci byed gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyi slob dpon gang bzhed pa gcig la 'bul ba yin mod gsung*/ bde bar gshegs pas phyag thal mo sbyar nas thugs la btags/ thugs la btags gsung nas/ sa skya pa la phul/ dol gyis gnas po ku ku ra tsas rgyas pa tshar gcig phul/ khengs po'i 'o se gyang nas 'o se'i 'bum dmar phul ba dang*/ rgyas pa tshar gnyis po de sgam po ba la phul bar gda'/ de yang mya ngan las 'da' ka'i dus su gzhan mi mthun pa'i phyogs sgrub pa rnams kyis zhal zas drangs pas/ lan gsum gyi bar du ma gsol ba yin par gda'/ pu shu kham bu khab kyis btsags nas/ shul du sman blug nas drangs pas sman yod pa thams cad logs su bzhag nas ma gsol/ nye gnas la 'di rnams dong gcig rkos la de'i nang du chug gsung*/ zhal zas 'dren mi ni slob dpon sgom pa'i lcam sring mo/ jo mo blo gros lha mo bya ba gcig dang*/ chos seng nag chung bya ba gnyis 'dus nas/ slob dpon sgom pa'i sku bsod la gnod dogs nas zhal zas drangs par snang*/ jo mo blo gros lha mo ni 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro ma yin par snang*/ chos seng nag chung ni byang shar mtshams kyi gnod sbyin mo lu bya bar 'dug khong gnyis kyi kho bo la srog gi lan chags pa yin gsung*/ phyi ma la khong gi lan chags par dgongs nas gsol bar 'dug sku lus thams cad zug gis ni gang*/ 'o brgyal ba chen pos ni 'o brgyal/ nye gnas kyis 'di 'dra ba byed phod pa/ sems can mnar med pa'i dmyal bar 'gro zhus pas/ ngan song tsam du ma song ba ni kho bo'i gnyer yin gsung*/

khyod kyis dge slong bzhi sde la kho bo'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i kaṃ ka ni'i gzungs chog gyis/ kho bo'i sdig pa dag pas kho bo sku khams bzang du 'gro ba yin gsung*/ de nas nye gnas kyis sngags rnon po shin tu zab pa mang po nyams su myong pas grub pa yod pas byed par zhu zhus pas/ khyod kyi de ngo mtshar che ba gcig 'dug gyis dang gsung pas/ sngags 'di nan tar grang ba che bas/ chang gi nying khu gsol zhal gang tsam zhig dgos zhus pas/ a tsi tsi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni re 'jigs/ mngal gyi dri ma ni ya nga*/ gsung nas skyes rabs de gsung bar gda'/ chang gsol zhal gang dang sku srog bsdos pa lags par gda'/ srog gi phyir yang chang ni btung du mi btub pa yin te/ las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ni shin tu ya nga la shin tu 'jigs su rung ba yin te/ de yang sngon 'das pa'i dus na dge slong dge ba'i blo gros chos kyi dpal bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' grub pa thob pa/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po dang ldan pas spre'u mang po zhig gis ratna tsa ra'i mchod rten na'ang mi rigs pa byed pa mthong bas/ 'di rnams gang du skye dgongs pa la/ thams cad mnar med pa'i dmyal ba chen por 'gro bar gzigs nas/ gnas der spre'u lus su bsams bzhin du srid pa nye bar blangs nas ngag tu ni chos ma bshad/ byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag nas mchod rten la skor ba byas pas spre'u rnams ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par gyur te 'pho ba mdzad dgongs pa la/ spre'u gnyis chags pa spyod pa mthong ba las/ dud 'gro rten ngan pas thig le nyams pa byung*/ nyes pa'i rgyus mngal gyi skye gnas su skyes nas rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams ni shor/ mngon par shes pa ni brjed pa la sogs pa/ nyes pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'byung bar gsungs te/ dus gzhan gyi tshe yang*/ e ma las kyi rnam par smin pa ni re 'jigs/

mngal gyi dri ma 'di nyes pa re che/ gsung ba lags/ bdag nyid chen po des chang 'thung ba'i skyon gzigs shing*/ ma 'thungs pa'i yon tan khong du chud pas/ rjes su 'jug pa'i slob pa rang bas gces par gyur pa rnams la chang ma 'thung zhig ces snying por gyur pa zhig gdams ngag tu gnang*/ phyin ci ma log pa'i skyes rabs dang bcas pa gsungs pas/ chang 'thung bar mi bya'o// dus gsum mngon du gyur pa dpal ldan chos kyi rjes// rgyu dang 'bras bu shin tu phra ba'i phra ba rnams// 'di las 'di byung shin tu chud pa'i phyir// 'gro ba bur gyur rnams dang bu slob rjes 'jug la// brtse chen des ni rang bas gces par gzigs pa'i phyir// rgyu dang 'bras bu zab pa'i gnad 'di snying por gsungs// chags sdang nyes pa'i rtsa ba sha dang chang rnams kun// rang nyid mi bzhes gzhan la gnang bar mi 'gyur ba// dus gsum mkhyen pa rgyal ba'i gsung rnams dpang mdzad nas// nyid kyi mngon tu gyur pa gces pa'i bu la gdams// gnad 'di so sor thar dang byang sems gsang sngags kyi// dam tshig ji bzhin srung bas gsang sngags yon tan rnams// bum pa gang byo'i tshul tu thugs la bzhag nas ni// thugs kyi snying po chongs shig rjes 'jug slob ma rnams// chags pa spyod pa'i sbyor thabs sum brgya drug cu dang*// rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad rnams zab pa ma yin te// de rnams 'od gsal dbyings su ldan na thub pa'i chos// rgyal bas gsang sngags zab pa'i gnad du gsungs// gzhan du mu stegs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sgrub rtags su// yang dang yang du nan tan chen pos bka' stsal gsungs// 'o na med de de rnams shin tu lags na'ang*/ khyod nyid de ltar mi byed pa ci ste zhe na/ de ni shin tu yang mad de/ bdag nyid chen po'i rnam par thar pa mtha' dag ni/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis kyang sgrub par mi nus mod kyi/ phyogs re tsam gyi rnam par thar pa la ma gnas na ni/

byi po dbyug pa thogs pas kyang mi tshe phyed par mi 'gyur bas/ bdag kyang phyogs 'ga' zhig la zhugs pa lags te/ zla stod dang zla smad dang snga dro phyi 'phred la sogs pa sgrub par nus tshad kyis/ de snga yang 'bad cing*/ da lta yang 'bad pa lags/ rang dbang med par 'ga' zhig byung ba ni/ nyes par ma mthong zhing*/ tshod yod du bgyis pa ma lags te/ rje rin po che yab sras dang bcas pa/ phyogs ris dang bcas thams cad la bshags pa lags/ rjes su 'jug cing phan pa dang bde bar 'dod pa rnams kyis/ bla ma rin po che de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa la bslab par bya'o// da ji ltar nyi ma shar nub bzhin// rigs 'di gtso bor smra ba yin// 'jig rten pa rnams rigs gtsor byed// rgyal po bram ze rta dang glang*// de las de nyid ji bzhin no// 'jig rten mgon po thub pa yi// sras rnams de yi rigs las skyes// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar rnams// gang zhig 'dzin par mi byed na// rgyal ba'i sras su ji ltar 'gyur// gzhan gyi brtul zhugs tha dad rnams// rigs nyid gtso bor mi smra zhing*// thub pa chen po'i rjes 'jug pas// thub pa'i sras su gyur pa yi// mgon po bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// mi slob rjes su mi 'breng na// de yi sku gsung thugs nyid dang*// dbyer med gcig tu ji ltar 'gyur// skyes chen mnyes par bya ba'i phyir// rnam thar phyogs gcig tsam spyad kyang*// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rnams// rnam thar de yi rjes 'brangs nas// chos kyi sku la sa bon btab// chos kyi sku dang mnyam par 'gyur// gzugs sku gnyis dang mnyam par 'gyur// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// mnyam med bla ma rin chen dang*// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa'i phyir// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// nan tan chen pos bslab par bya// de ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// ngar snabs la yang 'od 'byung ltar// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// yon tan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis// ngar snabs 'dra ba bdag kyang 'tsher// ngar snabs bzang po ma yin te// 'tsher ba'i 'od la blo gtad med// skyob mdzad mgon po rin po che// sangs rgyas 'od la thug pa med// dpag med gyur pa bsam yas kyang*// bdag cag tshu rol mthong ba'i ngor// mthun par snang ba'i rnam par thar// skye dang rnam par rol pa dang*// yon tan mnyes dang sgrub pa dang*// nags khrod bsten cing tshogs skyong dang*// stong nyid 'brug gi sgra sgrogs pas// seng ge'i rgyal po'i sras rnams la// ji snyed mkhyen pa rgyal ba'i chos// rgyu 'bras zhal chems bzhag pa rnams// bdag cag rjes su 'jug pa dang*/

khams gsum sems can thams cad la// zab pa'i gnad du bdag gis go// rang sems phyag rgya chen po de// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rgyal po yin// dngos med rnam rtog sna tshogs de// rgyal po de yi blon po yin// mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// byang chub mchog la 'god pa de// rgyal po de yi rgyal khrims yin// stong nyid rtogs na ci phyir na// rten 'brel nyid las gzhan pa yi// stong nyid ston pas ma gsungs shing*// rin chen nyid kyang mi gsung la// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i ston pa yang*// rgyur du btub par ma go bas// gsung la nan tan bya ba dang*// rnam par thar pa'i rjes su slob// bcu bdun nyin par tshogs su byon// don dam byang sems rin chen ni// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'dra// kun rdzob byang chub sems de ni/ rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dang 'dra gsung nas chos zab pa'o gsung*/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'i snga dro nyi shar la/ chos skad btang nas tshogs su byon/ de snga kho bos khyed rnams la 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa yin byas/ da nang kho bo rang la byung*/ kho bo zhal mthong ba rnams ngan song du mi 'gro/ phu 'di na yod pa'i bya byi 'bu yan chad shar phyogs rdul bral du kho bos rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa yin/ kho bos khyed rnams la chos zab pa zhig yod pa bya snyam pa/ sku khams kyis ma bskyod/ khyed rnams dge sbyor la 'bungs gsung*/ sang dge 'dun gyi rtsa khral de skyol/ da yar khyog gsung nas mya ngan las 'das par snang*/ sku cung ma bzhud pa'i dus na kho bo la sun ma byung*/ mchod pa shoms/ chos skyong gi gtor ma chen po gyis/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa dang*/ yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grogs dang bcas pa byon zhes gsung*/ chos skyong srung ma ma lus byon/ mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas mchod pa'i bkod pa dpag tu med pa thogs nas byon/

gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// bla re phye ma'i phur ma dang*// rnga dang rdza rnga rnga bran dang*// dung dang cha lang sil snyan rnams/ phyogs rnams kun nas mchod pa ma lus 'bul ba byung*/ de skad gsung nas chos kyi dbyings su gshegs// sku gdung tshogs su gdan drang nas// chos gsung khri la zhag gcig bzhugs// mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab phul// nyi shu bdun gyi snga dro la// gdung bzhu mchod pa'i bkod pa bshams// dge 'dun rnams la mthong snang du// sgra dang 'od dang sil snyan dang*// dud pa 'jar ni 'khrig pa dang*// me tog sngon po'i char 'bab dang*// ri dwags rnams kyang phyogs nas 'dud// bya rnams mkha' la sgra snyan sgrog /ye shes mkha' 'gros nam mkha' gang*// 'jig rten mkha' 'gros gdung dbyangs len// mthong snang bsam gyis mi khyab 'byung*/ dge bshes shel 'dul la sogs pa/ khong mang ba zhig gis spur khang kha la skor ba byas/ spur khang gi phyogs bzhi na mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ mchod pa'i rgyab na dpa' bo rgyan dang cha lugs shin du bzang ba bzhis mchod pa 'bul ba mthong*/ spur khang gi phyogs bzhi na rgyal ba rigs bzhi bzhugs nas snang*/ spur khang gi steng na shel gyi mchod rten zhig snang*/ de'i steng na rnam par snang mdzad kun tu zhal gcig bzhugs nas snang*/ shel 'dul gyis dbu mdzad khong mang pa zhig mthong*/ bu slob rnams kyi mchod gnas/ sku gdung ring srel rgyas par byon/ thugs ni byi ru'i mdog ltar byon/ ljags srab zangs kyi mdog 'dra ba// nye gnas chen po'i phyag tu byon// gdung la mchod pa zla gcig phul// che ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho ltar yangs shing*// yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas bshes gnyen gyis// thub pa'i gsung bzhin bla ma rab mnyes nas// bdag gis rnam thar cung zhig yi ger bris/ chos rje rin po che la/ dge bshes skyo skyam pas/ chos rje rin po che nyid kyi rnam par thar pa gcig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/

chos rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ nga 'bu'i rnam par thar pas dgos pa ci yod/ rje phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar zhig bya gsung nas/ rnam par thar pa 'di mdzad pa yin// dri med rnam dag rin chen 'di bris pas// mdzub mos zla ba mtshon pa ji bzhin du// kun tu bzang po bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med gcig tu shog /bdag cag dman pa'i gdul bya 'ga' zhig la/ tshu rol mthong snang gi rnam par thar pa cung zad bris pa/ nyams len mi zad pa rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba/ rgyal ba rin chen thog rdugs pas/ tshogs dang lkog tu gsungs pa la// bdag gis cung zad nan tan byas// rje rin chen de yi thugs kyi sras/ bsags pa'i rgyab can skal bar ldan/ kha ldo rin chen gzhon nu yis/ khyed kyis yi ger bkod dgos gsung*// thos nas yun ring song ba des// 'ong ngam mi 'ong snyam pa la// khong gis yang yang drag tu skul/ khong gi gdong ni ma ldog pas// bdag gis yi ger bkod pa la// 'khrul par gyur pa ci yod pa// bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol// dpe 'di bris pa'i dge ba gang*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog rje phag mo gru pa'i rnam par thar pa rdzogs so// // 805) ༄// tshogs chos chen mo rin chen 'brug sgra// oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba'i sman ljongs brtse bas rab brlan dri med ting 'dzin rtsa ba can// tshul khrims 'dab mdzes rtogs pa'i 'od 'bar legs spyad char gyis mngon rgyas shing*// 'jig tshogs nad sel skye dgu'i yid 'dren phyogs bcur snyan pa'i sgra de gsung*// srid na rab dkon bstan pa'i mnga' bdag u dum wa ra rgyal gyur cig

/phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras thub mgon spyan snga dang*// de gsung man ngag bum pa bzang lta bu// nyid kyi rjes 'jug tshogs mchog dpag med bcas// skyabs mchog khyad par gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa'i yon tan rnams mngon du byed pa la/ sems nang du ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu gnas dgos/ de la mthun pa'i rkyen gnas phun sum tshogs pa la brten pas phyi'i rkyen gyis mi g.yeng bas nang du ting nge 'dzin la rtsai gcig tu gnas pa yin/ des na rnal 'byor pa dgon pa dben pa chu shing dang 'tsho ba mod pa/ nyin mo skye bo'i rgyu 'grul med pa/ mtshan mo dgras glags 'tshol dang 'jigs pa med par/ rtse gcig tu bsgom pa yin te/ rnal 'byor pa tha ma'i gnas yin/ de lta bur zhag brgya bsgom pa bas/ ri khrod dben pa grong dang thag ring ba'am/ ri'i rtse 'am chu'i mdo 'am/ phug gam lung stong la sogs par zhag gcig bsgoms pa stobs che/ yang der zhag brgya bsgoms pa bas nags khrod du zhag gcig bsgoms pa stobs che ste/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas kyang*/ nags na ri dwags bya dang shing rnams mi snyan brjod mi byed/ zhes gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas kyang*/ nags khrod dben pa stes dbang gis// 'phrad cing rang dbang brten mdzad gsol// zhes gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor pa 'bring gi gnas yin mod/ yang de nyid du zhag brgya bsgoms pa bas rje btsun chen po mi la ltar/ gangs khrod ci yang med par zhag gcig bsgoms pa khyad par du 'phags/ de lta bur zhag brgya bsgoms pa bas u rgyan la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams sam gzhan yang dur khrod la sogs pa 'jigs su rung ba mi ma yin pa ce spyang dang ro gsar rnying la sogs pa mang po yod pa'i gnas rnams su/

dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlob pa mi rtog pa skye ba'i gnas yin pas zhag gcig bsgoms pa stobs sam yon tan shin tu che ste/ rnal 'byor pa rab kyi gnas yin/ mdor na gnas phun sum tshogs pa de rnams su/ dbang po lnga yul lnga la ma 'phros par nang du ting nge 'dzin la ma yengs par bsgom dgos pa yin/ de yang 'di ltar du bskyed pa'i rim pa yi dam gyi lha'am/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa mtshan ma dang bcas pa'am/ mtshan ma med pa'i bye brag mang po 'phrug shar gyi song na mnyam hrug ge ba la res 'ga' gang la mnyam par bzhag res gang la mnyam par ma gzhag pas ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan mi 'byung*/ 'o na gang bsgom snyam na/ rin po che'i thugs kyi gdams ngag chos kyi rje'i thugs dgongs phyin ci ma log pa lnga ldan rin po che bsgom pa lags te/ gzhan nyams su blang bya rnams lto 'grangs ba'i bya na dang 'dra ste/ rtag tu nyams su blang bya ma lags pas/ chos lnga po la rgyun du mnyam par gzhag des dbang po yul la mi 'phro mi 'dzin cing nyon mongs pa dug gsum rgyun bcad nas yon tan skye ba lags mod/ de ltar ma gyur par yul la phyir dbang po 'phros pas nyes pa mtha' dag 'byung ste mig gi dbang pos gzugs la phyir bltas pas/ sdug pa la chags pa'i sems skye/ sems de'i las kyi 'bras bus yi dwags su skyes shing bkres bskom la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ mi sdug pa la zhe sdang gi sems skye/ sems de'i las kyi 'bras bus dmyal bar skye zhing btso bsreg la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ bar pa la nyon mongs pa gti mug gi sems skye/ sems de'i las kyi 'bras bus dud 'gro bkol spyod la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa nyams su myong ba ma gtogs pa phyir bltas pas chen po zhig mthong rgyu ga la yod/

de bzhin du rna ba'i dbang po sgra la 'phros pas/ bstod pa la chags/ smod pa la sdang*/ bar pa la ni gti mug pa'i sems skye zhing*/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi las bsog sna'i dbang pos dri dang*/ lce'i dbang po ro dang*/ lus kyi dbang po reg bya dang*/ yid kyi dbang po yul du chos la sogs pa thams cad tshul de kho na ltar mchi/ de ltar yang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// de'i phyir dbang po lnga nang du ldog nas byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag na/ rlung rang shugs su ldog cing byang chub kyi sems stobs su cag gis 'gyur zhing*/ de dbang po lnga dag pas/ mngon shes lnga chu dwangs pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar 'char te/ de yang lha'i mig rnam par dag pas 'di nas nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid 'khor dang bcas pa mthong bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du lha'i rna ba rnam par dag pas bde ba can legs pa'i zhing gang dag pa rnams su sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la sogs pas chos gsung ba rnams mngon gsum ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du lha'i sna dang lce dang lus dang yid kyis 'jig rten na dri zhim pa dang*/ ro mngar ba dang*/ reg bya 'jam pa yid kyi bde ba la sogs pa thams cad la dbang byed par 'gyur/ mdor na yon tan gyi tshogs ji snyed yod pa de rnams nang du nyon mongs pa dug gsum dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa las 'byung ba lags mod/ de ltar yang*/ ma chags ma sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i phyir na rlung sems nang du gnas pa gces te/ phyir 'phros na nad mang ba dang tshe thung ba dang*/ kha mi phyed pa la sogs pa'i nyes skyon thams cad mun rub pa bzhin du 'byung bas na bhu su ku'i rnam par thar pas gzhan gyi ngo srung ba la sogs pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba thams cad rbad kyis bcad nas/

rang sems srung dgos/ de ltar yang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ sems srung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa// brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya// zhes gsung*/ khong gi sku 'bag 'bri ba yang zhal phar la bstan pa 'bri bar 'dug gsung yang 'ga' zhig gi rnam par rtog pa la/ kha bsag dang ngo dga' la sogs pas gzhan gyi sems ma bsrungs na rnyed pa dang bkur bsti la sogs pa bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen mi 'byung snyam na nang du sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la ma yengs par bya zhing 'phags pa ka ta ya na bzhin ting nge 'dzin las ma g.yos na/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dper na 'bras dkar mo lo legs na phub sog zhor la 'byung ba ltar 'ongs te/ de ma yin pa'i sems kyis 'dod kyang mi 'byung ste/ de ltar yang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pas brnabs sems yid la re ba 'joms// zhes gsungs/ de yang sngon yul 'phags rgyal zhes bya'i mtha' 'khob cig na/ sdig spyod kyi rgyal po gtum po rab snang zhes bya ba 'khor mang po dang bcas pa zhig yod pa 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas 'phags pa ka ta ya na la/ mtha' khob kyi rgyal po gtum po rab snang la sems srung ste/ der 'phags pas byon pa dang rgyal po dang 'phags pa gnyis kyi khri bshams nas skye bo'i tshogs mang po 'dus te/ glu gar dang rol mo mang po byas te rgyal po dgyes par byas te dgyes pa dang*/ rgyal pos 'phags pa la glu snyan nam gar legs sam zhus pas/ 'phags pas ngas ma mthong gang mthong ba dang thos pa de la'o gsungs pas/ 'o na khyod la mig dang sna ba med dam zer ba la/ rgyal po yid ches par bya ba'i phyir/ 'phags pas rgyal po la khyod kyi yul na chad pa phog pa'i mi dag yod dam dris pas yod zer te khrid nas byung bas/ lag tu til mar skyogs gang bskur/ gshed ma ral gri thogs pas bskor nas 'di grong khyer la skor ba'i tshe thigs pa gcig bo na gshed mas ske bag nas mgo thang la lhung bar 'gyur zhes bsgo nas lam du glu gar la sogs pa gyis shig gsungs/

de ltar byas te khyod kyis mthong ngam byas pas ngas ma mthong gang mthong ba'am thos pa de la 'o zer bas/ 'phags pas rgyal po la/ mi 'di nyid tshe 'di'i srog srung ba'i ched du yang ma mthong na/ bdag kyang byang chub kyi srog srung ba'i ched du glu gar ga la mthong gsungs pas/ rgyal po dad nas dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa dar bar gyur pa lta bu lags/ des na ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag cing lha mo brgyas gar byas/ srin mo brgyas bro brdungs yang mtshar ba dang 'jigs pa med par glang po smyon pa byung yang lam mi 'dzur/ rgyal po byung yang bsnyun mi 'dri bar nyams su blang zhing long ba glang gzhug lta bu 'di ma shor bar bya/ skyes bu rnams yun ring mo zhig mi 'gor bar sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i grub thob tu 'gyur te/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po ltar 'gyur gsung*/ de ltar yang rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ snying nas rtsa ba chod gyur cing*// ro gcig ngang la 'byams gyur na// dpal gyi ri la dar chen 'phyar// dgos dgu mi 'dod bzhin du 'byung*// de dbang med kyi rgyu 'bras ma lags sam// zhes gsungs so// mdor na 'jig rten 'dis kun nas blang ba'i bya ba thams cad slog rdul bzhin khengs kyis bor nas/ nang du ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar byed na/ sems kyis lus byin gyis brlob ste lus kyi mdze nad dang sha kra la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag nas dag pa'i lus thob/ lus kyis snang ba byin gyis brlob ste/ sems can thams cad smin par byed cing*/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi skyabs gnas su 'gyur/ de ltar yang rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ nang gtum mo ye shes me 'bar bas// phyi lus ngag spyod pa'i du ba bton// ces gsungs pa lags pas/ khyed rnams kyis de ltar thugs la bzhag par zhu gsungs//

//yang rje rin po che'i zhal nas tshe gcig gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar byed pa la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa bsten dgos pa yin/ de yang 'jig rten 'di'i bzo'i rig byed la sogs pa la yang slob dpon mkhas pa 'tshol dgos na/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes don du gnyer ba la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ltar sdud pa las/ slob ma bzang po bla ma gus ldan de dag gis// bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya// ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung*// bgyi ba la sogs pa gsung*/ de ma yin pa gang rung rung la bsten kyang yon tan skyed mi nus te/ dper na skos phor la ri mo med na/ tsha tsha la ri mo mi 'byung ba dang 'dra/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ gnyug ma'i drod tshod mi shes par// skal ldan gyi mgo skor ma byed cig /gsungs pas bla ma tshul khrims dang ldan pa la bsten 'tshal/ mtshan nyid kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab nas dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas shes rab chen po'i sgo nas gzhan gyi lam sna 'khrid nus pa dang*/ snying rje chen po'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi khur khur bar nus pa dang*/ rang tshe 'di la ltos ba spu'i rtse mo tsam yang med pa dang gsum po 'dir 'dus gsung*/ de la shes rab chen po'i sgo nas gzhan gyi lam sna 'khrid pa la bla ma des kyang slob ma'i sems mi gnas pa gnas pa dang*/ gnas pa brtan pa dang*/ brtan pa gong nas gong du bogs 'don cing bdud mi 'jug par byed pa dang*/ zhugs nas bzlog pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ blo sna bsgyur zhing rgyud byin gyis brlob pa dgos gsung*/ de la dang po sems mi gnas pa gnas par byed pa la/ slob ma'i khams dang bag la nyal shes pa/ so so'i las 'phro dang mthun pa'i gdams ngag dang rjes su mthun pa shes dgos/ de la yang bla ma rab 'bring rnam pa gsum du shes dgos/

rab mnyam par ma bzhag kyang gzhan gyi rgyud ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa sangs rgyas lta bu yon tan/ de yang sngon ded dpon stobs ldan gyi bu legs 'ongs zhes bya ba bsod nams shin tu chung ba zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar rab tu byung ba la/ skye ba snga ma la zad pa sngon po la goms par mkhyen nas/ rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i ldum ra nas utpa la sngon po longs la dge 'dun gyi gral du brims shig gsung ste brims pa dang*/ utpal mig la phan pas bsnam par bya'o gsung*/ thams cad kyis sngo zing kyis bsnams pas/ legs 'ongs kyis sngon gyi tshe snga ma sngon po la goms pa'i rgyu des lhan gcig byed pa'i rkyen sngon po des sad nas ting nge 'dzin thob nas dgra bcom thob skad/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod la chu srin byin pa gsod kyi klu a 'bras chu ngos thul cig gsung nas 'phags pas grong khyer du bsod snyoms la byon nas mthar gnas pa'i chu mig steng du gro stabs pa dang*/ de klu khros nas nam mkha' nas mtshon cha'i char phab pas/ yang 'phags pas me'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas khong kun nas me'i phung po rab tu 'bar bar mthong nas bred de 'phags pa nyid la skyabs su song ba dang*/ 'phags pas klu rnams la dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab pa'i gzhi rnams phog nas/ khong srog chags chu dur mdzad nas lhung bzed du bcug ste de bzhin gshegs pa la phul ba dang*/ dge slong rnams zad pa me'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa legs 'ongs yin gsungs pa lta bu dang*/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dge slong seng ge zhes bya bas bsgoms kyang sems gnas su ma btub pas/ de'i bag chags sad par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kho bsod snyoms la song ba'i dus su kun dga' bo la bsngags nas/ khong gi brang khang la gad dar gyis spos chus chag chag thob/

me tog sil ma khrom/ dar gyi lda ldi bris/ seṅge'i khri shoms shig gsung nas/ de ltar byas pa dang*/ de nas kho log byung ba dang*/ nga'i khang par su phyin pa yin zer/ kun dga' bo phyin byas pas/ 'dis mi bslu snyam nas dge slong seṅge'i khri la bsdad pas sngar gyi bag chags sad nas sems gnas pa byung ste de la brten nas bsgoms pas/ dgra bcom pa thob pa lta bu dang*/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong la la dag la/ tshe snga ma la dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po la sogs pa gang la goms pa gnas kyis lhung bzed kyi kha skor ba dkar po dang dmar po la sogs pa byugs nas de la dmigs pas skad gcig gis sems gnas pa grub pa yin/ de'i thog nas khrid pas 'bras bu myur du thob pa'i gtam rgyud mtha' med pa zhig gsungs te skyes bu rnams de ci la gleng blangs na/ slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mtha' med du bskyed pa la mnyam par ma bzhag kyang sa le mkhyen pa sangs rgyas lta bu yin gsung*/ bla ma 'bring gis mnyam par bzhag na slob ma la sogs pa'i khams rgyud la sogs pa mkhyen cing*/ ma bzhag na mi shes pas mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas tshe snga ma'i las 'phro dang*/ tshe 'di goms pa'i thog nas khrid shes dgos te/ de gang lta bu snyam na/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub de sngon shing 'thu yin pas de'i goms pa'i bag chags la brten nas 'khrid pa'i phyir/ slob dpon 'phags pas mgo la shing skye ba bsgom du bcug pas/ rtse gcig pa'i sems thob ste/ phug nas phyir 'ong ma shes pa la/ da khyed rang gis shing de sog les bcad par soms la phyir shog gsungs pas/ phyir thon shes shing*/ de nyid la brten nas bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa lta bu yin/ de yang shing la rtse gcig pa thob pa de rtog pa gzhan gyis stong pas zhi gnas/ de'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa dang lhag mthong*/ de ltar yang sems zhi ba de zhi gnas te/

chos shes pa de lhag mthong ngo*// bgyi ba gsung*/ de yang 'dzam bu gling pa thams cad kyi mdun du nyin mtshan dus drug tu byon nas 'o dod 'bod cing byin gyis brlob kyang las ngan gyi ma mthong ba yin/ sngon ra sgreng pha wong thang du dge ba'i bshes spyan mnga' ba dang zhal mjal gsung*/ gzhan yang 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bu la bram ze'i khye'u gnyis kyi rab tu byung ste/ gcig rus pa dkar po la sems 'dzin du bcug gcig gis rlung 'gram du bcug pas dbyar zla ba gsum du sems ma gnas pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shā ri'i bu la gtad de/ khong gi mnyam par bzhag nas bltas pas/ mkhyen nas go ldog ste bsgom du bcug pas dgra bcom pa thob pa lta bu dang*/ yang sga rgyal ba'i skye ba snga ma'i yi dam lha mo skul byed ma yin pas/ byis pa'i dus su gzungs ma bslabs par blo la byung*/ nus pa yang che ba la de'i dus na ra 'tsho zhing*/ gzungs klog pa'i tshe snga gro gdugs chung zhig spyi bo nas thon nas cher 'phel phyi gro chung du song nas spyi bor thim pa zhig byung skad/ slob dpon zhig la zhus pas 'dre yin zer nas 'phro bcad/ de nas dbus su byon te/ gtsang na gu ru lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bya ba bzhugs zer ba thos nas byon pa la/ lo tsā ba'i zhal nas kyang sang 'dir las can zhig 'ong bar 'dug pas de nga'i rtsar thongs shig gsung ste/ der kho dang mjal bas skul byed ma'i sku la mdzub mo btsugs nas 'di khyod kyi skye ba snga ma'i yi dam yin/ khyod sdig pa'i grogs pos bslus pa yin/ gsungs pas sku la 'khyud nas shums skad/ der khong gis ngo sprad nas bsgoms pas grub thob chen po zhig byung skad/ skyes bu rnams khong gi tshe snga ma'i yi dam skul byed ma yin pa la/ lo tsā bas 'jam dpal lta bu zhig sgom du bcug na grub thob mi 'byung ste/ lar na so so'i rigs shes dgos/

rigs gang la dad pa de'i las 'phro can yin/ rje rin po che'i zhal na/ so so'i rigs rnams dus su ngo sprod mdzad// ces pa dang*/ gzhan du 'dun pa sgyur na phrag dog can de phung du bcug /gsungs pas/ khyed rnams kyang gzhan gyi 'dun pa ma bsgyur bar so so gang la dad pa'i bla ma'am yi dam de skye ba snga ma'i 'brel pa can yin/ de ltar yang dgyes rdor las/ rnal 'byor pa gang nag po che// de yi lha ni mi bskyod pa// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pas na/ bla ma tha mas kyang bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs zhugs shing*/ rang gi nyams myong la phrigs tshud pa'i sgo nas khrid dgos pa yin/ de ma lags pa'i ra zam rtsa la 'gro ba'i lugs kyi khrid breng breng des yon tan skyed mi nus te/ shar du 'gro ba la byang du lam bstan pa 'dra/ de ltar yang dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ nyams myong med pa'i sgom khrid de// rgyus med lam mkhan byed pa yin// zhes pa la sogs pa gsung*/ khong la zhang po rgyas zhus pa la/ sgom chen pa'i bstan pa dma' ba'i dus nam yin zhus pas/ slob dpon myong ba med pas slob ma mos gus med pa la khrid byed pa'i dus 'byung*/ de rtsa na nyams dmas pa yin gsung skad/ mdor na sgom ro gcig gi rtogs pa med par slob ma la khrid byed pa bas/ mda' gzhu thogs nas lings byed pa drag gsung*/ des na skyes bu rnams khyed rang rnams kyang slob dpon ma snga/ dud 'gro kun kyang skye ma ran yar skyes na sna ba 'byar ba dang*/ sgyid pa byol ba la sogs pa 'byung bar gda'/ de rnams kyis sems gnas par byed pa'i thabs bgyi ba lags/ 'o na bla ma gong ma gnyis ma gtogs pa la mngon par shes pa ni med/ slob ma'i khams dang bag la nyal ji ltar shes snyam na/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rjes su 'brangs pa yin/ de gang yin gang la zer snyam na/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rnams lags mod/ de'i rjes su 'brangs pas phyin ci ma log par shes nas 'ong gsung*/

gnyis pa gnas pa brtan par byed pa ni/ ri khrod la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su spyod lam rnam pa bzhis chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi tshul du nyams su blang 'tshal lags/ gsum pa brtan pa bogs 'don par byed pa ni/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs yul rkyen sna tshogs dang bsres nas ro snyom zhing bsgom pa yin/ de yang bdud mi 'jug par byed pa ni/ spyir na bdud bgyi ba de nang du rang la dug lnga skyes na nyon mongs pa'i bdud yin/ de yod pas padma'i 'tsho la ngang pa 'du ba ltar gdon gsum po bos pa ltar 'du ba de lha'i bu'i bdud yin/ de rnams kyang 'byung ba bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po la zhugs nas/ rlung 'khris bad kan gsum gyi nad bskyed pa de phung po'i bdud yin/ des srog chad par byed pa de 'chi bdag gi bdud yin te/ de rnams mi 'jug par byed pa la/ nang du nyon mongs pa dug gsum med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la sems gnad du bsnun nas/ bdud 'jug pa med na/ dper na thab kyi me bsad na/ skar khung gi du ba mi 'byung dang 'dra gsung*/ bdud zhom pa bzlog pa ni/ spyir na bar chad kyi dngos po gang yin yang*/ nang du rang gi bsam pa 'khrul ba ma gtogs pa phyi rol na bdud bya ba dngos por grub pa yod ma myong pas na/ rnam rtog ma zad kyi bar du bdud mi zad/ rlung phugs nas langs nas phyi sgo sgo gtan gyis mi tshog mtsho la me shor na bsod pa'i chu mi rnyed pas bdud kyi rgyu ci zad/ mdor na rang la rang gis bar chad ma byas na phyi'i bar chod kyis mi tshugs te/ rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ rang sems bdud du ma shes na// phyi rol gyi bdud de rnam rtog yin// rnam rtog chos sku shes lags na// bdud cho 'phrul rnal 'byor rgyan du che// gsung*// de ltar yang 'phags pa sdud pa las/ go cha chen po bgos shing bdud kyi rgyu 'dul ba// de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes rab tu brjod// bgyi ba gsung*/

gzhan dag kha cig lam nyams su len pa la bar chad byung na spang byar byed/ de ma go ba yin/ skyon lam gyi grogs yin/ skyon de nyid kyi thog tu gnad du bsnun pas skyon thams cad dag cing rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yon tan thams cad dpe med cing 'gran zla dang bral bar rdzogs nas mchi/ gnyis pa snying rje chen po'i sgo nas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gyi khur 'khur ba ni/ snying rje gsum dang ldan pa yin te/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang gsum mo// snying rje de'i sgo nas/ sdug bsngal gyi khur 'khur ba la/ khur mkhan dgos/ de yang bdag pas gzhan gces kyi bsam pa byang chub sems yin te/ de med na re ltos can du 'gro bas/ phan btags pa la drin brtsi/ bzang po la zhwa bkon ngan pa la lham 'phrog pa'i tshul de lta bus ga la mchi/ snying rje phal cher der 'gro dogs yod/ rang 'dod phugs su bcug pa'i snying rjer 'gro/ gnod pa skyel ba yin gsung*/ chos rje'i zhal nas rje phag mo gru pa bzhugs pa'i dus su slong ba byung ba la sogs pa la yang zhig po mi mdzad par/ yul de'i nyon mongs pa'i rgyur 'gro'am mi 'gro phan thogs sam mi thogs brtags nas 'tshams po la 'tshams po/ rgyal po la dkar yol/ sprang po la pha phabs kyi tshul du sbyor bar 'dug gsung*/ de la 'brongs pas a tsa ra la gser byin pa'am dge ba'i bshes gnyen snang ba bas sprang po la ba men gnyis byin pa'i gtam rgyud lta bur 'gro ba lags/ yang mdo sde skye rabs nas kyang*/ snying rje ltos pa dang bcas pas sbyin pa gtang na bu lon chags su bcug nas 'dug gsung*/ skyes bu rnams sbyin pa gtong ba la dus shes dgos gsung*/ de ltar yang sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ phan dang bde ba rnams byas te/ bde yang mi phan mi bya'o// sdug bsngal yin yang gang phan bya// gsung*/ gsum pa tshe 'di la ltos pa spu'i rtse mo tsam yang med pa ni/

'jig rten 'di'i bsam pa dang rnyed pa dang*/ bkur sti che thabs dang bzang thabs 'dod na/ bla mar mi 'gro zhing 'jig rten 'di pa rang yin mod/ chos rje'i zhal nas dge bshes a gshed kha cig rang chos brgyad bsgrub pa'i snyad chos la bkal nas/ slob ma sdug pa rnams log pa'i lam la 'god par 'dug slob ma blo sna bstungs pas tshe phyi ma dang du len/ chos dang bstun pa la sgo zhan pas khe grags chung zer nas smra/ chags sdang can chos brgyad can khe grags rnams la 'di go chod cing sgo drag zer nas byams/ mtho thag dang brngan chen ri bo bas kyang che ba/ phan sems til 'bru bas kyang chung ba de lta bu'i bla ma de la bla ma gar btugs/ de lta bu de bdud yin zer te shin tu mad/ sngon dpal phag mo gru pa'i spyan sngar glang seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis khams su 'gro ba'i tshe na bla ma rin po che'i rnam par thar pa zhig zhu zhus pas/ kho bo la rnam par thar pa'i yon tan bya rgyu yon tan sna gcig kyang mi bdog 'on kyang tshe 'di'i rtog pa skad gcig kyang skye ma myong ba yin gsung skad/ lar skyes bu rnams mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa'i bla ma de lta bu rnyed na don 'grub pa yin pas glo snying brang gsum bla ma la lings kyi chol la nga ci shes khyed kyis de shes kyi tshul du mos gus byas pas don 'grub nas 'ongs te/ de lta bu'i bla ma dang mjal na/ rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas slob ma'i mtshan nyid mos gus yod pa gcig pus chog gsungs pas bu rnams kyis de ltar thugs la gzhag par zhu/ yang bsngo ba zhig bya gsungs// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o skol tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di cis lan snyam na gdams pa nyams su blangs kyang dus kyi gnad ma shes pas lan/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi nyams su blang byar gsungs kyang rgyud dkrugs/ lung bcus/

man ngag gab pas shes pa'am rtogs par dka' la/ gnad 'di rdo rje 'chang chen pos mngon du gyur pa yin/ des na sngags kyi dngos grub thob par byed pa la mnyam par 'jog pa'i dus shes dgos/ de la lo gcig la dus gnad du 'gro ba bzhi yod/ de gang yin snyam na/ sangs rgyas nyid sangs rgyas pa dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ dpal lha las babs pa dang*/ mu stegs kyi ston pa drug 'dul ba'i dus dang bzhi yin pas dus de rnams dang bstun pa'i dgos pa yang spang bya thams cad spong zhing*/ yon tan thams cad mngon du 'gyur ba'i dus yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin/ sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshul de bzhin mdzad pas sangs rgyas pa lags te/ mdor na de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa lags/ des na 'o skol ma 'ongs pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i gang zag rnams kyis kyang*/ de ltar byas te/ de yang sa ga sa ri'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal dang 'dzoms pa'i dus su ston pa sku bltams pa'i dus dang rab tu byung ba dang*/ de'i nya la mngon par byang chub pa lags pas/ dus der ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag na lo ril por bcad pa bas zla ba gcig po de stobs che'o// de nas zhag grangs bzhi cu rtsa dgu lon pa'i dus su wa ra nā sir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus yin pas sngar dang 'dra la/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi yum sgyu ma chen mo bya ba bden pa la bkod pa'i dus su lha'i gnas su byon/ dbyar zla ba gsum du bzhugs pa'i tshe na/ 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bus spyan 'dren du byon pa la/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pas zhag bdun na lha las babs par mkhyen nas nyi shu gnyis na grong khyer gsal ldan du byon/ rtsa rgyud nas me thebs can zer te don gcig de'i dus su ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag na gong ltar du 'byung zhing*/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i dus mchod dang yang gcig gsung*/

cho 'phrul gyi zla ba ni skar ma chu'i nya ba yin te/ chu ni mi bzad 'joms par byed gsungs pas/ dus der mu stegs kyi ston pa drug btul ba'o// de la sngon rdor gdan du/ du ru ka'i dmag byung dus su mchod pa zla ba gcig gi nang du ma chad pas/ du ru ka'i dmag phyir log te bkra shis par byung bas zla ba snga ma la phal cher byed/ de yin phyi ma ma yin/ de tsug tu 'ong ba la chos kyi rje mi mnyes pa mi mdzad de/ ston pa de'i sras su 'dug des na skyes bu rnams sdom chol byas pas mi 'ong bas dus 'di rnams su 'bar dgos pa yin mod/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa yang de dang 'dra te/ dus phal pa bas bye ba phrag sum cu so gnyis kyis 'gyur che/ yang zla ba gcig la dus gnad du 'gro ba bzhi yod ste/ nya dang*/ stong*/ tshes brgyad/ nyi shu lnga rnams yin/ de la 'dul ba'am phar phyin las tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi la lha'i tshogs chen po 'du bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas rtsis che ba yin/ sngags nas yar dang mar gyi bcu bzhi de'i dus su dngos grub thob pa'i dus yin te/ de yang rdo rje'i gur las/ phyi rol ji bzhin nang de bzhin// zhes gsungs pas/ nang rdo rje'i lus la ci gnas pa de phyi rol snod bcud du gsal ba yin te/ dper na me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar 'byung ba lags/ de yang nang du 'khor lo bzhi yod pa'i gnad kyis phyi rol du sku bzhi/ de'i chos bden pa bzhi/ dge 'dun sde bzhi/ gdul bya mi rigs bzhi/ 'byung ba sa chu me rlung bzhi la sogs pa bzhir bzhir snang*/ nang na yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pas phyi rol na yang snang la/ nang gi yul de rnams na dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams thig le'i tshul du yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams na yang yod la/ nang gi gsang ba rten 'brel byang sems dkar dmar gyis phyi rol du nyi zla gnyis snang ste/ de yang bco lnga'i zla ba rgyas pa'i dus su/

phyi rol gyi yul rnams su dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'du ba ltar/ nang du khams thig le 'dus shing*/ stobs rgyas pa'i dus yin pas/ dus gzhan pas gnyan pa yin/ de'i tshe na ting nge 'dzin bsgoms na gzhan du zla ba ril por bsgoms pa bas dga' la/ yang gnam stong gi dus su zla ba 'gribs pas phyir zla ba zad cing yul rnams su mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus pa dus gnad gcig pa yin/ tshes brgyad dang nyi shu lnga yang tshul de ltar phye zhing*/ bsod nams gsog pa yang gong dang 'dra ste gcig de la dgongs nas sangs rgyas kyi bsnyen gnas bstan pa dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams yang mya ngan las 'da' ba yang dus bzang ba la 'das pa yang ma 'ongs pa'i bsod nams la dgongs pa yin/ de bas kyang zhib tu brtsis na zhag gcig la dus gnad du 'gro ba bzhi yod/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos kyang rgyud rnams su thun bzhi'i tshul du nyams su blang bar gsungs pa lags/ de yang snga thun dang po sngags pa rnga brdung ba'i tshe gnyid kyi bde ba la'ang ma chags par/ mal nas langs te gdong la ser bu phog par byas pas pad ma gsar pa la chu btab pa ltar lus sems thams cad sings kyis 'byung*/ dus der rtsa stong par rlung so ma zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems lan drug gi bar du bskyed pas gnyis ldab kyis rgyud la skye/ bdun pa la byin gyis brlab/ de nas rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bskyed rim la rtse gcig par bsgom/ mdor na snga thun dang po la 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas las rgyu 'bras la yid ches par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa yin/ de yang sangs rgyas thams cad tho rangs sangs rgyas pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang tho rangs sa nas sar 'phar ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyang grub pa thob pa'i dus tho rangs yin/ 'di dus gnad du che ba lags gsung*/ de yang rtsa zug dang rlung zug thams cad zhi nas gnad du 'gro ba'i dus yin pas 'bad/

nyin gung sa'i rlangs kyis khams nyob nas mi 'phel ba'i dus yin pas gung bor te bsil sar skyo bsangs bya/ yang na bskor ba bya ba la sogs dge sbyor dang ma bral bar bya/ skyo bsangs byed zer nas dge sbyor bzhag nas bre mo'i gtam mang po mi bya/ de ltar byas na gung bor ba rang du mchi/ yang phyi 'bred pa'i khams dang tshad pa'i stobs ni zhi/ khams dang dbang po ni dwangs/ grib chung si le grib chen 'ubs se 'dus pa'i dus der gnad du 'gro bas bsgom/ dmar thag chad nas skar ma khra hrug gis ma byung gi bar der gtor ma la sogs pa bya ba'i rim pa rnams mdzad nas dod bsgom pa yin/ chos rje ni skabs 'dir spyi bshags mdzad nas de nas ye mi mjal bar gda'/ rgyu mtshan yang rkyen dbang gis rgyud ma dag par 'gyur zhing nyes ltung des dge sbyor mi 'phel/ rmi lam dang 'od gsal mi zin pa de la sogs pas byin gyis mi rlob pa yin gsung*/ gung la gti mug gi dus yin pas bor la/ tho rangs snga ma ltar byas pa'i rjes la mal mi bde tsam byas la gos srab par byas nas yud tsam nyal bas/ dge sbyor rmi lam du 'grongs/ 'od gsal zin pa'i dus yin pas/ 'bad la bsgom/ ro nyal chen po byas pas sgom yong du re na 'dag sbyar ga la 'ong*/ de la spyir dus bzhi po de la lus kyi 'khrul 'khor bzhi byas pas sems kyi ting nge 'dzin skye lugs bzhi 'byung ste/ tho rangs 'od gsal gyi dus su seṅge'i nyal stabs gnad du 'gro/ snga gro mi rtog pa skye ba'i dus yin pas rdo rje'i dkyil krung gnad du 'gro/ phyi 'bred cha mnyam pa'i dus su tsog pu byas la lag pa spus mo la 'khyud pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnad du 'gro/ srod la bde ba skye ba'i dus yin pas thabs lam gyi 'khrul 'khor bcas nas gtum mo la gnad du 'gro gsung*/ de la dper na thab bcas pa rtsa shing rtse nas sbud pa bus na/ me mi 'bar kha med/
