de bzhin du lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ sems kyi dmigs pa rlung gi man ngag dang gsum 'dzoms na yon tan mi skye dbang med pa lags/ gsang sngags gnad kyis sangs rgya ba lags/ dge sbyor la bogs med par yun ring po la re na 'o brgyal bar mchis te/ sngon gyi dus na rgyal bu thams cad sgrol bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che byed pas/ rang la bdog pa'i dngos po ci yod pa thams cad sbyin par btang*/ mthar yab kyi bal gyi glang po che padma'i steng nas 'gro ba dang rin po che'i rigs la sogs pa thams cad sbyin par btang nas/ yab dang blon po rnams khros nas rgyal bu yab yum sras dang bcas pa ri bo don ti la bcugs nas gnas der byon pa dang*/ de na drang srong zhig 'dug pa la khyod su yin dris pa las/ bdag ni drang srong a chu tha bya ba yin zer skad/ 'o na 'dir ci byed pa yin byas pas bsgom pa yin zer/ 'o na sngar lo du bsgoms byas pas/ lnga brgya bsgoms zer/ 'o na khyed la ting nge 'dzin ci yod dris pas/ da rung sems gnas pa med zer/ de lta bu bsgom pa'am/ yang rje rin po che tshogs pa lnga brgya tsam skyong ba'i dus na/ bsgom pa a ro khya bya bas lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bsten kyang sems ngo ma shes par gda' ste phyis rin po che'i zhal nas/ lnga brgya bsgoms kyang a chu tha// rtsa bzhi bsten kyang a rog khya// bya ba gsungs te/ de ci la gleng slangs na/ skyes bu rnams ci tsam bsgom yang na ning gi sa na do gcig kyang tsog ge des kyang mi 'ong bar 'dug pas dus gnad shes par byas nas bsgoms pas bogs zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'byung ba dang*/ skyon thams cad 'dag pa lags pas bu rnams kyis de ltar thugs la bzhag par zhu 'tshal// //yang rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags lus gtso bor ston pa yin/ de la yon tan skyed pa dang*/ skyon 'dag par byed pa thams cad 'khrul 'khor lags/

'khrul 'khor gyi bye brag tha dad pas ting nge 'dzin tha dad pa 'byung ba yin/ nga 'bus rje rin po che la de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrul 'khor gyi rjes su 'brangs sam/ 'khrul 'khor de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su 'brang zhus pas/ bu sangs rgyas chos kyi rjes su 'brang*/ chos 'khrul 'khor la brten nas rtogs par byed pas 'khrul 'khor gyi rjes su 'brangs gsung*/ de yang rgya gar na grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ bod na grub thob nam mkha' la 'phur shes pa bzhi cu rtsa dgu yang 'khrul 'khor re re la ting nge 'dzin re re skyes pa'i grub thob yin/ mdor na 'khrul 'khor rgyal po dang 'dra la ting nge 'dzin bran dang 'dra ba yin/ de'i nang nas rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor gsum po 'di gal che ste/ de la 'dug na 'dug pa'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ gang du sdod pa'i sa der/ rdo rje dkyil krung man ngag bzhin du bcas pa dang skad cig kyang ma 'bral ba bya/ 'di la phan yon dpag tu maid pa yod de/ sngon thub pa chen po la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang byang chub kyi shing drung du rdo rje'i dkyil krung gis bzhugs nas shes bya'i bud shing thams cad ye shes kyi mes bsregs te sangs rgyas pa lags mod/ de ltar mtshan brjod las/ rdo rje dkyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i chos 'dzin pa// ces gsungs/ dper na sngon rgya gar nub phyogs kyi ri zhig gi logs bzhi la/ shar na spre'u lnga brgya/ byang na phag rgod lnga brgya/ lho na drang srong lnga brgya/ nub na rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya yod pa las/ spre'u rnams la pho gcig las med/ pho gzhan byung na des bsod pa la/ dus re shig na spre'u mo zhig la pho zhig skyes pa la ma des yang bsad kyis dogs nas rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya yod pa'i sar bskyal bas/ der dgra bcom pa rnams grongs nas kho ltogs nas/ spur slong zhing gnod pa byas pas 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i gnod sbyin khros te/

gdug pa can 'dis 'phags pa rnams kyi spur la gnod pa byed zer nas/ spur rnams brag phugs su bcug nas/ sgo brtsigs pas/ der kho drang srong lnga brgya'i sar phyin pa dang*/ drang srong thams cad bsgom pa'i 'khrul 'khor la la lag pa gnam la sgreng ba'am/ la la langs pa'am/ 'dug pa'am/ lus shed thams cad rkang pa gcig gi mthe bong la bskur ba'am/ mig nyi ma la lta ba'i tshul du 'dug pa la/ spre'us sngon rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'khrul 'khor dkyil krung de drang srong rnams la byas pas/ khong rang rnams kyis mkhan po la spre'u ma rungs pa 'dis bdag cag rnams kyi bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs thams cad dkrugs zhus pas/ des gang zag dam pa dag mthong srid pas zhag shas spre'u'i lugs su thongs dang zer/ de nas spre'u'i lugs su byas pas thams cad la ting nge 'dzin skyes nas dgra bcom pa thob skad/ der spre'u la drin du bzo ba'i phyir dgra bcom pa rnams kyis lha'i gnas nas zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa blangs shing phud 'dren par byas shing drangs nas mthar spre'u shi ba'i tshe yang lha'i tsan dan blangs nas bsregs te rus pa la mchod rten byas pa de yang*/ phyis kyi dus su 'phags pa nyer sbas yin pa legs pa'i gtam rgyud gsung ste/ des na 'di la phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa lags mod/ gnyis pa 'gro nas 'gro ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni g.yas su mi blta g.yon du mi blta zhing*/ sku'i rnam par 'gyur ba gsum dang ma bral bar mig gnya' shing gang tsam du blta zhing gom pa ha chang che ba ma yin/ ha chang chung ba ma yin par mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mi yengs par 'gro/ de ltar yang sdud pa las/ gnya' shing gang tsam lta zhing 'gro la sems 'khrul med// ces gsung*/ yang mdo las/ bcom ldan gnya' shing gang tsam blta zhing gshegs// sa dang ri dang ngam pa g.yo bar mdzad// ces gsungs pas/ 'gro ba'i las la dbang gyur na nyal ba la sogs pa yang spangs te/

'dug pa'i 'khrul 'khor de byas pas/ rtog pa thams cad rlung zhi ba ltar 'gyur zhing lus sems thams cad pad ma la chu btab pa bzhin du sing gis 'byung*/ dge sbyor ngo 'phrod pa'i dus gnad kyang yod gsung*/ gsum pa nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni zhogs g.yas pa 'og tu phab/ mgo byang du bstan pa la sogs pa gal che/ de ltar ma byas par kha nub tu byas na gti mug 'phel zhing rmi lam du yang sa bdag gi cho 'phrul 'byung zhing bar du gcod/ g.yon 'og tu gcug nas nyal na zhe sdang 'phel zhing pho gdon gyi rmi lam 'byung zhing bar chod 'byung*/ gan rkyal du nyal na 'dod chags 'phel zhing mo gdon gyi cho 'phrul dang thig le nyams pa la sogs pa'i bar chad 'byung ba lags mod/ des na seng ge'i nyal stabs byas te/ sngar gyi nyes pa rnams spong zhing gnyen po ting nge 'dzin skye ba yin/ de yang sngon sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su/ gyad kyi yul du kun dga' bo la de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i gzims khri shoms shig gsungs nas/ kun dga' bos kyang bshams pa de la phyag gis 'jus nas shums te/ thub chen seng ge'i gzim khri ni// bshams pa'i tha ma 'di lags pas// phyin chad bsham du ma mchis so// gsungs te/ de'i steng du sangs rgyas nyid gong ltar seng ge'i gzim stabs su mdzad de/ tshes brgyad kyi nub mo 'dzam bu gling pa'i zla ba nub pa'i tshe/ thub pa zhi bar gshegs pa yang 'khrul 'khor de nyid kyi ngang nas gshegs shing*/ sangs rgyas gzhan rnams kyang de ltar du mchi bas 'di shin tu zab pa'i gnad yin gsung*/ de dag gi dus su nyams su blang bya de gang yin snyam na/ byang chub kyi sems nyid dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di kho na lags te/ de yang ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i gleng gzhi las/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po bya ba bzhugs/ de la chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ni don dam pa byang chub kyi sems phyag rgya chen po yin/

de rnam par spros pa ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems lags te/ de gang du spros/ tshul lam thabs ji ltar spros na/ sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa de nyid sems can thams cad kyi don du bde ba dang ldan par spros/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar spros/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par spros pa lags/ de lta bu'i mdo 'di yang sngon dpal ldan sgam po ba byang chub sems pa zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i tshe na bcom ldan 'das kyis btad pa lags te/ mdo sde 'di'i tshig tsam bzung ba yang phan yon dpag tu med cing 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las myur du sgrol ba lags na/ 'di nyid rgyud pa rin po che 'di pa'i chos yin zhing*/ dwags po bka' brgyud ces 'dzam bu'i gling du grags pa 'di khong gi drin yin mod/ de lta bu'i chos 'di nyams su blangs pas sems kyis lus byin gyis brlobs te/ lus kyi nad dang gnod pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas 'gro/ lus kyis snang ba byin gyis brlobs te/ gang snang gang gis mthong ba thams cad la phan bde dpag tu med pa 'byung ba lags pas/ bu rnams kyis de ltar du thugs la bzhag par zhu gsung*/ yang bsngo ba zhig bya// //yang rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ spyir sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la lam bgrod tshul rnam pa gnyis yin/ de yang mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa bas ni/ smon 'jug gnyis bskyed nas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis kyis/ lam bgrod par byed pa la/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa bas ni/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i lam dbang*/ smin pa grol bar byed pa'i lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi lam bgrod par byed pa bas/ sngon du rtogs pa dbang bskur dgos pa yin/ des na bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud thams cad du/ phung po dang khams thams cad gdod ma nas sangs rgyas su gsungs pa de rtogs par byed pa yin/

de ltar yang dgyes rdor las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// dbang las yang dag shes par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ dbang bskur mkhan po rdo rje 'chang lta bu'i bla ma zhig dgos/ su thod thod kyis spyod pa ma yin gsung*/ de la dbang bzhi'i go ba ni/ bum dbang lus la bskur bas lus kyi dri ma 'dag gsang dbang ngag la bskur bas ngag gi dri ma 'dag gsum pa yid la bskur bas yid kyi dri ma 'dag bzhi pa gsum ga la bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma 'dag cing nus pa 'jog tshul bzhi 'byung ba lags/ nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum 'byung ste zhi gnas yin/ bzhi pa lhag mthong gi nyams de dag par byed dgos/ 'dir ni dbang gi go ba ngo 'phrod par byed pa'am rtogs par byed pa zer te/ de yang bum pa'i dbang gis lus 'di nyid gdod ma nas sangs rgyas yin pas/ de yin pa la yin par shes pa yin/ kha cig gi 'dod pa la kun brtags yin pas dngos ma yin pa zhig la dbang gis bsgyur nas der brtags par 'dod de/ de ltar song na sol ba brdar ba las kyang dung 'gyur dgos te mi 'byung gsung*/ des na gdod ma nas lha yin pa la yin par shes 'tshal/ de'i go ba ma byung na gser dang dngul gyi bum pa mgo thog tu bzhag kyang mi phan/ chu bo gang gās lus bkrus kyang mi phan/ dbang ma thob pa bya ba yin/ 'on kyang bskyed rim sgom rung tsam byas pa'i rung chu gtor ba tsam yin/ de ltar ngo 'phrod nas skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral bar bsgom dgos pa yin no// tha mal pa dag dge slong ngam dge tshul yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa byung na ltung bar 'gyur/ de ltar yi dam lhar bsgom pa la rin po che'i zhal nas lha de byang chub sems las byung la/ kun brtags spros pas stong pa dang*/ rnam par gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa dang lnga dgos gsung*/ dang po ni byang chub kyi sems las byung ba zhig ma gtogs pa nyon mongs pa dug gsum la sogs pa skyes na lhar mi mchi bas/

de la dgongs nas rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ lha 'dod chags skyes na yi dwags yin// lha zhe sdang skyes na dmyal ba yin// lha gti mug skyes na dud 'gro yin// lha dug tu song na mi dge bas// des na lha la bya ra gces// zhes gsung*/ gnyis pa kun brtags spros pas stong pa zhig dgos te/ de la spyir bskyed pa'i rim pa 'di la kun brtags/ gzhan dbang*/ yongs grub gsum las/ kun brtags la gnyis las/ mtshan nyid yongs su chad pa'i kun brtags ni/ ri bong gi rwa'am/ nam mkha'i me tog tu brtags pa lta bu yin/ rnam grangs kyi kun brtags ni rwa'i gnyer ma brtsi ba'am me tog gi dbyibs la sogs pa brtag pa lta bu yin te/ mdor na min pa la min par byas pa thag pa la sbrul du 'dzin pa'am chu'i thog tu me sgrub pa lta bu zhig yin skad/ 'on kyang kun tu brtags pa ni las dang po pa rnams la ni/ yi dam lha'i zhal phyag la sogs pa mi gsal ba de shes pa snga phyi'i rgyun gyis lha de'i rnam pa la brtags nas/ bsgom dgos pa'i cha nas rnam pa la kun tu brtags pa bya ba 'ong yang*/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ sngags la kun brtags kyi sgra mi 'jug gsung*/ gnyis pa gzhan dbang la gnyis/ dag pa'i gzhan dbang ni byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang byas pa'i rgyu 'bras yin la/ ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang ni/ nyon mongs pas dbang byas pa'i rgyu 'bras yin gsung*/ gsum pa yongs grub la gnyis las/ 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub ni/ phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad gdod ma nas lha'i sku rang chas su grub pa yin te/ de ltar yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyid dang ni// rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid yin// zhes pa'am/ yang gsang 'dus las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags// zhes pa'am/ 'khor lo sdom pa las kyang*/ gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad do// ces pa la sogs pa gsung*/

he badzra las kyang*/ sbyin la kha dog gnas pa ni// skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas// zhes pa dang*/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pa lags/ phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub ni lha de nyid byang chub pa lnga'am/ cho ga gsum mam/ skad gcig dran rdzogs la sogs pa yin lugs ltar du bsgoms pas/ mngon du gyur pa de yin zhing*/ lha la brtan pa thob pa la zer ba lags/ 'di la slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ dang po las kyi sbyor ba yis// sa brgyad pa ni thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa la/ la la dag 'di la ha las pa 'dod pa yod/ de gnyis su mchi gsung*/ gzhan gyi dgongs pa len lugs kyis bskyed rim zhal phyag gsal tsam pa de a 'thas su bsgoms pas sa brgyad mi 'thob pa la blo rtse gtad nas skyon brjod pa yin te/ des sa brgyad thob tu re na kho thag chad ga la thob/ 'di rgyu byang chub kyi sems las byung zhing rkyen kun brtags kyi spros pas stong pa'i lha la brtan pa thob pa de sangs rgyas dngos rang yin/ ha las rgyu med/ de ltar yang byang chub sems las byung gyur zhing*// kun brtags spros pas rnam stong pa// sgrib gsum spangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pas na// sa brgyad thob pa mtshar ci che// ces gsungs pa lags mod/ yang gsum pa ni lha de shin tu rnam pa gsal ba zhig dgos/ de 'byung bar byed pa la rgyu dang rkyen tshang ba zhig dgos pa lags te/ rgyu ni sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad gsang ba rten 'brel las 'byung bar gsungs te/ de ltar yang*/ kyai rdo rje las/ ston pa'i sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cu ldan/ khu ba zhes bya rnam par gnas// zhes pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ ga bur nyid ni bdag med ma// bgyi ba la sogs pa gsungs so// rkyen la gnyis las mthun pa'i rkyen khams 'phel bar byed pa'i zas la sogs pa brten dgos/

de ltar yang*/ he badzra las/ de la ga bur rgyu yi phyir// sha dang sa lu skyes pa gza'// zhes gsungs so// gnod pa'i rkyen ni rul sungs dang sngo la sogs pa dang lus 'jig par byed pa'i spyod lam drag shul la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad spangs nas/ rgyas pa de mi nyams par bsrungs bas/ 'di'i yon tan lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs ba spu'i 'khyil stangs tshun chad gsal bar 'byung ba lags pas/ 'di la gces spras shin tu che bar bya/ yang bzhi pa rnam dag dran pa la gnyis las/ kun rdzob lha so so'i rnam dag ni/ gong ltar du phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad lhar gsal zhing tha mal du 'dzin pa dag pa de yin/ lha la zhen yang gser gyi sgrog dang 'dra ste 'ching bas/ lhar 'dzin gyi zhen pa spang ba'i phyir/ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par dag pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi lha dang rdzogs rim phyag rgya chen po gnyis dbye ba med par bsgom pa yin te/ de la zung 'jug zer ba lags/ gang du zung du 'jug snyam na/ lha stong pa dang stong pa lha/ de gnyis dbye ba med par gdod ma nas gnas pa yin pas/ de la sgyu ma lta bu'i lha sku zer/ don dam de bzhin nyid kyi rnam dag zer ba yin/ spyir bskyed rim zung 'jug tu gnas pa de gshis yin/ de babs yin te/ glo bur du gnyis gcig tu sangs rgyas pa lta bu ma yin pas/ de'i brdar lha yab yum du byung ba yin/ des na dpal he ru kas yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di/ logs shig nas khab tu bzhes pa dang*/ zung du bcug pa med/ yab yum gnyis gdod ma nas gnyis su med pa'i zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin yin te/ yab skye ba'i cha thabs yin/ yum stong pa'i cha shes rab yin/ de gnyis su med pa de zung 'jug zer ba lags/ lha pho reng dang mo reng rnams la yang phyag mtshan la sogs pa so so'i yab yum gyi brda mtshon pa re re yod pa yin/

spyir lha'i rgyan cha la sogs pa 'di rnams thams cad la skyon dag pa dang yon tan rdzogs pa'i mtshon byed re re yod pa yin lags/ mdor na yi dam lha zhal sbyor re la byed dgos pa yin/ de la rgyu mtshan zhig yod gsung*/ de lta bu de la brtan pa thob par byed pa la lha dang sngags gcig tu byed dgos te/ lha bsgom nas ma gsal ba'i dus su rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed pa yin/ de yang 'jigs 'jigs sam 'dre skrod pa'i ched lta bu ma yin te/ sngags de lha'i ming yin/ de ltar yang*/ rang ming brjod pa'i sngags la ni/ mthar ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa sbyar/ zhes pa'am/ yang na thugs skul ba'i phyir sngags yin te/ saṃ bhu ṭa las/ sngags rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid ni// bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs yin te// zhes pa'am/ yang na spyan 'dren par byed pa'i phyir na sngags yin/ gur las/ gal te skyes chen 'ga' zhig la// che la myur ba'i dgra bos na// thos pa tsam gyis 'ong ba ltar// sangs rgyas skad cig 'byon par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ dper na bu gcig pu shi ba'i ma des bu bu byas pas bu gsal lam lam 'byung*/ de bzhin sngags des kyang lha gsal bar byed pa yin/ bzlas thabs la 'phreng ba'i bzlas thabs dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa gnyis las/ phreng ba'i bzlas pa ni/ ba lang gi rmig rjes dang 'dra/ nor bu'i mching bu dang 'dra te ngag tu brjod pas chud pa yin/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra/ nor bu rin po che rtse dung rgya dang 'dra ba yin/ de yang ngag tu brjod pa spangs nas so la 'char tsam du yid kyis lha gsal lam lam byas nas 'dren pa yin/ slob dpon gzhon nu seng ge'i dpe yang gsung*/ de ltar ma song ba'i rnam rtog thang yan la btang ba'i bzlas pa 'phreng ba 'dom gyis gzhal yang mi phan pa lags/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya bzhi yang lha gsal bar byed pa don gcig pa gsang sngags bzlas pa yin/

de sngar ltar du lha de nyid gsal bar byed/ rigs sngags ni lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang rgyan dang cha lugs skye mched dang*/ rnam dag thams cad rig pa yin/ snying po ni de ltar brtan zhing ngo bo shes pa la bya/ phyag rgya ni brtan pa de las mi ldog cing mi 'gyur bar byed pa yin/ dper na me nyag chos kyi rgyal po'i bkar brtags kyi phyag rgya bskur ba de la gang gis kyang 'da' mi nus pa dang 'dra gsung*/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su/ bying rgod byung na/ 'og sgo snyoms 'jug gi bde ba la sems gtad pas sel/ rgod na spyan gsum dbu ma bsgrad/ sdang mig tu byas la/ dbu mdun du cung zhig dgug tshems sgra khrig khrig byas pas sel te/ de yang rje rin po ches/ dbye chung sgom phug tu thugs la 'khrungs pas brjed dogs nas brag la bris te/ bying na dga' bzhi rim gyis bsgom// rgod na dpa' bo tshems sgra sgrigs bya// zhes gsungs pas des sel bar byed do// lnga pa nga rgyal brtan pa ni gong du snyan du gsol ba'i zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku'i mnyam gzhag chen po de las g.yo ba med pa'i dus su/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu 'phrin las bzhi dang grub chen brgyad la sogs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsam pa'i gnad yin gyi sgyur ka res kyang lhun gyis grub pa 'byung zhing*/ snang srid thams cad la dbang sgyur ba 'byung zhing*/ dper na dpal rga lo'am/ gshen re thul la/ zhogs pa rdo rje dbang phyug lta bu'am/ de yang dpal rga los rgya gar du byon gser srang dgu bcu yod pa la/ bla ma a bhya la phul nas gdams ngag rnams zhus te/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog gi sku la brtan pa thob nas bla mas gshol yang ma nyan par dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du bsgom du byon te/ lo gsum du sgrub pa mdzad pas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis ka thob nas byon pa'i nub mo chang thod pa gang dbu sngas na 'dug pa yang gsol nas mthar tshur la byon pa la/

slob dpon gnyis kyis bsu ba byas te/ phyag g.yas g.yon gnyis po bla ma gnyis kyi gnya' gong du bkal nas spyan drangs/ grub thob tu grags pas zangs gling tshun chad 'dus pas sgrub pa byed du ma ster nas bod du byon pa la smyon pa la de si bya bas spyan gsum du mthong*/ byang gnam mtsho se mo do la bzhugs pa'i tshe na/ zhang sha ra ba bya ba'i bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes de'i slob ma gnyis kyis dbang bskur zhus nas/ sha ra ba'i spyan sngar phyin pas khyed gnyis de 'dra ba byed pa da bshags pa gyis gsungs pa dang*/ gcig gis bshags pa byas par gda'/ gcig gis dpal chen po'i drung du phyin te lo rgyus de bshad pas/ bla ma dpal chen po thugs log nas sku lus zing zing phrug phrug byas la/ de'i dus su lha gsal gdab pa yin gsung*/ de nas dpal chen po'i zhal nas nga'i chos 'di log pa zhig yin na nag po chen pos rga lo tsā ba'i lha zhig yod pa de yar thon la 'dre zhig med pa de mar chug cig nga'i chos 'di chos yin na shang rom chung ba'i lha zhig yod pa de yar thon la 'dre zhig yod pa de mar chug cig nga'i chos 'di chos yin de'i nyin mo rang nas zhang sha ra ba shes pa 'khrul nas mtshon thogs pa mang pos ded pa dang*/ mal gyi 'go nas kyang mdung thogs pa byung zer nas khrab 'dings pa la sogs pa'i rim gro chen po byas kyang grongs par gda'/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ kho bo'i bla ma dpal chen po de bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba'i grub thob yin gsung ba de lta bu dang*/ 'o na phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa mnga' 'am bya ba zhus pas/ shin tu yang mnga' gsung*/ yang zhogs pa rdo rje dbang phyug bya ba zhogs su byung bas/ kho bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed la brtan pa thob pas/ yab kyi la la 'ongs te lung na mar byon pas gzhi bdag drag po yod pa bros nas byung ba'i phyi na mar khong tshe ber zhig gsol/

gru mo rgyangs nas ma he'i zhal gyis ra'i 'dug stangs dang ngur sked byed kyin byon pa lta bu dang*/ yang gshin re thul yang bcom ldan 'das ma he'i zhal la brtan pa thob pa lags par gda'/ khong gis rigs gsum mgon po'i zhal yang yang mthong ba la/ thugs shes rab chung ba'i bka' gdams pa'i slob dpon zhig la dris pas 'dre yin zer ba la/ yang dus cig gi tshe zhal mthong ba la lha gsal btab nas/ ma he'i zhal du rngubs nas lto bar yun ring cig bsdams nas mthar 'og sgo na mar bton pas 'drer song nas/ shad du bse rags ser sob dang*/ skya rab rib dang*/ sngo rid dang gsum byung skad ste/ snang ba rang sems yin pas lhar bzung na lhar 'ong na/ 'drer bzung na 'drer 'gyur ba de lta bu yin gsung*/ de ltar bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa'i dus su/ bde gshegs sku yang chem chem gsol// srog chags gzhan lta smos ci dgos// bya ba yin gsung*/ skyes bu rnams de ci la gleng slangs na/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob pa'i dus su/ 'phrin las thogs pa med pa la de lta bu 'byung ba lags/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni gdams pa de rnams dang ldan pa'i bskyed rim bsgoms pas/ mthar phyin pa'i zung 'jug sgrib pa gsum pa 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang dbye ba med par 'gyur/ de rgyu mtshan bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang de sgrib pa gsum spangs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ de la brtan pa thob pa lags mod/ de'i byed las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i phrin las 'byung ba dang phrin las tshad med pa stong pa nyid dang*/ gnyis zung du 'jug cing*/ dbye ba med pa'i ngang las sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par byed pa 'byung ba lags pas na skyes bu rnams yi dam lha'i bskyed rim bsgom pa'i brtul zhugs chen po zung dang*/ gnad du song na yun ring ba'i kha na med skad cig gis chog pa yin/

des na log gdugs 'khyams gsum du ma song ba gal che bas/ khyed rnams thams cad kyis de ltar du thugs la bzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad kyang*/ theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus la/ theg pa chen po la yang sngags dang pha rol du phyin pa gnyis las sngags kyi theg pa gsang sngags rgyud sde chen po bzhi yin te/ de ltar yang*/ bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud// rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med rgyud// dang pos lus spyod gtso bor ston// gnyis pas ngag spyod gtso bor ston// gsum pas sems spyod gtso bor ston// bzhi pas lhan skyes 'ba' zhig go// ces gsungs pas/ bla na med pa'i brjod bya thams cad lhan cig skyes pa 'ba' zhig tu ston pa lags/ gang lhan cig skyes na/ snang ba dang stong pa/ thabs dang shes rab/ dbyings dang ye shes la sogs pa thams cad gnyis su med par zung 'jug 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa lags/ des na rgyud kyi mi rtog pa'i rgyal po 'di bya ba gsung ste/ de gang yin na zhe sdang thol gyis skyes pa'i dus su/ zhe sdang skyes pa med pa dang*/ bral ba med par gdod ma nas zung 'jug tu gnas pa de'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa de bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang rdo rje yin/ de ltar sangs rgyas nas zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i chos gzhan la ston pa de la rgyud ces bya/ de bzhin du 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa du ma'i rtog pa gang thol gyis skyes pa tsam nyid na 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dug lnga stong pa nyid dang 'bral ba med par gdod ma nas zung 'jug tu gnas pa de'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa de nyid/ bcom ldan 'das 'dod chags rdo rje'am phrag dog rdo rje la sogs pa 'byung*/ tshul de kho na ltar gzhan mang yang chos ston par byed pa la 'dod chags chen po'i rgyud ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/

de'i phyir na zhe sdang dang 'dod chags la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung du 'ong gsung*/ de ltar rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs go na sems kyi gnas lugs go nas 'ong bas/ rdo rje'i lus sam rtog pa'i rgyal po'i lus 'di/ 'byung ba bzhis bsdus te/ de thams cad kyang gdod ma nas yum bzhi'i ngo bor gnas pa yin/ de la lus 'di la sra ba dang sra bar byed pa thams cad ni 'byung ba sa'i khams yin/ de thams cad sangs rgyas spyan mar sangs rgyas pa yin/ de la sa chen po de'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dang zhal phyag gis khyad par du byas pa zhig yod snyam na/ de ma yin skyes bu rnams de nyid bsal gzhag med par gdod ma nas sangs rgyas spyan mar gnas pa lags mod/ de bzhin du dro dang dro bar byed pa me dang*/ brlan pa dang brlan par byed pa chu'i rang bzhin dang*/ g.yo ba dang g.yo bar byed pa rlung gi khams thams cad lha mo gos dkar mo dang*/ ma ma ki dang sgrol ma'i ngo bor gdod ma nas gnas pa yin/ nang ltar na bde chen gyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yin/ des na rtogs pa'i rgyal po'i lus 'di nyid gdod ma nas sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ lus 'di'i skye mched rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bo yin te/ mig gi yul du gzugs mthong ba ni gzugs rdo rje gdod ma nas bsal gzhag med par gnas pa yin/ de bzhin du rna ba dang sna dang*/ lce dang*/ lus la reg bya rdo rje la sogs par gnas/ mdor na phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad gdod ma nas lha dang lha mo/ sgo ma dang sgo mtshams ma la sogs pa lus dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'khor lor gnas la de'i dbus de na gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das he ru ka ni rtog pa'i ngo bo yin te/ zhe sdang ngam 'dod chags la sogs pa'i rtog pa'i go ma 'gags par thol thol skye ba de snang ba thabs kyi cha yab yin/

rtog pa de rtog med dang dbye ba med par gnas pa de shes rab stong pa yum reg bya rdo rje ma yin/ de ltar zung 'jug tu gnas pa de la dpal lhan cig skyes pa zer ba lags te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin/ rtog pa phra mo thams cad 'khor du 'ong ste/ de thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu bsgom zhing der 'dus pas na 'khor lo sdom pa zhes bya/ gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya/ cis kyang zhal phyag la sogs pa yod pa de ltar yin rgyu med de/ de mtshon byed brda'i lha yin/ lha mtshan nyid pa de gshis rtog pa de yin/ der ma zad de mig gi dbang po la sogs yul la 'jug pa yab lnga/ yum gyi ngo bo stong par gnas pa yum lnga ste/ de ltar snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad yab yum zung 'jug 'ba' zhig tu gnas te/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas kyang*/ yod pa dngos por snang ba dang*// med pa stong pa'i chos nyid gnyis// ngo bo dbyer med ro gcig pas// thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin// zhes gsungs te/ de thams cad sangs rgyas sgam pos byas pa'am/ sems can sgrin pos bcos pa ma yin te/ gdod ma nas gshis sam babs kyis de ltar gnas pa lags/ de rtogs pa la 'dug lugs shes pa'i shes rab zhes bya te/ de ltar shes pa la dbang mtshan nyid pa zhig thob dgos/ de thob pa'i dus su 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung du 'ong ba de babs lags/ babs shes pa de nyams su len par byed pa de la gsang sngags zer ba yin mod/ nyams su blangs pa'i sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i ngo bo 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba yin/ ngo bo gang yin na/ ngo bo gzugs med mthong ba po yang med// sgra med thos pa po yang med// dri med snom pa po yang med// ro med reg pa po yang med// sems med sems las byung ba'ang med// yid med chos kyang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pas thams cad spros pa med pa'i ngang du 'jug pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa zhes kyang zer te/

lar tshe gcig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa yin/ 'di la dgongs nas sangs rgyas kyis kyang gsang 'dus las/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsad nas// dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa yin/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis/ gshis de las log nas bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis gzhan na 'tshol te shin tu dka' gsung*/ de bas na sngags kyi lam la mi 'jug kha med/ zhugs nas rgyu byang chub kyi sems las byung zhing*/ rkyen kun brtag gi spros pas stong pa'i zung du 'jug pa'am lha dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor phyag rgya chen po/ rjes bsngo ba dang bcas pa 'di rnams dang*/ skad cig kyang 'bral ba med par nyams su len par zhu gsung*// //yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags su rtogs lam dbang bskur nas/ dngos grub thob par byed pa la rtsa ba'i dam tshig ma nyams pa zhig dgos/ 'di nyams na dngos grub mi 'thob cing pha rol tu bro gcong du 'gyur gsung*/ 'o na dam tshig gang yin snyam na/ dam tshig gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin/ de la rig pa ni lha'i sku yin la/ de la sems ma yengs par 'dzin pa la rig pa 'dzin pa zer ba lags/ de yang bskyed rim la rtse gcig par rig pa ma zin par yul lnga'i rjes su rtog pa phyir 'brangs pas nyes pa mtha' dag 'byung ste/ mig gi dbang po gzugs la phyir ltas pas/ gzugs la chags sdang rmongs gsum skyes nas ngan song gsum du skye ba'i las bsags nas/ rlung nang du mi gnas pa'i skyon gyis tshe thung ba dang*/ nad mang ba dang*/ skye ba snga ma'i phun sum tshogs pa bag tsam yod pa yang*/ shes pa phyir yan pa'i mes sregs nas/ lung skam gyi chu ltar rbad kyis chad de/ kha mi phyid par yi dwags chen po dang 'dra bar gyur nas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad chu sna la sbur ma 'dus pa ltar 'byung*/ de bzhin du rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/

lce dang lus dang*/ yid khyab byed kyi rlung dang bcas pa yul phyir 'phros pas/ gong ltar chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi las gsog cing nyes skyon mtha' dag 'ong la des na mig gi dbang po yul gyi rjes su mi 'brang*/ yul la mi rtog par kha nang du bzlog nas lha la rig pa 'dzin pa yin/ des na mig gi dbang po'i rlung nang du log pa'i stobs skyu ru ra ltar gsal bar 'byung ste/ dbu'i gtsug gtor nas zhabs kyi pad ma'i bar du sku mdog dang phyag mtshan/ rgyan dang cha lugs bzhugs stangs dang sku'i rnam par 'gyur ba ba spu'i 'khyil stangs la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsgoms pas/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su 'gyur zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs rgyas pas/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes 'char te/ bde ba can la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa dang*/ yon tan dang*/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa la sogs pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa mthong ste/ dper na skyes bu mig dang ldan pa'i lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa bzhin mthong bar 'gyur gsung*/ de bzhin du rna bas sangs rgyas rnams chos gsung ba thos pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi skad shes pa dang*/ sna yis 'jig rten rnams kyi dri tshor ba dang*/ lces ro myong ba dang*/ lus kyis reg bya shes pa dang*/ yid kyis gzhan gyi sems shes pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ de thams cad kyang dbang po lnga yul gyi rjes su ma 'brangs par rlung nang du log pas ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs rgyas pa lags mod/ ting 'dzin bsgom pa la rlung gi stobs med na/ brlan med pa'i sa gzhi la me tog la sogs pa mi skye ba dang 'dra gsung*/ nang du rlung stobs su phyu ru ru rgyas pas rlung sems 'dra/ gnad gcig pa'i stobs kyis mngon par shes pa lnga thob cing*/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa yin/ rdzogs rim logs su bsgom mi dgos te/

bskyed rim de nyid bsal gzhag med par phyag rgya chen por rtogs pa de la dus kyi sna rtse zer/ bskyed rim lha/ lha de nyid stong pa nyid/ stong pa nyid lha/ stong pa de la brtan pa thob pa dang sangs rgyas kyi sku la brtan pa thob/ gsung dang thugs la brtan pa thob pas sgrib pa gsum spangs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'ong ba lags mod/ de ltar ma shes pas a 'thas kyi lha bsgoms pas 'khor ba nas rnga 'dres gang yang mi 'phags/ dper na yi dwags rdo rje 'jigs byed dang 'dra gsung*/ de yang sngon jo bo rje gnye thang bor na bzhugs pa'i dus na nye gnas shig dang gnyis skyo sangs la byon pa'i dus na/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas saṃskṛ ta'i skad mang po gsung zhing khyod ma 'jigs shig a dzi dzi/ a dzi dzi/ dmar gtor zhig khyer la shog dang gsung*/ de ci lags zhus pas/ de dpal nā len dra'i zhal ta ba'i rnal 'byor pa bcom ldan 'das ma he'i zhal la brtan pa thob pa zhig gis dge 'dun la ma zhus par til gyi phub ma sle ba gang spyad pas/ de'i rnam smin gyis/ yi dwags chen po rdo rje 'jigs byed du skyes 'dug khong la gtor ma 'dod du byung*/ 'dis bod phungs su 'gro bas/ phar la bskrad btang yin gsung ba lta bu yin/ des na dbang po yul la mi 'jug par rlung sems nang du ting nge 'dzin la rtse gcig tu gnas pa gal che/ de bas na gsang sngags kyi yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi bskyed rim yin zhing*/ grub chen brgyad dang 'phrin las bzhi yang thogs pa med par 'byung ste/ de yang nyes pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig byas pa tsam gyis zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par gyur cig byas pa tsam gyis rgyas pa dang*/ lha dang mi la sogs pa thams cad dbang du 'du bar gyur cig byas pa tsam gyis dbang du 'dus te/ dper na dpal bsam yas bzhengs pa'i dus su lha 'dres rtsig tu ma ster nas slob dpon padma gdan drangs nas slob dpon gyis lha 'dre rnams bran du bkol bas/

nyin mo mis rtsigs pa bas nub mo mi ma yin gyis rtsigs pa mtho bar gyur nas/ mnga' bdag gis lan gcig gzigs pas nub mo gnod sbyin 'jigs su rung ba mang po tshogs nas bu chung gi mtshog ma'i steng du/ shing gi gdan byas nas shing bzo byed pa mthong skad/ mi ma yin pa dbang du 'dus na mi thams cad dbang du 'dus pa lta ci smos/ yang drag po'i 'phrin las la shi bar gyur cig byas pa tsam gyis 'chi ba la sogs pa'i las thams cad bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub cing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis gnon to// de yang sems nang du gnas pa las byung*/ dper na smyon pa dpag tu med pa yang ma smyo ba zhig gis zil gyis gnon/ sems nang du mi gnas pa ni smyon pa dang 'dra/ de ltar yang slob dpon shan ta de ba'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis// gong ma gong ma rnams kyis ni// 'og ma 'og ma rnams la gnod// ces pa'i don yin pas/ ting nge 'dzin 'di mi sgrub nor sgrub/ gtam sgrub yin pas/ brtson 'grus chen po brtsam la bsgom/ gzhan yang byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom/ thams cad kyi tshul de ltar du mchi/ gnyis pa mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la yang*/ sems nang du gnas par ma gyur na/ yon tan mi 'byung*/ nang du byang chub kyi sems la gnas pas/ rtsa byang chub sems kyi rtsa/ rlung byang chub sems kyi rlung*/ lus byang chub sems kyi lus/ snang ba byang chub sems kyi snang bar 'gyur/ sa dang lam la gnas pa'i yon tan thams cad 'di las 'byung ste/ thub pa chen po 'di yang*/ tha ma byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa'i tshe/ bdud kyi dmag bye ba phrag sum cu so drug byung ba'i dus su yang nang du rtse gcig tu rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag bdud kyi bu mo dga' mo la sogs pa bud med kyi g.yo sgyu ma lus pa bstan pa'i tshe yang sems phyir skad cig kyang mi dmigs te/

skad cig ma gcig phyir dmigs kyang*/ bar chad des sangs rgyas mi thob pa lags/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin las ma yengs par gnas pas byang chub brnyais pa yin/ des na gnad 'di go bar byas la sna thag mi la ma shor bar byas la bhu su ku'i spyod pa byed cing nyams su len dgos pa yin/ nyan thos rang rgyal gyi byang chub kyang sems nang du gnas shing yul lnga'i rjes su ma 'brang par bsgoms pas thob pa lags mod/ dper na yul 'phags rgyal gyi rgyal po gtum po rab snang 'phags pa ka ta ya nas btul ba lta bu yin/ des na sngags mtshan nyid theg pa che chung gnyis ka yang gnad gcig par gda'/ gnad 'di lta bu yod kyang nyams su mi len pa ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che yod kyang gsol ba mi 'debs pa dang 'dra gsung*/ des na skyes bu rnams dus da lta skye ba gtan gyi so nam sgrub pa'i dus yin pas 'bad dgos te/ shes bya mang po skyong ba'i long med/ rje btsun chen po mi la'i zhal nas kyang*/ shāka thub bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// mi rnams tshe thung longs spyod dbul// bdud rigs bar chod mang ba'i phyir// rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya mi 'tshal bas// bu sgrub pa snying por long zhig gsung*// zhes gsungs pas/ la la'i rtog pa la da lta dpe cha dang lha rten mang po bsgrubs nas/ yul lam dgon pa chen mo zhig tu phyin pa dang*/ lha rnams dgram dpe cha la lta rtog bya'o snyam ste/ de'i long med par shi nas dgra gnyen rnams kyi lag tu 'gro ba la tshegs med/ sngon dpon 'tsham phu ba bya ba cig grongs khar dpe cha dang nor la sogs pa chags pa skyes pas/ rje rin po che byon nas bka' bkyon te/ dpon la da 'dis khyod la snying tshim mam ma tshim/ yang na nga la 'bul ba yin/ yang na rang re zos nas bsgom pa yin/ da khyod kyi 'di rnams dgra snying na ba rnams kyis dgos pa de gal med gsung nas thal mo brdab gsung*/

des na skyes bu rnams tshe 'di'i 'dod pa dang bya ba thams cad lings kyis bor nas/ shin tu sgrims nas nyin mtshan kha sbyar nas bsgom pa gal che ba lags pas bu rnams kyis de ltar du thugs la bzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rgyu mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa bas/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa zab/ de la rgyang yel yod pa las rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud zab/ de'i brjod bya bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis yin pa la/ bskyed rim ni lus yi dam gyi lha gang yin du bsgoms pas lus tha mal gyi zhen pa bzlog pa lags/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la mtshan bcas dang mtshan med gnyis las mtshan bcas pa rim pa mang yang yon tan skyed par byed pa'i gzhi 'di yin pas gtum mo bsgom pa 'di gnad che gsung*/ de la gtum mo'i go ba ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho dang las dang nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa la sogs pa thams cad 'go gtums pas na gtum mo te/ de la yang rtsa gtum mo/ rlung gtum mo/ thig le gtum mo la sogs pa gsum las/ dang po rtsa gtum mo ni/ spyir rdo rje'i lus 'di la spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu kha nas/ rkang pa'i mthil gyi bar du khyab par rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis gnas pa la/ de las bsdus pas rtsa drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*/ sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de las bsdus na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i ngo bo yin te/ de yang rtsa ro ma/ rkyang ma/ kun 'dar ma gsum du 'dus pa'i 'dus mdo der rtsa yi ge'i tshul du gnas pa de rtsa gtum mo yin/ rlung gtum mo ni spyir lus dar ma skyon med pa la/ nyin zhag phrugs cig la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gyu/ de las bsdus pas drug cu rtsa bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de yang rtsa ba'i rlung lnga las/ thur sel/ gyen du rgyu/ srog 'dzin/ me mnyam/ khyab byed/ yan lag gi rlung la rtag par rgyu ba/

nges par tu rgyu ba/ rnam par rgyu ba/ shin tu rgyu ba/ rab tu rgyu ba dang lnga ste/ de dag kyang gnas tha dad du 'dod kyang rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i 'dus mdo der/ rlung gi ngo bo ro gcig tu gnas pa rlung gtum mo yin gsung*/ thig le gtum mo ni rtsa gsum gyi 'dus mdo der gtum mo sum khrid la sogs pa'i dmigs pa gang rung zhig bsgoms pas ye shes kyi me 'bar te/ spyi bo'i haṃ la byang chub kyi sems babs te/ thams cad gnas der zhu nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'byung ste/ de ltar yang he badzra las/ lte bar gtum mo spar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs nas// spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs pas// sreg pa ri bong can haṃ 'dzag /ces gsungs pas/ de yang rdo rje'i lus 'di la phyi'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad bzhugs shing*/ lus 'di nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gdod ma nas rang chas su grub pa la/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs par 'gyur te/ de las gzhan pa'i mchod bya zhig logs na grub pa med gsung*/ de la dgongs nas/ rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la gtum mo sgom pa bas bsod nams che ba med gsung*/ de lta bu'i rten 'brel de yang spyir lus la rtsas gar khyab pa na rlung gis khyab/ rlung gis gar khyab pa na thig les khyab/ thig les gar khyab pa na bde ba des khyab ste/ de yang he badzra las/ bde ba dkar po bde ba dmar// bde bas rgyu dang mi rgyu khyab// ces gsungs pas/ de yang bde ba skye bar byed pa'i gnas ni 'dus mdo de nyid yin te/ dper na ra lug rnams ri la rtsa gram yang ra rdzis 'ubs kyis bsdus nas tshang du 'dzud cing ra lug gi gnas kyang tshang de nyid yin pa ltar/ thig le'i gnas kyang de nyid yin gsung*/ de ltar yang*/ he badzra las/

lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gnas// ces gsungs/ de ltar na gnas der rtsa rlung thig le gsum dbye ba med par gnas pa de la rnal 'byor ma zhes bya/ yum chen mo zhes bya ste/ yang dgyes pa rdo rje las/ de nyid bcom ldan shes rab ma// de dang lhan cig phyag rgya che// bsgoms na bde sbyin dngos grub thob// gsungs so// de yang gtum mo rnam pa gsum po de bsgoms pas khams dgu dwangs snyigs bye nas dwangs mas lus khyab pas rtogs pa skyed cing*/ snyigs ma bu ga dgu nas phyir 'don pa yin/ de la lus kyi 'khrul 'khor sems kyi dmigs pa/ rlung gi man ngag gsum ma 'dzom na yon tan mi skye bas/ 'khrul 'khor ni thabs 'ga' byas te dmigs pa gsum gang gsal ba bsgoms la rlung phyir lan gsum bud nas/ de nas nang du 'brog skud tsam zhig rngubs te mchu mi rtsum/ de yang mgrin par mnan na mid 'chus/ snying gar mnan na snying rlung*/ pho bar mnan na skran du 'gro bas/ des na yul der mnan na phar 'khor te/ dper na sbud pa bus pa dang 'dra gsung*/ de'i dus su me mgrin pa na yar 'ong ste/ 'byung drags pa yin pas glod/ rlung phyir btong dus su sgra dang bcas kha nas btang na khrag dang chus ser mgrin par 'tshangs nas nad du 'gyur bas dal bus sna na phar btang*/ btang ma thag tu mi bsdu bar skabs su dkrug 'khor gsum gsum tsam bya gsung*/ de ltar yun ring du bsgoms nas bogs 'don pa ni/ dkyil krung bcas rtsa dhu tī non par byas nas khu tshur bcang pa brla khug tu bsnol nas gong ltar du bsgoms pas rlung ma thub pa'i dus su/ 'khrul 'khor byas pas rlung je ring je ring la nyin zhag gsum gsum bzhi bzhi bdun la sogs pa zin gsung*/ yang 'khrul 'khor de ltar byas pas rlung sems lte ba'i 'og tu tshud/ lte ba yan chad gtsang sing gis 'byung ste/ bde ba skye ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa 'di las 'byung gsung*/

yang de byas na snying gi dbus su gnas te mi rtog pa skye gsung*/ de yang sngon nga 'bu phag mo gru na yod dus na/ chos rjes bka' shog la chas dril ba zhig dge slong rdo rje dpal la bskur ba las kyang*/ bde sbyin ting 'dzin mi gnas pa// lus ngag yid gsum rnam par g.yengs// gzhan rgyud byin gyis mi brlobs pas// bsgom bsal chab la mi gsol zhu// zhes pa gnang ste/ de'i don yang lte 'og ting nge 'dzin yin/ 'di la gnas na bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu chen po des/ chos la yang skad skad krig krig med kyang gzhan rgyud byin gyis brlob nus shing*/ yon tan skye bar byed nus te/ dper na zhu byas dngos grub la sgom zhu byas pas da de tsug bya zer bas slob ma la sgom skyes skad de/ de'i byin rlabs lags mod/ de min na da de tsug bya bya ba'i chos 'ong ba med/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ gnas ther zug med pa'i zhu byas la// bde stong la rgyun chad med do skad// dgon pa yod skad kyang ma thos so// gsung ste/ de yang zhu byas te sgo zhig la bsod snyoms blangs te des ma byin pa'am ma 'grangs kyang gzhan du mi slong bar grog por nyal zhing smyung bar gnas pa la bzhugs te/ khong gis lte 'og gi ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes pa yin gsung*/ yang bde bar gshegs pa'i zhal lnga nas/ za tsha med gsol ba'i mi la la// mkha' 'gro'i sprin tshogs 'du 'o skad// gtor ma yod skad ma thos so// gsungs te/ khrag zul dang zan bra ba'i rna cog tsam gyi gtor ma la 'du ba ma lags/ bde sbyin gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnad du song ba las byung ba yin gsung*/ mdor na ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnad du song ba'i dus na phyi nang gnyis shes te/ phyi gdul bya'i phung po dang*/ khams dang skye mched la sogs pa thams cad shes/ nang rdo rje lus 'di'i spyi bo nas rkang pa'i mthil gyi bar du gnas lugs shes shing phyi'i snang ba thams cad dbang du 'dus te/

'brug sgra ltar grags pas sa steng khyab pa ste/ sku'i bkod pa chu la mi bying ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i snyan pas sa steng khyab par 'byung*/ thun cig bsgoms pas kyang gzhan gyi snang ba 'gyur/ 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ltar 'ong*/ des na rtsa rlung thig le dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas bla na med pa'i byang chub tshe gcig gis bde blag tu thob cing 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pas 'gro don phun sum tshogs pa lhun gyis 'grub pa 'byung ba lags pas bu rnams kyis de ltar thugs la gzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags lus gtso bor ston pa yin/ de yang lha cig tu bsgom pa la zer ba ma lags/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor rtsa rlung thig le la sogs pa la brten nas yon tan mngon sum du skye ba la zer ba lags/ de'i nyams len tho rangs gnad che/ dge sbyor ma skyes pa yang tho rangs skye/ bogs ma thon pa yang tho rangs thon/ grub chen brgyad dang sangs rgyas kyi bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang tho rangs thob ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan rdo rje'i lus 'di la pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis mi gtsang ba'i rdzas kyis gang bar 'dod kyang*/ sngags kyi lugs kyi dag pa'i lus su grub par 'dod pa la mi gtsang ba zhig spangs nas gtsang ba zhig sgrub rgyu med/ dper na gser rdo dang dngul rdo la gser dngul gnas pa dang 'dra/ de yang nyin par gyi sems can thams cad kyis bza' btung byas pa rnams/ me rlung gis dwangs snyigs phye nas/ snyigs ma dri chen dang dri chu phyir 'dor/ dwangs mas rtsa dmigs rnams la khyab cing shes pa gsal ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las su rung ba la sogs pa'i sngags kyi yon tan thams cad des skyed pa lags mod/ de yang la la dag shes pa thom pa dag zas dang khar mi len pa byung na bad kan du 'dod de/

de yang yin mod kyis gtso cher me rlung gyis dwangs snyigs ma phyed pa lags mod/ de phyed na chu dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan gsal ba ltar ting nge 'dzin gsal gsung*/ de yang rje mi la'i zhal nas kyang*/ sdong po dgu 'dus kyi rtsa ba na// nad dug lnga sel ba'i sman cig yod// de len nam mi len khyed rang shes/ gsung*/ de gang yin na 'byung ba bzhi 'dus pa 'dir dbang po lnga'i yul lnga bsdams nas bsgoms pas thabs thig le byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba la dgongs pa yin/ de yang jo mo lha rje ma gzugs mdzes pa zhig yod de/ bla ma rtsa mi lo tsā ba'i zhabs tog phyag rgya ma mdzad de/ bla'i zhal nas cha lugs bud med rang gis chog gsung nas de ltar yod skad/ der lo dgu zhabs tog byas nas mthar bla ma nyid grongs nas jo mos gdams ngag nyams su len cing bzhugs pas/ yon tan chen po skyes pa la skabs shig dwangs ma nyams nas/ yon tan skye 'phro chad/ de yang jo mo de nyid ma la las sgrol mar 'dod pa yod/ la las rdo rje rnal 'byor mar 'dod pa yod kyang skyon byung dus su grongs pa la thug gsung*/ de'i dus su la stod ding ri dam pa rgya gar gyi spyan sngar byon nas ka ra sla nga tsam zhig phul te/ nga'i rtsa ba'i bla ma ni smar lo tsā ba yin/ lo dgu'i bar du bsten cing zhabs tog byas pa la/ bla ma mi bzhugs nas rang gcig pu dge sbyor bskyangs pas skyon 'di lta bu zhig byung sel bar zhu zhus pas/ 'ongs dag ka ra la dri bo gsung nas/ ka ra la mo na re 'di skad zer ces gsungs nas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams ka ra la dris pas/ ka ra mi smra bar 'dug gsung nas bor nas btang*/ de nas bu ram ltang khras lug gzugs tsam zhig phul nas zhus pas kyang sngar skad gsung nas skyur nas btang*/ de nas yang gu gul de tsam zhig phul nas zhus pas kyang de snyan la bslan nas dri byung 'dug skad/ der gu gul gyis smra bar 'dug ste/

dam nyams ma khyod nga'i rtsar ma sdod par phyir khyed gsung*/ der thal mo sbyar nas ngas dam tshig nyams pa'i las ma bgyis na gang tsug lags zhus pas/ de khyod kyis dbang zhus nas dbang yon ma phul bar 'dug pa gsung skad/ nga rang phul ba lags zhus pas/ da khyod kyi ming po zha ma dkon mchog gis rta nag po gcig rin du zos nas 'dug pa gsungs/ de rin du byin pa min yang ming po la byin pas rin du song 'dug gsung skad/ 'o na da bshags pa'i thabs zhu zhus pas/ 'o na da bshags pa'i thabs tshogs 'khor chen po byed dgos gsung*/ ding ri na bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams la 'tshal lam zhus pas/ des mi 'ong gsung*/ 'o na ci tsam 'tshal zhus pas/ zan gron phor gang dang bya mo'i sgo nga gcig dgos gsung*/ de khyer nas byon pa dang*/ phyed dam pas gsol/ phyed btsun mo la gnang nas 'dis lo gsum skyon kheg nas 'ong de nas yang 'ong bar 'dug ste/ mdo rgyud la ltos dang skyon las grol nas 'ong gsungs pas/ des gsungs pa kho na ltar 'byung ste/ rtsang rong du gnas chung zhig tu mdo gzigs pas 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud nas/ skye ba med las thams cad skyes// skyes tsam nyid na'ang skye ba med// ces pa gzigs pas/ rgyal te skyon las grol zhing yon tan chen po skyes te/ grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mor gyur pa lags par gda'/ rdo rje gdan du mchod pa byed pa'i dus su nam mkha' la 'do li'i steng na mar skor ba byed pa na rtsa mi lo tsā bas gzigs te/ a bi bod la grub thob med snyam rtsa na/ yod par 'dug bud med sham bu khra shig ge ba zhig nam mkha' la byon pa mthong gsung skad/ de yang grub thob mar bzhugs pas thams cad kyis zhal bltar 'ong bas/ yul pa la bzan par byung pas/ gtso bo rnams kyis gzhan du bzhud par zhu zer phyin pas mi snang*/ nye gnas ma la a ne gar song dris pas ya gi yin zer bas gdung sna la phug ron zhig tu snang skad/

chos zhus pa'i tshe na ngas bsgom nyams su blangs pa zhig yin a bus bsgom rdog tu sgril ba zhig yin gsung skad/ des na skyes bu kun yon tan thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i rtsa ba dwangs ma kho na yin/ rtsa ba med na yal ga dang lo 'dab me tog dang 'bras bu mi 'byung ba ltar/ rtsa ba dwangs ma 'di med na/ rtags dang yon tan mi 'byung bas rtsa ba'i srung bran gal che/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yang 'di yin te/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa med na mdze nad dang sha kra dang dmu chu mid 'chus la sogs pa'i nad dang bar chad la sogs thams cad 'byung ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yod na skyon de thams cad mi 'byung zhing yon tan phun sum tshogs pa 'byung gsung*/ des na skyes bu rnams bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bya ba'i khro bo/ sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gyis khyad par du byas pa zhig phyi rol na yod pa ma lags/ de ltar mi bsam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rang la gnas pa yin/ 'di ma nyams na dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi srog snying zin pa yin pas/ 'phrin las thams cad dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis sgrub pa yin/ de yang rje btsun chen pos lo drug tu thabs lam bsgoms kyang drod ma skyes pas/ de la mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan te/ thabs 'gal 'khrul 'khor zhes kyang bya/ tsog pu'i 'khrul 'khor zhes kyang bya/ la phyi gangs kyi 'khrul 'khor zhes pa de byas pas drod dang yon tan thams cad skyes skad/ re zhig na gnas chung zhig tu byon pas bsnyen bskur byas/ dad par gyur nas rje btsun dbu rtse'i nang du bcug nas bsnyen bskur byas sgo la lcags bcug ste 'di nas gar yang mi bzhud pa zhu/ nged kyi bshos gsol gyin bla mchod mi mdzad re dbu bsnyung bzhes par zhus pas/ zhal kyos bzhes nas khyed gsung ba ltar mi byed na rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mgo tshal par khos zhes/

dbu snyung bzhes skad/ de nas phyir byon na bza' rjes nas shad kyis bros pa dang*/ nye gnas kyis de ltar mdzad na dbu snyung de mi bzhes pa yin te zhus pas/ ngas mkha' 'gro ma'i mgo phar la ma khos na mkha' 'gro mas tshur la mi 'gas gsung*/ 'on kyang cung zad lon pa dang dbu 'gas pa tsam du snyung pa'i tshe/ bud med 'chi ma rtsa re ba 'ga' byung ste/ da zhig shos su dmigs pa smod zer ba dang dbu'i snyung ba de skad cig gis sos skad/ mdor na de rnams thams cad bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gnad yin pas/ gnad de go bar byas nas nyams su len par zhu/ yang bsngo ba zhig bya// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir sgom chen pa bya bas/ lus nyams/ sems nyams/ rmi lam nyams gsum shes dgos gsung*/ de yang lus nyams lus kyis ci byed pa dang*/ sems nyams sems kyis ci bsams pa dang lags te/ de'i dus su bcu chos dang sum chos gnad du bsnun gsung*/ rmi lam nyams la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga rmi lam la mkhas pa yin gsung ba ni/ rmi lam 'od gsal du 'dzin pa la gsung ba yin/ nga rmi lam bsgyur ba la mkhas gsung ba ni/ bzang po ngan par mi bsgyur ba dang*/ ngan pa thams cad bzang por bsgyur ba de shes dgos pa lags/ de la rmi lam rmi ba thams cad 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gsum las skye ba snga ma phan chad dang*/ da ltar ci byed bzhin pa dang*/ phyi ma ci byed dgos pa dang*/ tshe stod la sogs pa'i bag chags 'ba' zhig rmi ba yin la/ rang re sgom chen pa kun gyis rmi lam du 'od gsal zin pa yang bag chags yin/ spyir yang bag chags bsgrub pa dang*/ 'dag par byed pa gnyis las/ chos drug gis bag chags bsgrub pa lags pas nyin par gtum mo dang sgyu lus bsgom/ nub mo rmi lam dang 'od gsal 'dzin pa gal che/ gnyis pa phyag rgya chen pos bag chags 'dag par byed pa yin gsung*/ spyir rmi lam 'dzin pa yang rung mi 'dzin pa yang rung ste rmi lam gyis legs nyes bsgrub pa 'di shin tu myur ba yin gsung*/

de rmi lam zin pa'i gang zag cig gis rmi lam du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'am/ bla ma dam pa dang yi dam gyi lha la sogs pa zhal mthong nas de nyid rang du yan lag bdun pa cig byas nas/ rang la bstim de nas lnga ldan la gnad du bsnun pas/ yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du bogs thon cing*/ zhal yang yang mthong bar 'gyur te/ de la rmi lam 'byongs pa dang zin pa zer ba lags/ lo dang zla bar yang rmi lam phogs re mi zin pa la bsgom chen pa'i ming med/ zin na yon tan thams cad 'byung ste/ rmi lam thun gcig zin na sgom chen zhag bdun 'tsho bya ba gsung*/ rmi lam ma zin pas gnyid sad ma thag tu 'khrul 'khor ma zhig pa la/ lam gtong la sogs pa lnga ldan la gnad du bsnun/ de yis yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur/ 'khrul 'khor 'gyur nas bcos shin tu dka' gsung*/ yang ngan pa mi ma yin nam/ kha'i dbugs 'phrog khong pa'i srog gcod pa rmis kyang*/ rmi lam 'byongs pa des rmi lam du shes shing bdag gi rmi lam ngan pa 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ las dang nyon mongs pa shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur cig snyam du lam du btang*/ de nas sems bskyed/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom la phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag /bar chad dngos grub tu 'gyur/ skyon yon tan du 'char gsung*/ yang ri khrod la sogs par 'dug pa'i dus su/ dngos sam nyams kyi snang ba la mi ma yin pa la sogs pa'i gzugs kyis bar du gcod pa'i gzugs sam ltas 'jigs su rung ba rnams ston du byung na rang nyid skad cig gis yi dam lhar gsal lam gyis bsgom pa yin/ de la gsal bas lha'i nga rgyal bskyed pas skyon mi 'byung*/ yon tan du 'gyur ba la khong rang yi dam du 'gyur bsgom la spyi bo nas rang la bstim la/ cig shos su dmigs nas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas rang gi dbang du 'dus nas rtag tu gdong grogs byed par 'gyur te/

'di la bdud chos skyong du bsgyur ba'i gdams ngag zhes kyang bya/ bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i man ngag zer ba lags/ de la spyir phyi rol du 'dre'i gzugs la sogs pa mthong ba thams cad/ nang du rang gi bsam pa ngan pa stobs su gyur pa las byung ba yin te/ phyi rol na mthong rgyu dang bcas pa'i bgegs dngos por grub pa zhig mi bdog des cig shos bsam pa bzang po zab pa yin bgyi ba gsung*/ yang bla ma dang yi dam la sogs pa dngos su zhal mthong na/ der rang gi bsam pa dang mos gus stobs su gyur pa las byung ba lags pas/ yun ring por kha pog ge sdod pa min/ bsam pa bzang po de ma 'gyur pa la yan lag bdun pa bsdus pa tshar gcig phul nas/ rang gi spyi bo nas bstim la/ bde sbyin du bzhugs su bcug nas/ rang nyid phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par 'jog pa yin/ de ltar byas na rtag tu zhal mthong zhing byin gyis rlob pa yin/ de ltar ma byas na bar chod du 'gro ba yin te/ de yang sngon ye phug pas rta rna ru dpal phag mo gru pa zhal mthong ba la yun ring por mos gus byas pa la/ ci tsam zhig na spre'u zhig tu gyur nas mdun du phar rgyug tshur rgyug byas nas med skad/ de skyes bu rnams bla ma spre'ur 'gyur ba ga la srid/ nang du rang gyi bsam pa 'gyur bas bla ma spre'ur gyur pa lags mod/ de la bar chad byung zer ba yin/ de bas na bar chad 'byung mi 'byung gyi gnad cig nang nas sgrig ma shes par/ phyi'i hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs pa la re na des mi 'ong gsung*/ spyir gar 'dug pa'i sar yang sa gnyan brko ba dang shing gnyan gcod pa la sogs pa mi bya/ cig tu bar chad kyi rgyu yin/ gnyis su mi chog pa yin pas 'dul ba las kyang bkag pa lags mod/ de yang sngon 'phan yul gyi rgyam pa jo sras bya ba de bod phrug cig la shes rab che zhing chos kyang sngags dang mtshan nyid gnyis ka mkhyen/ rje rin po che'i yang thugs kyi sras yin pa la/

khong gis mang khung du dgon pa zhig tu bzhugs pa'i sgo kha na/ shing phung cig yod pa de'i zil chus gnod par byung nas/ nye gnas rdo rje dbang phyug la st+wa re rengs par khyer la shog gsungs nas khong rang gis bcad pa dang*/ shing de chod grab la rgyal ba'i skor bdag mo de da 'dzug byed zer nas brang rdung gin byung skad/ mos ma bzod par sbron du 'ongs par 'dug de'i grogs la bcos ma byas pas/ ltas ngan chen po bon gyis mi zlog pa byung gsung skad/ de nas grongs pa lags par gda'/ de la rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ khong gis go ma bcad bon gyis ma log yang rje'i gdam ngag gis log nas 'ong ba yin te/ nged 'bri gung pa gtam de'i 'og nas mi longs gsung*/ de'i dus su snang ba dang mi snang ba dang a cang yang ches te/ mdor na rang gi lus de min pa gang du bsgoms kyang chog ste/ de yang rta dang glang po la sogs pa'am/ yang na sa rdo shing gsum bsgoms kyang gnod pa las grol ba yin gsung*/ rje'i zhal nas kyang*/ snang ba sems su shes pa yi// ting nge 'dzin la bsam mi khyab// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i rjes la khyad yod pa ma gtogs pa/ rdo leb cig tu bsgoms kyang gnas skabs de'i skyon las grol gsung*/ khong gis yang de'i dus su gzhan ma byung yang rdo rje dbang phyug tu bsgoms kyang*/ gnod pa'i yul des mi mthong bas bar chad 'jug pa med pa lags/ yang sngon rje ye phug pa bya ba des lhong rdzong du dgon pa gsar pa zhig btab nas/ phyis khong rang dpon g.yog kha yar gyis byon pa'i la rtsar phyin pa dang*/ lhong rdzong gi brag gseb nas sbrul chen po zhig don nas mgo khong gi thugs khar btad pa zhig byung ba la 'khor rnams kyis 'ja' tshon du mthong skad/ de'i lo la khong grongs par gda'/ chos rje'i zhal snga nas/ khong grub thob yin yang de kun la bcos ye mi byed pa glen par byung*/ lhong rdzong pas bla ma'i zhabs 'dren du song gsung*/

des na skyes bu rnams rkyen byung dus su bla ma'i gdams ngag dran par byas nas phag sna'i gtun bu ltar gnad du bsnun dgos pa yin/ snang ba rang gi sems kyi gnad kyang 'di yin/ byol zor bsgyur gsum 'di shes na/ rnal 'byor pa nyes skyon bar chad dang bral ba lags pas/ de ltar du thugs la bzhag par zhu gsungs so// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir sgom chen pa kun gyi grub mtha' la lus rgya snang rgya rtog rgya gsum dang bral nas sangs rgyas bar 'dod pa 'di shas che ste/ 'o skol rang gi brgyud pa 'di yang rje sgam po pa'i bu slob rnams kyang 'di ltar bzhed skad de/ de yang gong gi chos thams cad 'dul bya'i rim pa dang sbyar nas rim pas gsungs pa lags par gda'/ dang po'i dus su nga'i 'khor sems ngo shes pa rnams dang*/ nga ni sa dang po'i bden pa mthong ba yin bya ba gsung*/ phyis dpal phag mo gru pa dang*/ lha stengs ka ba la sogs pa byon pa dang*/ kho bo rdo rje 'chang dngos yin/ nga'i 'khor rnams phal cher phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig yin bya ba gsung skad/ de yang dang po nas de skad gsungs na bka' gdams la sogs pa mang po dogs pas smra ma nus pa'i rigs su 'dug gsung*/ stag gi lo la phag mo grur byon nas kyang stag gi lo la mya ngan las 'das pa lags te/ de yang dang po tshogs pa'i stod la nub gling du lo drug bzhugs kyi bar la rtogs ldan skye ba mi len/ thod pa mgo la mi 'jog pa la sogs pa'i grub mtha' de rang gsungs pas/ bu slob rnams kyang de ltar bzhed pa lags par gda'/ nyin cig spyan snga nas nye gnas kha yar dang bcas pa shar gling gi stod du skyo bsang la byon pas/ mdo smad pa'i grwa pa zhig gis spyan drangs nas bu ram dang ja la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur mdzad pa la/ rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ khyod bsod nams bsags pa de lta bu'i dgon pa yod pa gsungs pas/

der kho na re 'di la thugs spyod na dbul zer bas/ zhal snga nas da thugs la btags/ nga'i mal stan rnams da lta rang khyer la shog gsungs nas de nub rang nas gzims/ de'i nang nas nye gnas me nyag ring mo thugs stobs che bas thams cad 'jag ma dang lbug ma len du btang*/ la las 'jim pa g.yos te/ de nyin rang la sgo dang zha la la sogs pa tshar ba'i gzims spyil zhig byas pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o shin tu legs/ khyed rnams kyis bsams pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'dug pas/ ming bsam grub me nyag ring mo bya bar thogs shig gsung skad/ de rnams ci la gleng slangs nas/ shar gling na bzhugs pa'i dus na grub mtha' en re 'gyur skad/ chos rje byon pa dang grub mtha' thams cad log gis 'gyur te/ grwa pa kun kyang grub mtha' 'gyur ta re gsung*/ dge bshes dmar pa dang*/ lha dgra rtsa ri ba'i lo rgyus kyang gsung*/ dang po'i grub mtha' ni/ de ltar sems skye med chos sku rtogs kyang*/ rgya gsum dang ma bral bas sangs rgyas pa ma yin te/ de la chos sku rtogs pas rnam par smin pa'i lus 'di la da lta na tsha la sogs pa byung yang shi ba'i dus su/ lus dang bral nas bsgoms pa'i 'od gsal dang rtogs pa'i 'od gsal gnyis dbyer med du 'dres nas sangs rgya/ yang da lta sems rtogs kyang rjes la dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang ba 'di 'chi ba'i dus su yul lnga gcig la gcig thim nas snang rgya dang bral nas sangs rgya/ yang rtogs rgya yang chos sku 'ba' zhig yin/ yang nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog sna tshogs su skye ba 'di/ 'chi ba'i dus su snang ba dang*/ mched pa dang*/ thob pa dang*/ nye bar thob pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rim pa ltar thim nas 'od gsal shar nas sangs rgya ste/ don la de'i dus su khyad par gyi gzhi lus med pas/ de'i khyad par gyi chos sems dang snang ba yang med cing*/ bar do 'od gsal gnyis po 'dres te/

dper na bum pa chags pa'i nam mkha' dang gnyis 'dres pa ltar/ chos sku zang thal la 'khyil gyis song nas gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis po 'phrin las dang bcas pa mi 'dod de/ mdor na nam shi sangs rgyas/ thod pa mgo la mi 'jog rtogs ldan skye ba mi len par 'dod skad/ phyis chos rje rin po che byon nas dus cig na tshogs chos la sngar skye med rtogs nas rgyu 'bras mi 'dod pa la/ de'i nyin par a 'thas su nyams su blangs pa dang*/ mnyam rjes dang zung 'jug mthar phyin pa'i dus dang*/ nyams su len tshul rnam pa bzhir gsungs shing*/ rgya gsum dang yang da lta ma bral bar bar ma dor 'bral ba la des na kho thag chad/ ces pa la sogs pa'i grub mtha' byon pas/ rje rin po che'i thugs dgongs la chos 'di la 'phro yod pa la snyam yang zhu ma nus gsung*/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum yang tha ma zab pa ltar/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i chos kyang mya ngan las 'da' khar gsungs pa 'di zab gsung*/ de yang rje rin po che'i bzhed ni da lta skye shi bar do 'di nyid rang la lus lus med phyag rgya chen por ma rtogs na/ rnam smin gyi lus dang bral yang bar do yid kyi lus bya ba 'di bas dam pa yod pa yin la/ snang rgya yang da lta snang ba snang med du rtogs/ snang rgya dang bral la/ de min na snang ba yang bar do 'di bas rags pa yod la/ rtog rgya yang da lta rtog pa rtog med du shes na rtog rgya las grol la/ de ltar min na bar dor 'di bas rags pa'i rtog pa ldang gsung*/ de na skyes bu rnams rgya gsum dang da lta rang nas 'bral dgos pa lags te/ de dang bral ba'i dus su rtogs pa'i 'od gsal dang*/ bar do'i 'od gsal dang*/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal dang gsum dbyer med du gyur nas sangs rgya/ de ltar yang*/ 'od gsal ba ni rgyun par gnas/ bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// gzhan don gzugs sku'i snang ba 'byung*// zhes gsungs te/

mdor na smon lam dang thugs rje'i dbang gis/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los sems can gyi don du gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul du 'khor ba dpag tu med par skye ba len pa 'byung ba lags pas de ltar thugs la bzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa'i tshul rnam pa gnyis yin gsung*/ de yang khong thos bsam pa rnams sgro 'dogs phyi nas gcod pa'i lugs yin zhing*/ bka' dang bstan bcos la sogs pa'i tshig dang tha snyad kyi nyan bshad mang po dang*/ dpe cha mang po'i lung rtog dang*/ bsam mno la sogs pa'i dka' ba du ma spyad nas mkhas pa paṇḍi ta lta bur gyur kyang nang gi sems la ma bltas par shes pa phyir yan pas/ des rtsa ba 'chugs pa'i gnad kas tshe thung ba dang*/ nad mang ba dang*/ longs spyod chung bar 'gyur/ nad kyang mdze dang skran dang dmu chu dang snying rlung la sogs rnams 'byung la/ de ltar skyon ma byung yang phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga dang*/ gnas dus kyi bskal nas/ longs spyod dang 'byor pa chung zhing rtag tu bkren par 'gyur ro// mdor na tshig dang tha snyad la mkhas kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa tsam ma gtogs pa 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las mi thar gsung*/ 'o skol rnal 'byor pa ku su lu pa rnams kyi lugs kyis/ sgro 'dogs rtse gcig tu sems kyi nang nas gcod pa lags te/ de la rtsa ba sems las med pa'i gnad kas/ sems nang du gnas pa la tshe ring ba dang nad med pa la sogs pa longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung bas na/ bskyed rim lha'am rdzogs rim phyag rgya chen po'am/ gtum mo la sogs pa gang la mos pa de bsgom pa yin/ de yang rje rin po che'i phyag len rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa 'di'i nyams len ni/ byang chub kyi sems nyid dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin te/

de la dang po kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ brtul zhugs chen pos de nyid la rtse gcig tu ma yengs par bsgom/ de'i tshe byams pa dang snying rje la sogs pa'i sems skyes kyang bar chad yin la/ zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i sems skye ba lta smos kyang ci dgos/ des na byang chub kyi sems la rtse gcig pa de brtan pa ri bo'am zab pa rgya mtsho ltar bsgoms pas/ dang po nas mnyam par 'jog pa dka' yang*/ thun dkyil tsam du sleb pa dang rlung nang du bzlog de yang rlung lnga'i dwangs ma dang shes pa 'dres nas/ dbang po lnga lam byung ste/ yul lnga la 'jug cing gzung 'dzin dang chags sdang rmongs gsum skye ba de nang du log pas/ rlung des byang chub kyi sems stobs rgyas nas zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'gyur/ de ltar gyur pa'i dus su byang chub kyi sems de nyid lhar bskyed de/ des na bdag nyid chen po'i gsang gnas su dbang gi rgyal po'i bla ma bsgom// ces gsungs pas/ gsang gnas ni snying gi dbus yin la/ dbang gi rgyal po ni chos rje bsgom dgos pa lags mod/ de ltar yang zhal snga nas/ rang rdo rje 'chang du ma gyur tshe// brgyud pa gong ma ma gtogs pa// rang 'khor la bsgom du ma 'jug cig /'khrul pa la nying 'khrul non nyen gda'// gsungs pas/ zhal mthong ma mthong med/ gsung thos ma thos med/ dri med chos sku phyag rgya chen po rtogs par byed pa'i lha/ 'gro ba'i bla ma gcig pu yin pas bsgom pa lags/ de nas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa yin/ de la byang chub kyi sems dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin zer ba lags// de la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas/ nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs rgyas nas nyi ma nub phyogs su 'gro ba 'am/ chu bo gzhol phyogs su 'bab pa ltar/ dge sbyor gyi ngang la shugs kyis 'gro bar 'gyur/ de ltar byung ba'i dus su a re dga'/

tho le rgyal byas la zas bzang po bza'/ gos 'jam pa gon/ grogs mthun pa rnams bos pas mi 'ong*/ ting nge 'dzin skye dus skyong dgos pa yin/ skong bu dros dus phyi dgos pa yin/ 'dod yon la ma 'byam par sgrub pa byas dang*/ skyes bu rnams mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob nas/ rang gzhan gyi dgos 'dod thams cad 'grub cing*/ bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yang des rdzogs pa yin/ de rnams thams cad nang du sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i byin rlabs lags pas khyed rnams kyis de ltar thugs la gzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'jig rten mgon pos dam pa'i chos bgyi ba'i don mthar thug pa de gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa 'di lags/ de yang rdo rje'i go ba ji lta bu zhig yin snyam na/ rdo rje bgyi ba de ni mi 'gyur zhing dngos po gzhan gyis gzhig cing gzhom par mi nus pa zhig la zer ba yin te/ de ltar yang*/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med/ */sreg cing bcad du med pa dang*/ gzhig cing gzhom du med pas te/ */stong pa nyid ni rdo rjer bshad/ */ces gsungs pa de gshis yin/ de lta bu'i gshis de rtogs par byed pa la/ nged ku sā li pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i lugs kyis/ nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ thabs mkhas pa dang shes rab zab mo gnyis su byas na 'du la/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis thabs kyi rgyal po pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyal mo ma rgyud sgyu ma bde mchog la sogs pa dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs te/ mdor na sngags rgyud sde bzhi/ theg pa rim pa dgu la sogs pa bstan pa thams cad kyang thabs shes rab gnyis su 'dus la/ de rnams thams cad kyi don/ de nyid rgyud la skye bar byed pa la theg pa chen po gsang sngags su dbang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig thob dgos pa lags/ de la bya ba'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur bas 'bras bu lha mi'i go 'phang thob/

spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur bas rig pa 'dzin pa thob/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang bskur bas 'khor los bsgyur ba thob/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dbang bskur bas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob ste/ blo gros 'jug pa las/ dang po lha mi'i go 'phang thob// gnyis pa rig pa 'dzin pa ste/ gsum pa 'khor los bsgyur ba thob// bzhi pa dngos grub kun gyi gter// zhes gsungs pas te/ de lta bu'i dbang de yang rab bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor las thob dgos pa lags mod/ de ltar yang chos rje'i zhal nas/ rje btsun sku'i dkyil 'khor las// dbang yongs su rdzogs pa mang du zhus// gsung pa dang*/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas kyang lus kyi dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsungs pa lags mod/ 'bring bgyi ba de ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las thob pa dgos pa lags/ dbang bskur tha ma ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas thob par gsungs/ de yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa ni phyogs gcig nas ngo mtshar che yang*/ gong ma rnams la ltas na sngags kyi snod du rung ba tsam yin gsung*/ de la 'di'i skabs su gtam rgyud 'di gsungs par gda' ste/ sngon bsam yas bzhengs pa'i dus su/ snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad kyis rtsig dbang ma byung pa la/ slob dpon pad ma sambha ba rgya gar nas byon nas snang srid kyi lha ma srin sde brgyad rnams btul nas dpal nā len dra la dpe byas nas bsam yas bzhengs par gda'/ de la bod khams kyi rten 'brel yang bzhugs shing*/ ka ba stong rtsa gnyis yod pa de yang bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis 'byon pa'i rten 'brel yin gsung*/ des na bstan pa'i bya ba slob dpon gyis dpag tu med pa mdzad nas/ slar rgya gar du phar bzhud pa'i dus su/ rgyal po dang btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa skyel chung byas pa la/

btsun mo gnyis kyis bal yul yang le shod kyi brag phug tu bskyal/ sang nas slob dpon rgya gar du bzhud pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ ngas do nub khyed gnyis la dbang zhig bskur bas srod la dril bu sil zer rtsa na jo mo cog ro bza' rang tshur shog /tho rangs sil zer rtsa na jo mo mkhar che bza' mtsho rgyal rang tshur shog gsung skad/ der srod la dril bu byung ba dang cog ro bza' spyan sngar phyin pa dang*/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor/ phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum nam mkha' la lam me sprul nas gda' skad/ der slob dpon gyis khyod nga las dbang len nam ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las dbang len gsungs pas/ jo mo'i zhal nas slob dpon las de snga yang blangs/ phyis kyang blangs pas chog pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las dbang len zer ba dang*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas khyod nga las mi len par/ nga'i sems kyi cho 'phrul las dbang len gsung nas/ zhal gnag gting gis song skad/ der dbang bskur gdams ngag bcas pa bstan nas bstod pa dang skul ba la sogs pa ni 'jigs 'jigs ni che zhing byin brlabs ni chung ba lags par gda'/ yang tho rangs dril bu sil zer ba dang jo mo mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gyis byon pa dang dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum sngar ltar sprul nas gda' skad/ der slob dpon gyi sngar ltar khyod dbang gang las len gsungs pa dang*/ jo mo'i zhal nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor las sngar yang blangs pa yin/ da phyis kyang blangs pas chog pa yin/ nga 'bu slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor nyid las dbang len zhus pas/ der slob dpon yang mnyes gdams ngag yang zab la byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa yin/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi nyung dkar 'bru bdun gnang nas 'di tsho btug gis thug pa'i dus cig byung na nga'i phyogs su gtor la thong cig yar lung shel gyi brag phug tu sgrub pa gyis shig

tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi dngos grub thob nas nga dang mjal nas 'ong gis gsung*/ de nas jo mos de kho na ltar sgrub pa byed bzhin bzhugs pa'i dus su pha ming gis bag mar btang bas khug po byung ba la thabs gzhan med nas/ de'i dus su sngar yungs dkar gnang nas sdug bsngal byung dus su gtor la thong gsungs pa de dran nas/ de 'di la dgongs pa yin snyam nas slob dpon gyi phyogs su gtor bas sku'i steng du babs nas/ der slob dpon gyis phung byed sbas ma bzhi dang*/ khro bo arya a tsa la btang bas/ khro bos pho lha'i 'gram pa bcag ma bzhis rta'i sug pa bzhi nas btegs nas lho brag mkhar chur bskyal nas/ der sgrub pa mdzad pas mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ slob dpon gyi spyan sngar phyin te da lta yang bzhugs pa lags par gda'/ jo mo cog ro bza' ni phyis grir shi/ chos kyang byin brlabs kyi brgyud pa min/ jo mo mkhar chen bza' mtsho rgyal gyi brgyud pa ni a ce snya nam bza' dbang phyug sgron ma yin la/ de nas brgyud pa'i phur pa ni chos rje'i yab ye shes kyi thugs dam yin/ chos kyi rje nyid kyang thugs dam mdzad pa lags te/ de rnams ci la gleng bslang bgyis par gyur na/ dbang bskur bgyi ba de bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor las thob dgos pa yin pas/ dbang gi go ba ni rang sems la dbang thob pa'i don gyis na dbang bya ba yin/ sems chos kyi skur ma rtogs shing de la dbang ma thob na/ lha rigs mi gcig pa stong gi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs/ mgo thog tu rin po che gser dngul gyi bum pa brgya bzhag chu bo gaṅgās lus bkrus kyang dbang ma thob pa yin gsung*/ 'on kyang sngags kyi snod du rung bar byas pa tsam yin/ de nas dbang rnam par dag pa las rtogs pa'i don rang sems phyag rgya chen po chos kyi sku de lam thabs shes rab dbyer med du nyams su len pa yin te/ de la bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhi gnas pa sems can gyi dus/

lam sgom pa rnal 'byor gyi dus/ sgrib pa gsum spangs pa sangs rgyas kyi dus/ mdor na thams cad thabs dang shes rab kyi 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pa lags/ des na skyes bu rnams thabs bgyi ba de ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i pha rgyud ma rgyud rnams dang*/ de'i nyams len gyi gnad bsdus pa gdams ngag rin po che rnams na yod pa yin snyam du mi dgongs/ thabs bgyi ba de rang re nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skye ba dang 'gag pa dang gnas pa'i cha/ mdor na rnam par rtog pa'i bye brag ji snyed cig yod pa de thabs yin/ shes rab ni de'i rang bzhin skye 'gag la sogs pa dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu lags te/ dper na nam mkha' la phan 'dogs pa dang gnod pa skyel ba'i yul las 'das pa lags/ mtshon dkar nag gang gis kyang gos pa med pa yin/ sprin dang khug sna la sogs pa gang gis kyang sgrib par mi nus pa ltar sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa la phan gnod de las dang las kyi 'bras bu la sogs pa gang gis kyang sgrib pas mi gos pas na shes rab zab mo zer ba lags/ de ltar yang rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar nam mkha' kun stong pa// phra phyir nyes pas gos pa med// de bzhin sems can thams cad la// gnas 'dir nyes pas gos pa med// bgyi ba gsung*/ der ma zad rgya che bar bstan na stong gsum gyi stong chen po mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya'am shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams nam mkha' dang mnyam pa rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings kyi bklas pa/ mdor na dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba thams cad thabs yin/ de'i rang bzhin phyag rgya chen po gcig tu shes pa de shes rab yin la/ de tshur la 'ubs kyis bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas na/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis su 'dus pa yin te/ bskyed rim thabs/ rdzogs rim shes rab/ bskyed rim nyid rdzogs rim/

rdzogs rim nyid bskyed rim la sogs te de ltar yang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas sgyu ma lta bu'i lha sku bsgom gsungs pas/ de ltar zung 'jug dbyer med du rtogs par byed pa la pho nya'i lam pa dang mos gus kyi lam pa gnyis yin gsung*/ pho nya'i lam pa de rje btsun chen po yan chad la mnga' yang rje btsun chen po man chad nas bka' rgya mdzad nas tshul khrims dang yon tan bskyed pa'i lam yin gsung*/ de la mos gus de yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku yin snyam du mos gus dang 'dun pa btung btung po'i stobs su gtong ba yin te/ da phrug pha mas gdungs pa'am/ bkres pa zas kyis gdungs pa'am/ bskaum pa chus gdungs pa lta bur bla ma dang skad cig tsam yang ma 'bral bar bya/ thabs bya ba der 'dus so// de ltar mos gus la stobs btang ba'i dus su shes rab bya ba de'i ngang nas ched du sgrub mi dgos te lhun grub tu 'byung*/ de la dus kyi sna rtse zhes bya/ sems kyi gsang zhes bya/ de'i tshe bla ma rtogs ldan zhig gis ngo sprad na/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho la phyi phyag byas nas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po gcig tu rtogs nas mchi/ lar skyes bu rnams gang la yang nyams nga bya mi dgos/ yang khrol gyis btang bas chog legs nyes dang bde sdug mtho dman thams cad chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po'i cho 'phrul 'ba' zhig yin/ de la bdag gzhan dang bral ba'i tshul gyi mnyam bzhag chen po'i ngang la phyams kyis zhog mdzod cig de'i ngang sgyu ma'am rmi lam gyi tshod tsam du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs sgo du ma nas bsags 'tshal gsung*/ sems bskyed/ bsngo ba dang smon lam la sogs pa yangs shing mu med par bsgrub par bya/ de nyid ni nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa bgyi bar mchi ba lags/ lar mang po'i chos mi zin pas/ 'o skol sgom chen pa ni tshig tu nyung la don du 'dril ba zhig gal che ba yin/

dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ lar na sgom chen pa'i chos la sa bcad gdab rgyu dang*/ skad skad krig krig mang po mi 'tshal/ sems la gang phan phan ston pa yin/ sems la ma phan na po ti byung shad shes kyang mi phan gsung*/ lar dge 'dun rnams/ rang la yon tan med na brgyud pa bzang yang mi phan/ chos nyams su ma blangs na gdams ngag zab kyang mi phan pas/ 'di lta bu'i chos 'di dang por go dgos pa lags/ go nas thugs nyams su bzhes 'tshal bas/ bu rnams thugs la de ltar bzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis sems can thams cad thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug nas thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa yang sems can gyi don bsags/ tha ma rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa yang sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas nas bka' 'khor lo rim pa gsum bskor ba yang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rim par bskor ba ste/ de yang sems can gyi rgyud la nyon mongs pa 'dod chags las gyur pa nyi khri chig stong*/ zhe sdang las gyur pa nyi khri chig stong*/ gti mug las gyur pa nyi khri chig stong*/ dug gsum cha mnyam pa las gyur pa nyi khri chig stong ste/ mdor na nyon mongs pa brgyad bzhi stong gi gnyen por/ chos kyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa lags te/ de la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ gzungs kyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'du'o// de las bsdus par gyur na nyon mongs pa de rnams thams cad kyang rtsa ba dug gsum du 'dus pas nas/ chos kyi sgo de rnams kyang bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum du 'dus la/ rjod byed sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum du 'dus so// de yang rjod byed 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi brjod bya lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa bstan pa de nyams su blangs pas nyon mongs pa rag pa 'dul bar byed pa yin la/

de bzhin du mdo sde ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa nyams su blangs pas nyon mongs pa phra ba 'dul bar byed pa yin/ mngon pa la phyi nang gnyis las/ nang mngon pa ni/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa yin pas/ des na rjod byed mngon pa'i sde snod kyi brjod bya lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa bstan pa de nyams su blangs pas/ nyon mongs pa phra ba dang bag la nyal dang bcas pa thams cad rtsa ba nas 'dag cing 'dul bar byed pa yin/ des skyes bu rnams sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad nyon mongs pa spong ba'am 'dul ba'i gnyen po 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pa lags mod/ de gang zag gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum ltar nyams su len pa yin/ de yang la la'i bzhed pa nyan thos kyi 'dul khrims/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa/ sngags kyi dam tshig gsum/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum ga mi gcig nyan thos kyi so so thar pa blangs nas de ma nyams par bsrungs pas 'bras bu dgra bcom pa thob/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ma nyams par bsrungs pas/ grangs med gsum gyis sprul sku thub chen lta bu thob/ sngags kyi rtogs lam dbang bskur nas lam du bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pas 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen po thob pa yin/ mi gcig zer ba yod de de so so'i 'dod pa yin/ 'dir chos rje'i bzhed pa sdom pa gsum po gang zag cig gi rgyud la rten 'brel gsum gyi tshul du gnad gcig par gsungs pa lags/ de la phyi nang rten 'brel gsum gnad gcig pa lags te/ de yang so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i ngo bo bcas pa dang rang bzhin gnyis las/ rang bzhin mi dge ba bcus sdug bsngal bskyed pas spang bya yin la/ gnyen po bcas pa des spang bya mi dge bcu spangs shing dge ba bcu bsgrub pa las mi bdog 'dul ba nas khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum bstan kyang don 'dir 'dus/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par yang mi dge bcu spong ba 'di sdom pa'i tshul khrims/
