dge ba bcu bsgrub pa de dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ spang sgrub gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gzhan gyi don byed pa de sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims yin/ mdor na bsam pa dang yul na 'phos pa ma gtogs pa so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang gcig pa lags/ pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas 'bring gsum/ sde tshan de dag gi don thams cad kyang 'dir 'dus te/ de ltar yang rgyas pa las/ bdag kyang srog gcod pa spangs pa yin te/ gzhan yang srog gcod pa spong ba yang dag par bskul lo// zhes pa la sogs pa rgya che bar gsungs nas gda' ba/ gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig tu yang mi dge bcu spong zhing*/ gnyen po dge ba bcu bsgrub par gsungs te/ smon lam dbang gi dam tshig 'bogs pa'i tshe na/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// zhes pa dang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje las kyang*/ dang po gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu sbyin// de nas bye brag smra ba bstan// mdo sde la'ang de bzhin no// de yi rjes la dbu ma bstan// sngags kyi yan lag kun shes nas// de rjes kye'i rdo rje brtsam// zhes gsungs pas/ dge ba bcus rgyud dag pa zhig ma gtogs par lam gong ma sngags kyi yon tan thams cad mi 'byung bas mdor na phyi rten 'brel kyang sdom pa gsum gnad gcig pa chos kyi gshis sam babs yin/ mi dge ba bcu mi spong ba'i chos de bzhin gshegs pas kyang gtan nas mi gsung ba yin/ 'dir chos rje'i bzhed pa/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa la nyes pas ma gos pa'i dus su dga' ba dang 'gyod pa med pa'i sems skye/ me long rnam par dag pa la gzugs gsal ba dang 'dra ste/ des ting nge 'dzin gang la mnyam par bzhag kyang zhog la/

sdom pa la nyes skyon byung ba'i gang zag des/ ting nge 'dzin gang la mnyam par bzhag kyang nyams grib bam mi dge ba'i mthus/ 'gyod pa dang bcas pa'i sems des/ blo rnam par g.yengs nas ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan mi 'byung ste/ me long g.ya' ma dag la gzugs mi gsal ba dang 'dra gsung*/ de ltar yang so so thar pa'i mdo las/ tshul khrims ldan pa dga' ba kun gyi gnas// zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ sdud pa las kyang*/ dga' dang 'dun pa bskyed pa myur du byang chub reg ces gsungs pas/ mdor na phyi rten dag pas na 'grub pa yin mod/ gnyis pa byang chub sems pa'i sdom par yang*/ tshul khrims la nyes pa la sogs ma gos pa'i dus su dga' ba'i sems skye/ sems de la ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par bya snyam pa la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye zhing brtan pa thob par 'ong ste/ de la byang chub sems kyi grub thob zer ba yin/ skyes bu rnams grub thob kyi go ba yang nam mkha' la 'phur shes pa la sogs pa la grub thob mi zer/ ri bo ltar byang chub kyi sems 'pho 'gyur med pa de la zer ba lags te/ dper na ri rab chen po rnam par mtho ba'i rlung gis bskyod mi nus pa'am/ rgya mtsho chen po 'dom dgu man chod mi g.yo ba dang 'dra zhing jo bo rjes snye thang du byams sgrol zhal gzigs pa lta bu lags/ lar ni tshul khrims la nyes pas gos na rtsa ba chad pa'i sdong po la myu gu dang sdong po la sogs pa mi 'byung ba ltar/ byang chub sems kyi yon tan la sogs pa gtan nas mi skye/ gsum pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom par yang tshul khrims la nyes pas ma gos shing 'gyod pa med pa'i sems de las/ sngags kyi yon tan dang dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba lags te/ de yang sngags zhes bgyi ba'i go ba yang dri ma 'khru ba dang nus pa 'jog pa gnyis yin te/ bum dbang gis lus lhar ngo sprad nas lus kyi sdom pa srog gcod pa la sogs pa gsum ma nyams pas/

lus bskyed rim lha'i rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob/ gsang dbang gi ngag sngags su ngo sprad nas ngag gi sdom pa tshig rtsub mo la sogs pa ma nyams pas/ ngag bzlas pa gsung gi 'khor lo la brtan pa thob/ dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa bskur bas sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chos kyi skur ngo sprad nas/ yid kyi sdom pa bsnabs sems dang gnod sems la sogs pa gsum ma nyams pas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la brtan pa thob te/ de lta bu yang rgyud dag pa kho na las 'byung la ma dag par gyur na dam tshig nyams pa'i mes yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad bsregs te/ slad lus bro gcong du 'gyur/ de ltar yang lung las/ tshul khrims 'chal pas sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// lar mdor bsdus par gyur na phyi rten 'brel tshul khrims rin po che la brten nas/ nang rten 'brel lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa rgyud la skye/ de nyid la ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan thams cad 'byung ste/ dper na chu dwangs pa la gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang ba dang 'dra gsung*/ des na sdud pa las/ tshul khrims kyis ni zhi ba 'dod rnams 'phags par 'gyur// stobs bcu'i spyod yul gnas shing tshul khrims nyams pa med// ces gsungs pas na/ sdom pa gsum gnad gcig pa lags mod/ gsum pa gsang ba rten 'brel kyang*/ sdom pa gsum gnad gcig pa yin te/ de yang byang chub kyi sems thig le kun da lta bu de yin/ 'di la so so thar pa dran shes bzhin du nyams na pham pa dang lhag ma gnyis phog ste/ pham pa ni sdom pa shor ba yin la/ lhag ma ni yul gnyis la bshags dgos shing*/ thun tshod las 'das na dge 'dun lhag ma'i sder 'gyur la/ sdom la/ mi tshangs spyod dang ces pa dang*/ khu ba 'dzin dang ces dang por bkag pa lags/ lar na gsang ba rten 'brel 'di so so thar pa'i sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i srog lta bu yin/

de nyid ma nyams na yon tan thams cad 'byung te/ tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong 'od dang ldan// tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams kun gyi mchog /ces pa la sogs pa thams cad kyang 'di kho na'i byed pa lags gsung*/ gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par yang*/ gsang ba rten 'brel ma nyams na byang chub sems kyi stobs su 'gyur ro// rtsa thams cad byang chub sems kyi rtsa/ rlung dang thig le thams cad byang chub sems kyi rlung dang thig ler gyur nas/ de rnams tshogs pa'i rten 'brel gyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe na yang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems de'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa'i tshe na yang*/ thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis nye bar mdzes pa de nyid kyang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'jug sems sdom pa'i ngo bos khyad par du byas pa las byung ba lags mod/ thig le nyams par gyur na tsha sgo can gyi thang la lo thog mi 'byung ba dang 'dra bar/ phan bde'i 'bras bu mi 'byung bar/ des na gces spras chen po mdzad par zhu'o// gsum pa gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig tu yang*/ dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba gsang ba rten 'brel yin te srog gi dbang po dang 'dra/ dper na skyes bu'i srog gi dbang po 'gags pa'i dus na mig gzugs la bltar med/ rna ba dang sna dang lce la sogs pa'i dbang po gzhan yang de 'dra'o// de bas na 'di nyams na sngags kyi dngos grub dang*/ yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad mi 'byung*/ chu chad pa'i rang thag dang 'dra gsung*/ de ltar yang dgyes rdor las/ ga bur nges par mi spang ngo*// ces pa dang*/ rtsa ltung las kyang*/ chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// de spong ba ni lnga pa yin// ces gsungs pas ltung ba lnga pa phog /de la ci'i phyir ltung ba zhes bya na/ rdo rje dmyal ba la sogs pa 'og nas 'og tu ltung ba'i phyir na ltung ba zhes bya ba yin/

rig pa 'dzin pa'i go ba yang 'di ma nyams par 'dzin pa la zer ba yin pas na skyes bu rnams 'di nyams na dam nyams zhes bya ste/ mi che ba dang zha ring bas mi phan/ chos pa bzang ba dang lta ba mtho bas mi phan te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams khros nas tshe 'dir yang me tog sad kyis khyer ba bzhin du nag hrul gyis 'gro zhing*/ tshe phyi ma dam nyams de la srid pa'i lcags kyus sna nas bzung*/ las kyi zhags pas ske nas bcings te rmos glang ltar rang dbang med par khrid nas rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro ba 'di shin tu 'jigs/ de bas na 'di ma nyams na thun mong gi dngos grub 'phrin las bzhi dang grub chen brgyad la sogs pa thob/ mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di la sku bzhi'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba lags te/ sngags kyi dam tshig sa ma ya 'bum sde gsungs kyang don 'dir 'dus gsung*/ sngon bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i dus na rab tu byung tshad thams cad kyis dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob pa yang gnad 'di ma nyams pas thob pa yin mod/ 'di nyams na dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu bas rgyun tu zhugs pa yang mi thob gsung*/ kha cig gi rnam par rtog pa la theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags 'di nyid tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya ba/ lta ba mtho ba/ sgom pa bzang ba/ spyod pa yangs pa/ zas skom sha chang la byas pas chog pa skyo rogs bud med la bcol bas chog snyam pa yod srid de/ ma go ba yus che zhing then pa brdab na na ba yin/ sngags 'di 'og ma gnyis pas shin du phra ba'i chos yin te/ jo bo rje'i zhal snga nas/ nga'i so so thar pa'i sdom pa la nyes ltung gtan mi 'byung*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la bag tsam 'byung*/ sngags kyi dam tshig la char cig dang nyar cig tu 'byung gsung*/ 'di la dgongs nas kyang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas kyang*/ sdom gsum gnad kyi man ngag mkhas// a pho mi btsun kha med yin// bgyi ba la sogs pa gsungs te/

de ltar bstan pa'i sdom pa gsum po 'di gnas na sdom gsum ngo bo gcig pa bya ba lags/ rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas len na so sor len 'tshal/ dus tshod gnas skabs dang sbyar nas bsrung na/ 'chol bar bsrung dgos/ yul dang bsam pa na 'phos pas/ ldan na mar ldan bgyi bar mchi/ nyams na so so'i cho gas gso dgos pa lags/ des na gnad go dgos la/ go nas nyams su len dgos pa yin pas/ dge 'dun rnams rang gi bsam pa kha nang du log la gzigs dang*/ rang gis byas pa rang la rgyus med pa mi 'ong pa yin pas/ gnad 'di dang ldan na rje'i bu yin la/ 'di med na bsten yun ring pas mi phan/ drang srong a chu tha dang 'dra/ mnyes pa gsum bsgrubs kyang mi phan/ mi mnyes pa bco brgyad kyi gral 'go de gar 'ong bas/ khyed rjes su zhugs pa rnams kyis snga yo ngan pa thams cad bor nas/ phyi yo bzang po len pa 'di gal che ba lags pas/ mdor bsdus par gyur na/ phyi rten 'brel sdom pa gsum ma nyams pas mi dge ba thams cad spangs te/ gsang ba rten 'brel khams ma nyams pa'i mthus nang rten 'brel ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan thams cad lhun grub tu 'byung zhing sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bor tshe gcig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba lags pas rje rin po che'i thugs kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa sdom gsum gnad kyi man ngag 'di ngo mtshar la rmad du byung ba'i chos lags pas khyed rnams kyis thugs kyi dkyil 'khor zhig tu bzhag par zhu gsung*// //yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o skol thams cad 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho 'dir 'khyams pa 'di rgyu cis lan snyam na sems rig pa 'di rtogs ma myong la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub tu bsngo ma myong bas lan gsung*/ de la 'khor ba spong bar byed pa la/ 'jig rten mgon po la zhing du byas nas/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa gal che/

rje rin po che de nyid la mos gus byas pa dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams kyi mthus/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i phyag rgya chen po gcig tu rtogs nas mchi/ des 'khor ba spong ba yin/ kha cig gi rtog pa la des mi 'ong snyam nas thos bsam sgom gsum rang dgos snyam na/ ra snor la rgyugs pa bzhin byed pa de ni glen pa mgo 'khor ba yin mod/ thos pas 'khor ba spong na blo 'bring po zhig gis kyang*/ lo gsum bzhi zhig bslabs na po ti zung re tsam mi shes rgyu ci yod de/ des mi phan tha snyad tshig bgyi ba yin gsung*/ de ltar yang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ thos bsam na chung bde ba don du gnyer byas kyang*// sdig grogs tsha sgo'i thang la u tum 'bar ba tshol// bgyi ba gsung*/ sngon khams pa mdo smad pa'i ston pa zhig gis/ dge bshes dan bgyi ba de'i drung du phyin nas/ phar phyin dang tshad ma rnam nges dang*/ byams chos la sogs pa bslabs pas/ mkhas pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur nas/ yul du byon skad pa la de'i dus su ma rgan mo 'chi ba la thug pas ston pa spyan drangs nas skyabs 'gro dang gdam ngag zhu zer bas rung zer nas/ 'o na a ma rang ka ba 'di la dam chos/ ngas sun bdon/ yang na ngas dam bca' yis a ma rang sun thon zer skad/ de lta bu'i chos kyis 'khor ba mtha' yod tsam 'ong srid dam ste lar bul med/ mkhas pa chen po bka' rab 'byams la shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas pa lung rig pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po lo tsā ba rngog blo ldan shes rab tsam yang bsam yas su sku snyung pa la yar la skyi shod du gdan drangs snyam pa la bsam yas sa ra'i chu khar sku gshegs pa'i dus su/ sems la bzhag sa ma rnyed pas/ thos pa rkyang pa la thugs mug nas bka' bstsal pa/ 'di la brten nas bdag cag 'khor ba'i pha rol tu// 'gro ba snyam nas rgya mtshor 'jug pa gang yin pa// rbu ba rdol pa brtsegs pa 'dra ba'i phung po yi// ri mchog 'dra ba'i rang bzhin des ni gtan nas bslus// gsung skad/

de la dpal phag mo gru pas mchod brjod mdzad pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje brtse ba can// sbyangs stobs 'bras bu kha ba can du sad// yon tan rgya mtsho rig pa'i gnas lnga rdzogs// ston pa'i gsung la blo gros rab yangs pa'i// srog gyi dbang po ma ri'i rtser 'gags tshe// thos bsam chos la thugs chad bka' stsal pa// zhes pa btags nas gda' ste/ de ci la gleng blangs na theg pa mtha' dag gi chos la mnga' brnyes par shes kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa tsam ma gtogs pa 'khor ba mi spongs te/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ chos nyon mongs kyi gnyen por ma song na// pag shis grong pa bsdud pa yin// bgyi ba gsung*/ yang bsam pa rkyang pas 'khor ba mi spong ste/ bsam pa bya ba de 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nye dmigs bsam pa yin te/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i nyams len gyi mthil yang 'di yin gsung*/ thos pa bas cung zad lam nye te/ nyi ma 'char rtags su skya rengs shar ba lta bu yin/ 'khor ba las blo log kyang sems nyid kyi don ma rtogs pas 'khor ba mi spong ste/ de la dgongs nas dam pa rgya gar gyi zhal nas kyang*/ jo bo bka' gdams pa bya ba chos nyid snying po'i don kyi gdams ngag bstan nas da ruung de'i dus la ma bab zer ba gsung nas bka' bkyon pa de shin tu mad gsung*/ yang sems ma rtogs na bsgoms kyang 'khor ba mi spongs te/ yod par bsgom pa dang med par bsgom pa dang*/ stong par bsgom pa dang*/ de la sogs pa thams cad 'dzin pa'i blo'i bye brag yin/ blo'am sems kyis 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ de ltar yang*/ skye med zhes dang stong zhes dang*// bdag med zhes pa stong pa nyid// dman pa'i yid kyis gang bsgoms pa// 'jig rten 'di na bdag bsgom pa'o// gsungs pas/ sgom bzang po rang yod kyi bu lhag spyod dang 'dra bas/ des na ting nge 'dzin bya ba zhi gnas kha chu na le ba zhig la mi zer/

rje gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*/ blos byas stong pa bskal par bsgoms byas kyang*/ gser gyi sgrog tu chud pas grol ba'i dus skabs med// bgyi ba gsung*/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i mngon shes lnga dang ldan yang*/ sems ma rtogs na 'khor ba las mi 'da'/ mngon shes rgyal po dpe dkar la yang yod de/ go ma chod par gda'/ skyes bu rnams de bas na/ 'khor ba spong ba la sems rtogs dgos pa yin/ sems rtogs par byed pa la bdag rkyen bsod nams kyi tshogs dang mos gus la 'bad pas/ gzhan rkyen bla ma gdams ngag dang ldan pa/ brgyud pa byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ rtogs pa yod pa zhig dang mjal nas 'ong*/ rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa de/ 'jig rten na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgya/ ci 'o na sangs rgyas pa dbu'i gtsug gtor dang*/ zhabs kyi 'khor lo mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa zhig yod snyam na de ma lags/ sangs rgyas gtsug gtor dang zhabs kyi 'khor lo dang mtshan dpes khyad par du byas pa ma yin/ de rnams kyi cha tsam 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la yang yod/ sangs rgyas chos skus khyad par du byas pa lags mod/ mtshan dpes spras pa tsam la khyad par du 'dod na log par lta ba yin te/ de ltar yang*/ chos nyid zhi ba 'du byas ma yin pas// zhes pa shākya thub des rab tu phye// ces pa dang*/ rdo rje gcod pa la kyang*/ gang zhig nga las sgrar shes shing*// gang zhig nga la gzugs su mthong*// de ni log par brtags pa ste// 'gro ba des ni nga mi mthong*// 'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku// chos sku mthong bya ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// lar na skyes bu rnams bla ma bzang ngan phyi rol na yod pa ma yin/ rang gi bsod nams bsags pa'i mthu'am/ bsam pa'i bye brag gis der snang ba yin/ bla ma la 'gro 'ong med pa yin/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan par ma mthong ba de yang rang gis bskyed rim phyin ci log la goms pa'i skyon yin/

tshangs dbyangs dri ma med par ma mthong ba de yang tshig ngan gyi dug mda' mnga' bas lan pa yin/ thugs chos sku ye shes su ma mthong ba de yang rtog ngan dang chags sdang bsams pas lan pa yin/ khab rtse gnyis/ lam kha brag mos gus ltem rkyang tshul de la yon tan re na kho thag chod ga la thob/ de ltar ma mdzad par/ nor bu lta bu'i bla ma rtogs ldan de la byi dor lta bu'i mos gus gyis dang*/ yon tan thams cad rgya dang 'bur gyi tshul du 'byung gis/ de ltar yang*/ bde mchog las/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje 'chang zhabs pad la 'dud// bgyi ba gsung*/ de yang rgyud la skyes pas mi chog mnyam par 'jog dgos pa yin/ 'di'i skabs su chos rje'i zhal nas/ mnyam gzhag gi dus su/ dug gsum la sogs pa'i rtog pa mi skye ba yin/ ting nge 'dzin de nyid las langs pa'i dus su/ mnyam gzhag de nyid las rjes su 'ong ba yin/ lar mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su rjes kyi shes pa de nyid mnyam gzhag gyi ting nge 'dzin du lhan gyis 'gro ba zhig dgos/ mnyam gzhag bar mtshams med pa yod na rjes shes nyon mongs pa dug gsum la sogs pa'i rnam rtog mi skye ba lags mod/ srid pa'i bar do spangs/ bar mtshams mi 'ong zhing 'od gsal de nyid kyi ngang nas sangs rgyas nas/ gzhan don gzugs sku'i snang ba 'byung ba yin/ de ltar yang rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ 'od gsal ba la rgyun par gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// gzhan don gzugs sku'i snang ba 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ des na mnyam gzhag de nyid rjes shes/ rjes shes de nyid mnyam gzhag tu 'ong ba lags mod/ 'di'i skabs su nga 'bus rje rin po che la mnyam gzhag la sems brtan pa'i dus su rjes kyi shes pa gang du gnas/ rjes su ldang na gang du ldang bya ba dang gcig bar do dang po'i 'od gsal gnas pa'i dus sngon byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can gyi rtog pa de gang du gnas/

rdo rje gdan dang ma'i mngal ma gtogs pa'i thogs med du 'gro rgyu de gang nas ldang bya ba gnyis po de zhus pas/ gser phul gsungs pas/ gser phul nas zhus pas/ bka' bkyon te 'di gzhan zhu ba byung na khur ba bcag pa yin te khyod la bstan gyis gsung nas/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus na me long la gzugs yal ba'am/ nam mkha' la sprin yal ba bzhin du rjes kyi rtog pa de mnyam gzhag de nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig pa yin/ rjes shes su ldang na nam mkha' la sprin langs pa'am/ me long la gzugs byung ba ltar/ mnyam gzhag de nyid rjes su ldang gsung*/ yang bar do dang po'i 'od gsal bya ba 'di kun la 'ongs te/ ngo ma shes pa yin/ de yang 'chi ba'i dus su 'byung ba bzhi thim pa'i rim pa dang*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa phra rags thim pa'i steng la/ skye shi bar do rdzogs nas srid pa bar do dang po'i skabs der/ 'od gsal chos sku de nyid skyes bu'i lag pa brkyang skum tsam zhig lus can kun la 'ongs te ngo mi shes pas phan med/ rang re sgom chen pa sems ngo shes pa yin na sngar gyis goms pas de ngos zin nas 'od gsal chos sku mngon du byas nas rang don 'grub/ gzhan don gzugs sku 'byung ba yin/ spyir bar do dang po'i 'od gsal de/ se gol bcu gnyis gtogs pa'i bar tsam pa zhig tu zin na/ de'i tshe sa bcu gnyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas pa yin gsungs pas/ skyes bu rnams rang re thams cad kyang bar do dang po'i 'od gsal de ngo shes tsam re byed dgos/ 'od gsal de la gnas pa'i dus su bar do'i rnam shes rtog pa can de/ 'od gsal de nyid la/ til dang til mar gyi tshul du gnas pa yin/ tshul ji ltar du ldang na 'od gsal de nyid la gnas pa'i tshe/ nga shi nas 'dug snyam pa'i rnam par rtog pa thol pa zhig skyes pa'i dus su/ 'od gsal de nyid sngon byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can gyis lus de ldang ba yin/

de ltar yang lung las/ rdo rje gdan dang ma yi mngal// gnyis po ma gtogs thogs med 'gro// gar bsams su 'gro ba lags te/ rdo rje gdan ni sems skye med du rtogs pa la zer te/ de bar do dang por ngos zin na longs sku sngon du byed pas gzhan du rgyu med mi 'byung ba yin/ ma'i mngal ces pa pha ma gnyis dang bar do'i rnam shes las mthun pa gsum tshogs pa'i tshe na/ ma'i mngal du khu khrag gi thig les 'thums pas/ thogs med du rgyu mi nus pa yin/ de ma gtogs pa'i yid kyi lus su gnas pas rdzu 'phrul gyis gar bsam bsam du bgrod pa la/ sngar bas nyon mongs pa rags pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa des lan pa yin/ mdor bsdus par gyur na/ rang gi rgyud pa rin po che 'di'i lugs kyis nyams su blang rgyu bla ma'i mos gus ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas gcig pu ri khrod dam mang po'i tshogs na 'dug kyang rung ste lnga ldan rin po che dang gcig bla ma'i mos gus gnyis la thugs rtse gcig par mar me'i rtse'am/ rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung ltar nyams su len par bya ba dang*/ nyes skyon gyi tshogs thams cad chu klung gi dri ma dag nas 'od gsal chos sku mngon du gyur te sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo lhun grub tu rgyun chad med par sems can thams cad kyi don du 'byung ba lags pas/ khyed rnams kyis de ltar du thugs la bzhag par zhu gsung*/ 'og min gnas mchog dpal gyi 'bri gung du// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma rin chen gyis// theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe// legs par bsdus pa bcu bdun grangs nges can// rin chen 'brug sgra'i mtshan gyis legs bsngags pa'i// bdag gis bris pa'i bsod nams gang yod des// mtha' yas sems can blo'i padmo ni// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'ur kha phye nas// rtogs pa'i ze 'bru kun nas rgyas gyur te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshe 'dir thob nas ni// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma'i gnas thob shog

/deng nas bzung te tshe rab thams cad du// rkang gnyis gtso bo bla ma rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin cing*// 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du shog /chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin po che'i gsung*/ rin chen 'brug sgra zhes bya ba// shākya'i dge slong dar ma tshul khrims kyis 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du brjed par 'phangs nas yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so// dge'o// //

806) ༄// dwags po chos bzhi'i 'grel pa don gsal// oṃ swasti// dus gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon chos kyi rje// lhar bcas 'jig rten sgron ma gtsug gi rgyan// mkha' mnyam grags pa'i dbang phyug rin po che// sku gsung thugs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// jo bo'i gdams pa dwags po rin po che'i thugs kyi yang snying chos bzhi bri bar bya/ 'di ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ thub pa chen po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs kyang*/ bla ma rin po che sgam po pa'i nyams kyi chos bzhi po 'dir ma 'dus par med de/ de yang chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam 'khrul pa sel ba/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba dang rnam pa bzhi yin gsung*/ de la chos rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ chos chos su mi 'gro ba gang yin snyam na/ tshe 'di 'ba' zhig don du gnyer/ 'jig rten gyi chos rnam pa brgyad kho na don du gnyer ba zhig yin te/ de yang ngas sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa la sogs pa byas na bdag gis rnyed pa che 'ong snyam nas/ rnyed na dga' ba ste 'jig rten gyi chos cig ngas sbyin gtong dang tshul khrims bsrung ba la sogs pa ma byas na mi rnyed de 'ong snyam nas ma rnyed na mi dga' ba ste 'jig rten gyi chos cig yang bdag gis sbyin gtong dang tshul khrims bsrung ba la sogs pa byas na bdag la grags pa chen po 'ong ste 'ong snyam nas/ grags pa 'ong ched du tshul khrims bsrung ba la sogs pa byed nas/ grags na dga' ba ste 'jig rten gyi chos cig /sbyin pa la sogs pa ma byas na bdag la grags pa chen po mi 'ong ste 'ong snyam nas/ de ltar ma byas nas mi grags na mi dga' ba ste 'jig rten gyi chos cig

yang bdag gis sbyin gtong dang tshul khrims bsrung ba la sogs pa byas na bdag bde bar 'ong ste 'ong snyam nas/ bde bar 'ong bar 'dod pas de ltar byed nas bde na dga' ba ste 'jig rten gyi chos cig sbyin gtong la sogs pa ma byas na mi bde ste 'ong snyam nas de ltar byed nas mi dga' ba ste 'jig rten gyi chos cig yang bdag gis sbyin gtong dang tshul khrims bsrung ba dang thos bsam bsgom pa la sogs pa byas na bdag la bstod pa chen po 'ong ste 'ong snyam nas de'i ched du de rnams byed nas/ bstod na dga' ba ste 'jig rten gyi chos cig sbyin gtong la sogs pa ma byas na bdag la smod par 'ong snyam nas/ de ltar smad ra mi 'ong ba'i ched du sbyin gtong la sogs pa byed nas smad na mi dga' ba ste 'jig rten gyi chos cig de ltar 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad po de las/ rnyed na dga' ba/ grags na dga' ba/ bde na dga' ba/ bstod na dga' ba dang bzhi po 'dod chags kyis bsdus/ ma rnyed na mi dga' ba/ ma grags na mi dga' ba/ mi bde na mi dga' ba/ smad na mi dga' ba dang bzhi po zhe sdang gis bsdus/ gti mug shugs las khyab/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad po yang mdor bsdus na 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gti mug gsum las ma 'das/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyis kun nas blangs pa'i las ci byas pa thams cad mi dge ba 'ba' zhig gi las yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas/ des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba'o// zhes gsungs/ yang slob dpon 'phags pa'i bshes spring las/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang*// grags dang ma grags bde dang mi bde dang*// bstod smad ces byar 'jig rten chos brgyad po// khyod kyi yid yul min par mgo snyom mdzod// ces gsungs pas chos chos su 'gro mi 'gro rang gi bsam pa la rag las te/

rtsa ba sman yin na sdong po dang yal ga dang lo 'dab dang 'bras bu thams cad sman yin la/ rtsa ba dug yin na sdong po dang yal ga lo 'dab 'bras bu thams cad dug yin pa dang 'dra/ byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas blangs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyis las ci byas pa thams cad dge ba yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan byang chub kyi sems de thog ma dang bar dang tha ma thams cad du dge ba'i phyir ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la// da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas// yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang*// zhes gsungs/ de ltar chos chos su mi 'gro ba 'jig rten gyi chos rnam pa brgyad po 'ba' zhig gi sgo nas tshe 'di kho na don du gnyer ba yin pas/ de'i gnyen por 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa bsam ste/ de yang rang cag 'jig rten 'dir yun ring por mi sdod/ 'chi dgos/ 'chi nges par 'chi/ mi ldog par 'chi/ myur du 'chi/ mi sdod par 'chi/ dus ma thebs/ dbang po ma tshud/ de ring mi 'chi ba'i gdeng med/ sang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med do// slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ sang tsam 'chi bar sus shes kyis// de ring nyid du bstun te bya// 'chi bdag sde chen de dang ni// bdag nyid bshes pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs/ zas gos gnyis 'tsho ba'i rkyen yin yang zas kyi brnang nas 'chi ba'am/ zas ma zhu ba'am/ zas la dug byung bas shi ba yang dpag tu med/ gos kyis subs nas shi ba yang dpag tu med/ zas gos gnyis bsgrub pa'i mkhos gsham gyis shi ba'am tshong lam du shi ba yang dpag tu med de/ lus 'di la rma khab mig tsam zhig byung yang shi/ rtsa rta rnga tsam zhig chad kyang 'chi/ 'chi ba'i rkyen du ma gyur pa gang yang med pas/ 'jig rten 'dir yun ring po sdod pa'i gdeng su la yang med de/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/

tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yis// chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na// dbugs rngub dbugs dbyung gnyid kyis log pa las// sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs// 'chi ba la nges pa med par 'chi ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ la la rgas dang la la gzhon// la la dar la bab pa'i mi// la la btsas ma thag tu 'chi// kha cig mngal du 'chi ba'ang mthong*// de dag rim gyis 'chi 'gyur na// gson po'i gdeng ni su zhig mchi// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang mdo sde mdzang blun las/ skyes pa 'chi/ 'dus pa 'bral/ bsags pa mdzad/ bslang ba 'gyel/ zhes rang bzhin gyi gtan tshig bzhi gsung*/ 'chi ba'i tshe na longs spyod/ gnyen 'dun/ mdza' bshes/ 'byor pa/ lang tsho/ dgra la sogs pa thams cad 'jog tha na rang gi lus na mi bzod/ tsha mi bzod/ grang mi bzod/ bkres mi bzod pa 'di yang 'jog nang ma cig kyang med pa'i glags med pa yin yang ro des byur de non nas sgor ma phyin nas sbyongs/ tshe thar du lus pa 'di yin bya ba su yang ma mthong bas 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa yin par go bar bya'o// tshe 'dir dar cig la skyid par 'dug kyang tshe 'di mi rtag ri gzar gyi chu dang 'dra ste/ 'dus pa chen po'i tog las/ grogs dang tshe 'di myur du 'gro ba ste// ri gzar chu drag mgyogs 'dra na// byis pa'i skye bos ma rtogs nas// mi mkhas 'dod pa'i dregs pas myos// zhes pa dang*/ 'dus byas g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gang la yang rtag pa med// chos kun rnam par 'jig par 'gyur ba blo dang ldan pas shes// zhes gsungs/ lang tsho mi rtag ste/ gzhon pa rgan por 'gro ba la tshegs med/ me tog sad kyis khyer ba bzhin du 'gro ste/ lung las/ lang tsho mi rtag gzugs kyang rtag ma yin// nad med mi rtag 'byor pa rtag ma yin// zhes gsungs/ 'byor pa mi rtag ste/ phyug po yong 'phro la ltogs par song ba dpag tu med/

khe dang tshong gis nor gyi phung por yod kyang*/ dgras khyer nas sprang lag stong par btang ba yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ rnyed pa mang po thob gyur cing*// yun ring dus su bde spyad kyang*// chom pos phrogs pa ji bzhin du// sgren mo lag pa stong par 'gro// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang*/ a cang sogs la dga' ba yang*// 'byor pa gzhan gyi dbang du 'gyur// sbrang mas 'bad de bsags pa yang*// sbrang rtsi gzhan dag spyod par snang*// zhes gsungs/ mdza' bshes kyang mi rtag ste/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas kyang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus kyang*// 'bral te so sor 'gro gyur na// mdza' ba gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos// mi mdza' rnams kyang smos ci dgos// zhes pa dang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ byis pa 'ja' tshon blta ba bzhin// mdza' bshes 'grogs pa de dang 'dra// zhes gsungs/ des na gang gis kyang stongs par mi 'gyur te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ bdag nyid mal na 'dug bzhin du// gnyen bshes mang pos mtha' bskor yang*// srog gcod pa yi tshor ba ni// bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur// gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan// de tshe bsod nams skyabs cig ni// bdag gis de yang ma bsten no// zhes gsung*// de'i dus su las gang bsags pa de'i rjes su 'brang ba ma gtogs pa gzhan gang yang rjes su mi 'byung ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ dus kyi gnyen te rgyal po 'gro 'gyur na// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// rgyal po dag ni gang dang gar 'gro yang*// las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// zhes gsungs/ bsod nams bsags na longs spyod du 'ong ste/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ bdog pa thams cad bstun te btang*// bdag gis bdog pa kun bor nas// gcig pur ga shed 'gro dgos na// dge ba'i phyogs su btang ba rnams// nyid kyi mdun du dong ba nyid// ces pa dang*/

bsod nams kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i mdo las/ bsod nams bsags pas bde ba thob/ de phyir mi yi bsod nams bsags// de yang yang dang yang du bsags// de nyid la yang bstun de bya// zhes gsungs/ de ltar chos chos su 'gro ba la 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa bsgoms pas tshe 'di la blo log pa zhig gos/ tshe 'di la blo log pa 'di la skyes bu chung ngu'i lam rim zhes ming 'dogs so// de rnams gar gces na mal gyi tha ma na nyal/ zas kyi tha ma chu phrog cig 'thung*/ nye du dang gnyen 'brel rnams kyis mtha' bskor/ dbugs ring dbugs thung byed pa'i skabs su skyabs dang mgon chos ma gtogs pa med pas/ de kho na bzhin du thugs la bzhag par zhu// //de ltar chos chos su song yang*/ chos lam du 'gro ba zhig dgos te/ de yang tshe 'di la blo log kyang*/ tshe phyi ma la lha dang mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa 'khor ba'i bde 'bras don du gnyer na/ chos lam du ma song bas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes par bya ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ lha dang mi dang ngan song gnas gsum po// 'gro ba rgyud lnga'i 'khor lo 'di dag kyang*// gar byed lha bzhin mi rtag mi brtan na// mkhas pa su zhig 'di la yid brtan yod// 'di ni sdug bsngal rang bzhin chen po yin// zhes gsungs/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi zhal nas/ 'khor ba pa la bde ba med// me yi nang na bsil ba med// mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med// ces gsungs// 'gro ba na rigs drug skye ba na gnas bzhi/ lam rgyud lnga/ mi 'dod bzhin du 'khor bar 'khor ba 'di rnams/ sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das te/ dmyal ba la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags la bkres skom/ dud 'gro la blun rmugs dang bkol spyod/ mi la brel 'phongs/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung byed la sogs pa 'gro ba rigs drug so so la sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/

de las kyang dmyal ba tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ nyi tshe nye 'khor gnyis te bco brgyad/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dar drags la yun ring ba/ brnag gis mi bzod pa/ rna bas thos pa tsam gyis kha nas khrag dron mo skyugs nas 'chi bar 'gyur nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis// rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal mi bzod pa// des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu la// char yang mi phod 'ol yang mi nye'o// zhes gsungs/ tshe ring thung gi dbang du byas na/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi zhal snga nas/ til sbyang nang nas lo brgya zhig til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe yin te// gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shu 'gyur// zhes pa grang ba'i dmyal ba'i tshe tshad dang*/ tsha ba'i dmyal ba'i tshe tshad ni/ yang sos lo drug rim pa bzhin// 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// rab tu tsha byed mnar med ni// bar gyi bskal pa gcig yin no// zhes gsungs/ yi dwags la yang phyi'i sgrib pa can dang*/ nang gi sgrib pa can dang*/ spyi mthun gyi sgrib pa can dang*/ de la sogs pa zas kyis bkres shing skom pas gdungs te/ sdug bsngal dar drags la yun ring ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la// lto ba ri yi ltos tsam bkres pas nyen// mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad yang*// 'tshal ba'i mthu dang nus pa ma mchis so// zhes gsungs/ tshe'i tshad kyang lnga stong dag dang khrir yang 'chi mi 'gyur// zhes pas/ sdug bsngal brjod kyis mi lang ba yod de mgo smos pa yin no// dud 'gro la yang sdug bsngal rgyun du 'byung ba ni// blun cing rmug pa byings na gnas pa/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na chang 'gags kyi sbangs ma tsam nying sha nying gis za ba la sogs pa dang*/ kha 'thor ba la sogs pas kyang che ches chung chung za ba la sogs pa dang*/

'bros 'ded dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal mi theg bzhin du bkal nas lcag tshan gyis 'brab pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med de/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang*// bcing dang brdeg btsogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa// zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni// gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa// kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa dang*// sha dang lpags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur// dbang med gzhan dag lag pas brdeg pa dang*// lcags dang lcags kyus gdab nas btab ste bkol// zhes gsungs/ mi la yang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gsum dang*/ skye ba dang*/ rgas pa dang*/ na ba dang*/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal bzhi dang*/ dgra sdang ba dang phrad kyis dogs pa dang*/ gnyen byams pa dang bral gyis dogs pa dang*/ yod pa 'tsho skyong mi thub pa dang*/ med pa btsal gyis mi rnyed pa ste bzhi dang brgyad/ mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin te/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ brel zhing 'phongs pa las kyi dub// bu lon na tsha chung mas gtses// dgra dang 'phrad dogs bu la chags// mi yi sdug bsngal dmyal ba bzhin// zhes so// de ltar mi la sdug bsngal bcu gcig yod do// lha ma yin la ni lha'i longs spyod la phrag dog gis sems gdungs pa dang*/ gdug sems kyi sdug bsngal ba dang*/ 'thab rtsod kyis rtag tu sdug bsngal ba'o// lha yang lha min gyi sdug bsngal de dag kyang yod pa'i steng du 'dod pas ngoms pa med pa dang*/ lha ma yin dang 'thab rtsod dgos pa dang*/ 'chi ltas byung ba'i dus su mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba bas kyang sems kyi sdug bsngal che ba ste/ ngan song du lhung ba'i sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal te/ lha gnas na yod 'phro la dma' mor ltung ba la tshegs med de/

'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nga las nus sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas na rgya byin brgya rtsa bcu bzhi'i tshe thub cing*/ brgya byin gyi stan phyed la dbang ba la/ rgya byin bsad la stan gcig nga'i bya bsam pa byung bas de ma thag tu mar sar gyi gong bu bzhin du zhu ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling du lhung ba lta bu ste/ de ltar yang slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ brgya byin mchod 'os nyid du gyur nas ni// las kyi dbang gis slar yang ngan song ltung*// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nyid du gyur nas kyang*// slar yang 'khor ba'i yang bran nyid du 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas na lha'i longs spyod dga' bder spyod 'phro la/ lus la dri ma zhim pa bro/ lus la 'od yod pa yang yal/ me tog gi rgyan yod pa yang rnying*/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis mi 'dod cing gles la bor bas/ 'di ci yin snyam pa la/ sngar gyi bsod nams ni zad/ phyi ma ni ma bsags pas ma ga ta'i 'dam rdzab tu phag mo lto ser zhig gi lto bar skye bar mthong bas/ ma bu gcig po shi ba'am/ rnga mo de rnge'u gtor ba'am/ nya bye tshan la 'gre ba lta bur sdug bsngal ba ste/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ nyi ma zla ba'i lus thob rang lus kyi// 'od kyis 'jig rten khyab par byas gyur kyang*// slar yang mun nag smag tu de gyur nas// rang gi lag pa brkyang ba mi mthong 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gzugs khams dang gzugs med pa'i khams gnyis po ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'du byed pa'i sdug bsngal gnyis las ma grol nas rtag par sdug bsngal lo// 'gro ba rigs drug la drag shos lha dang mi yin na yang*/ sdug bsngal de 'dra na/ 'khor ba ni me 'bar ba'i khang pa'am btson ra dang 'dra/ me mar mur gyi 'obs dang 'dra/ mi gtsang ba'i dong dang 'dra ste/ 'khor ba 'di mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin no// de ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams pas/

'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal du shes pa/ de la 'jigs shing mi 'dod pas rang nyid zhi ba dang bde ba 'dod pas 'khor ba las nges par 'byung 'dod pa'i bsam pa skyes nas/ tshangs par spyod pas khams gsum 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dgra bcom pa yang thob ste/ sred dang bral la yang srid med bya ba yang de la zer/ nges 'byung gi tshul khrims bya ba yang de la zer/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba la yid ma byung na// mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur// sdug bsngal gdung ba med par ni// skye bo skyo ba skye mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de ltar chos lam du 'gro ba la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la blo log pa zhig dgos gsung*/ 'di la jo bo rje chen pos skyes bu 'bring gi lam rim zhes ming 'dogs so// //de ltar chos lam du song yang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa lam gar 'gro cha med pas/ lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la blo log pa zhig dgos te/ de yang lam gyi 'khrul pa gang yin na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas yin te/ de yang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la 'jigs pas rang nyid gcig pu zhi ba dang bde bar 'dod pas/ tshangs par spyad pas rgyun du zhugs pa thob/ de nas brtson 'grus cher brtsams pas dgra bcom pa thob pa la sogs pa yin te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas de dag kyang 'khor ba las thar ba la stong pa nyid rtogs dgos pas/ stong nyid kyi rtogs tshod nyan thos rnams byang chub sems dpa'i sa lnga pa dang mnyam/ rang sangs rgyas ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa drug dang mnyam zhes bya bar sa bcu'i mdo las gsungs te/ stong pa nyid zhi ba phyogs gcig pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i lus gcig gis gnas pa yin te/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ nyan thos de dag ji srid du// sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bskul bar// de srid lus gcig ye shes kyi// ting 'dzin dregs pas myos de gnas// bskul nas sna tshogs gzugs kyis ni// sems can don la brtson dga' zhing*// bsod nams ye shes nyer 'phel nas// sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/

nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gnyis po de bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam gyi 'khrul pa'am bgegs yin te/ slob dpon thogs med kyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ dmyal bar gnas pas byang chub la// gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te// nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas// de ni gtan gyi byang chub gegs// zhes gsungs/ de dag kyang sangs rgya bar byed pa la gdod byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dgos te/ rgyud las/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// zhes pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i yum sdud pa las/ byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na// 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung*// zhes gsungs te/ byang chub kyi sems med na sangs rgyas 'jig rten du mi 'byung*/ de ma byung na legs par gsungs pa'i chos mi 'ong*/ de ma byung na legs par spyod pa mi 'ong*/ de ma byung na brgya byin la sogs pa'i mngon mtho dang nyan thos la sogs pa'i nges legs mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs gang*// des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgom dgos te/ de yang byang chub kyi sems de snying rje las skye/ snying rje byams pa las skye/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ byams pa'i chu bo mi gcod cing*// snying rje'i rtsa ba rab brlan te// byang sems ljon shing rab rgyas nas// don gnyis 'bras bu smin mdzad gsol// zhes gsungs/ byams pa ni sems can bde ba dang ldan par 'dod pa yin/ snying rje ni sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa yin/ byang chub kyi sems ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/

sems can rnams la brtse ba can// 'phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral ba yi bsam pa can// phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ces pa dang*/ mngon rtog rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces gsungs/ de yang sems can thams cad mar shes na byams pa skye/ gang la byams pa skyes pa na/ snying rje rang shugs kyis skye/ snying rje skyes na sdug bsngal dang 'bral 'dod pa skye/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral ba yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas min pa gzhan med pas/ sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blo skye ste/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas ma gtogs mya ngan 'das pa med// ces pa dang*/ mdo las/ grags chen shes rab chen po pa// thub chen dpa' bo chen po pa// srid pa'i mya ngan brgal ba po// nyon mongs brgal la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs// sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blo skyes na/ sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i rgyu 'jug pa lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags ltar na bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis nyams su len pa'i rtsol ba la 'jug pa 'ong bas/ 'di rnams thams cad 'brel pa can du 'byung ngo*// de la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i rgyu nges pa byang chub kyi sems de rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bskyed par bya ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ rkyen rnam bzhi ste rgyu dang ni// dmigs pa dang ni de ma thag /bdag po dang ni bzhi yin te// rkyen lnga pa ni yod pa ma yin// zhes gsungs te/ rgyu'i rkyen ni gdod ma nas sems can la brtse sems gnas pas khra dang spyang ki la yang brtse sems yod pa de'o// bdag po'i rkyen ni/ bla ma byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ rang bas gzhan gces kyi blo dang ldan pa zhig las sems bskyed pa'i cho ga blang bar bya ste/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa las/

bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas// nus dang ldan las blang bar bya// zhes gsungs/ dmigs pa'i rkyen ni sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa rgyun chad med par bya ste/ slob dpon blo gros mi zad pa'i zhal nas/ phan par bsam pa tsam gyis kyang*// sangs rgyas mchod la khyad 'phags na// gang gi mnyam med sems can gyi// bde don brtson pa smos ci dgos// zhes pa dang*// slob dpon bi ma la mi tri'i zhal nas/ gzhan phan las la mthu med kyang*// de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya// gang la de yi blo yod pa// de la de ni sgos kyi zhugs// zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i sems bskyed mi nyan snyam na/ yang dang yang du goms par byas pas skye ste/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ goms na sla ba mi 'gyur ba'i// dngos de gang yang yod ma yin// gang gi mi thos 'jigs pa yang*// de dag med na mi dger 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas yang dang yang du bsgom par bya ste/ rgyal ba'i yum sdud pa las/ chu yi thigs pa bum pa dang po tha ma'i bar// rim gyis nyung ngu nyung ngus de yong 'gengs pa ltar// dang po'i sems kyis byang chub zhi ba thob min te// de med par yang de la reg par nus ma yin// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so// de ma thag pa'i rkyen ni/ rang bas gzhan gces kyi bsam pa rgyud la skyes pa ste/ de yang byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i brtson rar bsdams pa'i nyams thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras su brjod bya zhing*// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur// zhes slob dpon zhi ba lhas gsungs pa dang*/ yang de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu// mi gtsang lus 'di blangs na rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya bar legs brtan zung*// zhes gsungs/

de lta bas gzhan gces kyi blo rgyud la skyes pa'i dus su de ma thag pa'i rkyen zhes bya ste/ de ltar yang*/ bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa'i sems nyid dam// bdag las gzhan gces sdug pa thob nas ni// gzhan gyi don gang rang gi don gang yin// zhes gsungs/ de bas na lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la blo log pa zhig dgos gsung*/ 'di la jo bo chen pos skyes bu chen po'i lam rim zhes ming 'dogs so// //'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms pas/ dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad la blo log pa yin te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal snga nas/ stong nyid bag chags bsgoms pa yis// dngos po'i bag chags spong bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de la 'khrul pa gang yin na/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa yin te/ saṃ bhu ṭa las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par 'gyur// ces pa dang*/ bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ rlung gi chu la zhugs shing dkrugs pa yis// 'jam pa'i chu yang rdo yi gzugs ltar 'gro// rtog pas dkrugs pas rmongs pa gzugs med pas// shin tu sra zhing mkhregs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsungs// de la spyir sems kyi gnas lugs gdod ma nas bdag med pa zhig yin te/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spang*// chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs/ de ltar bdag med pa la ma rig pas bdag tu 'khrul/ des bdag gzhan la sogs pa 'khrul te/ des las sna tshogs bsog ste/ khams gsum du 'khor zhing rigs drug tu 'khyams te sdug bsngal ba'o// de ltar yang*/

ji skad du/ 'phags pas/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes// bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang*// de gnyis dang ni 'brel ba las// nyes pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur// nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can// 'di yang 'jig tshogs lta ba yin// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i yum sdud pa las// bdag dang bdag gi chos gnyis yang dag mi stong ste// byis pa bdag nyid kyis ni mkha' la mdud pa bor// dper na dogs pa'i 'du shes kyis ni dug langs pa// dug de khong du song ba med kyang brgyal bar 'gyur// de bzhin byis pa bdag dang bdag gir khas len pa// bdag der 'du shes yang dag min rtog skye zhing 'jig// ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar kun nas nyon mongs bstan// bdag dang bdag gir mi 'dzin rnam par byang bas gsung*// zhes pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ 'gro ba 'di dag ming dang gzugs kyi 'dam la chags// rlung gi 'khor lo lta bu 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khyams// 'gro ba 'khrul pa ri dwags rgyar tshud 'drar shes na// shes rab ldan pa mkha' la bya bzhin rnam par rgyu// zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ ji srid phung por 'dzin yod pa// de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod// ngar 'dzin yod pa'ang las yin te// de las yang ni skye bar 'gyur// ces pa dang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas chags// de gnod pa la zhe sdang ngo*// de la nyes tshogs kun 'byung zhing*// 'gro ba kun nas nyon mongs 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ yang de nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang*// 'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed yod pa kun// de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung ste// 'dre chen des ka khyod la ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs/ de ltar bdag tu 'dzin pas las bsags/ las kyis 'khor ba mtho dman du sdug bsngal te/ las brgya pa las/ las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs las// de yi 'gro 'di sna tshogs byas// zhes pa dang*/

mngon pa mdzod las/ 'jig rten sna tshogs las las skyes// zhes gsungs/ de la sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab dang*// bstan bcos rnams nas las kyi dbye ba mang du gsungs kyang*/ mdor bsdu na dge ba dang mi dge ba gnyis su shes par bya ste/ de la mi dge ba'i las kyis ngan 'gro dang sdug bsngal 'byung ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do// zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i zhal snga nas/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// 'di las ji ltar nges thar zhes// nyin mtshan kun tu bdag gis ni// 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam par rigs// zhes gsungs/ dge ba'i las kyis mtho ris kyi bde ba 'byung ste/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba'o// dge bas bde 'gro thams cad dang*// skye ba kun tu bde ba dag /bsam gtan tshad med gzugs med kyi// tshangs sogs bde ba myong bar byed// zhes pa dang*/ dbu ma rgyan las/ tshul khrims kyis ni bde 'gror 'gro// lta bas go 'phang mchog thob byed// ces pa dang*/ lung las/ skye dgu rnams ni bde ba mngon par 'dod// skye dgu'i bde ba longs spyod med la min// longs spyod sbyin las 'byung ba mkhyen pas na// thub pas dang po sbyin pa'i gtam dag gsung*// zhes gsungs so// mdor na dge ba dang mi dge ba gang yin yang*/ 'khrul pa yin par gcig par shes par bya'o// de la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems sgom pa de nyid yang 'dus byas dang rgyu rkyen gyi bskyed pa/ de las byas pa'i chos la mi rtag pas khyab pas de yang 'khrul pa yin te/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas/ 'on te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms na yang*// 'khor ba 'dir gnas thar pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ phun tshogs ma yin phun tshogs brtan pa'i sems// yang ni phun tshogs pa yang skam par 'gyur// ces pa dang*/

slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// nyes pa shin tu tshar gcod min// stong nyid lta dang de 'gal bas// stong pa nyid ni bsgom par bya// stong nyid rtogs pas grol 'gyur gyis// bsgom pa lhag ma de don yin// zhes gsungs/ 'khrul pa de nyid gdod ma nyid nas lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas pa skye ba med par rtogs pa'i dus su/ spang blang med par lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su shar ba yin te/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gnyis su yod pa ma yin te// 'khor ba'i de nyid shes pa la// mya ngan 'das zhes brjod pa yin// zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes kyi mdo las/ sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs te/ de rtogs par byed pa su la rag las na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhig la mos gus byas pas rtogs par 'gyur ba ma gtogs pa/ gzhan tshig tu brjod pa dang blos dpyod pa'i yul ma yin pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi tas kyang rtogs pa ma yin te/ kun dga' bo sde snod gsum la mnga' brnyes kyang*/ 'phags pa 'od bsrungs sgom chen zhig gis grol ba lta bu dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub la/ bram ze chen po sa ra has/ mchod rten gyi drung du sems thag gcod pa'i man ngag bstan pas/ nub gcig gis grol ba lta bu dang*/ slob dpon chen po nā ro paṇa chen gyi shes rab la 'dzam bu gling pa'i shes rab kyis bcu drug char yang mi phod pa yod kyang*/ tilli pa sgom chen zhig la dka' ba bcu gnyis kyis mnyes par byas pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa lta bu lags pas/ mkhas pa paṇḍi ta chen po thams cad kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa ku sā li nyams myong dang rtogs pa can re'i drung du phyin nas mos gus byas pas grol ba sha stag yin te/

de lta bu'i sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi rtogs pa 'char bar byed pa de la phyi'i rkyen bla ma dam pa zhig la mos gus kyi bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ nang gi rkyen bsod nams bsags pa ma gtogs pa gzhan gyis rtogs pa ma yin te/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed ste// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i yum sdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni thob mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de la mos gus bya ba'i bla ma de yang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma khyad par du sems nyid kyi rtogs pa yod pa'i bla ma zhig la mos gus byas shing bsnyen bkur ba las 'byung ste/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud las/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs padmor 'dud// zhes gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i bla ma de la zhe thag pa snying khung rus pa'i gting nas/ nga ci shes khyod de shes kyi tshul du mos gus byas pa las rtogs pa skye ste/ mos gus kyi tshul lugs yang bla ma de sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi sangs rgyas su blta ste/ bla ma la so so skye bo'i 'du shes skyes na/ yon tan gang yang gtan nas skye mi srid/ byang chub sems par mthong yang sems bskyed tsam yang skye'am mi skye the tshom za na/ rang sems rtogs pa lta ci smos/ bla ma la sangs rgyas rang du mthong yang sprul pa'i skur mthong na 'gro ba la phan pa grub tsam/ longs skur mthong na rang gi bsam pa'i don 'grub tsam 'byung*/ mos gus kyi mthar thug pa sangs rgyas chos kyi skur bltas nas nga ci shes khyod de shes kyi tshul du byas pa sems nyid kyi rtogs pa skye ste/

bram ze chen po sa ra ha zhal snga nas/ bla ma'i lung la bsgrim ste gus 'bad na// lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med// ces pa dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs// zhes gsungs/ rtogs pa skye ba'i tshul la rim gyis pa dang*/ cig car ba gnyis yin/ de la cig car ba ni gang zag dbang po rab skye ba snga ma phan chad du sbyangs pa dpag tu med pa song ba rnams/ tshe 'dir bla ma'i mtshan thos pa'am/ zhal mthong ba'am khrid byas ma thag tsam gyis stong nyid kyi don rtogs pa la zer te/ snga ma'i sbyangs pa la ltos nas de yang rim gyis pa yin pa rje phag mo gru pas bzhed do// rnal 'byor ma kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud las/ gang gi myur du shes bya ba// bla ma'i rim pas ji ltar bstan// skye ba bye ba stong phrag du// nga yi ye shes kyis bskul yin// dad pa yang dag bskyed pa dang*// rnal 'byor spyod yul gnas pa yin// ces gsungs/ rim gyis pa ni bla ma la mos gus rim gyis byas shing bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas mngon par rtogs pa yang de'i kha tshon tsam skye ba zhig yin gsung*/ gzhan yang rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ mos gus thod brgal du skye ba rnams la thod brgal ba'i rten gyi gang zag bya ba yang gsungs so// de rnams gang yin yang rang gi sems skye ba med par rtogs pa'i don de la goms par bya bar gsungs te/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ zla ba rgyas 'dra ba ni goms pa las byung ste// gsal bar byed pa sa mun nyi zla'i 'od 'drar spyod// ces pa dang*/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'gro snying rnam dag zhes bya ba// thub pa chen po yang dag bzhugs// nam mkha'i rang bzhin de las ni// rnal 'byor pa yi bsam gtan bya// zhes gsungs/ sems nyid kyi don rtogs pa de nyid ma bcos par bsgom par bya ste/

slob dpon tog tse pas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// bsgom du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /ces gsungs pa dang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje las/ gang yang yid kyis mi bsgom par// 'gro ba thams cad bsgom par bya// thams cad chos ni yongs shes nas// bsgom pa nyid ni sgom pa min// zhes pa dang*/ byams pa'i zhal nas/ 'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas// yongs su sbyong ba shes par bya// zhes pa dang*/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bsam gtan dag gis mi bslad de// bdag nyid bde la gnas shing gdung bar ma byed cig /ces gsungs so// de ltar sems goms pa las/ snang sems gcig tu 'dres shing gnyis 'dzin rang sar dag pa 'byung ste/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// de ring nyid du mgon po nga ni 'khrul pa chad// da ni su la yang 'dri bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs/ de ltar shes na chab rom chu ru zhu ba lta bu/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char te/ de yang nyon mongs pa'i gtso bo dug lnga la ye shes lnga 'byung la/ gzhan rnam par rtog pa phra rags ji snyed thams cad kyis kyang ye shes bye brag de snyed re re bskyed de/ slob dpon birwa pa'i zhal snga nas/ rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pa// rtag tu brten cing spyad par bgyi// zhes pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ dbang po lnga rnams gzhan gyur dang*// don kun 'jug dang kun byed dang*// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis dang*// rnal 'byor dam pa'ang thob par 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ dbang po gang dang gang lam nyid// de de'i rang bzhin phyir la 'gro// phan pa mchog gi sbyor ba yis// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin byed// ces pa dang*/ yang slob dpon birwa pa'i zhal nas/

sa gsum mthar phyin gsum phrag gsum gnas 'gyur// shes brgyad gyur pa ye shes lngar gyur te// ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa// chos sku byang chub snying po thob par shog /ces gsungs so// de ltar 'khrul pa ye shes su shar ba'i dus su/ dper na chu dwangs pa'i nang du nyi zla la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan shar ba dang 'dra bar stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad lhun gyis grub par shar nas 'bad pa med par gzhan gyi don lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ rgyun chad pa med par rang shugs kyi 'byung ste/ slob dpon bram ze sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ theg pa chen po bla med snying po'i lam 'di ni// 'bras bu lam du khyer nas gdod nas 'bras bur gnas// zhes pa dang*/ yang sems ni ngo bo nyid kyis dag pas na// de nyid dri med mchog gi go 'phang ngo*// zhes pa dang*/ yang ji skad du/ snying rje ma gtogs gzhan phan 'bras bu 'dzin// ming ni mchog tu gzhan la phan pa'o// stong pa'i stong pa dam pa'i me tog rgyas// snying rje rnam pa sna tshogs du mar ldan// lhun gyis grub pa phyi ma'i 'bras bu ste// bde ba 'di ni gzhan pa'i sems min no// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang slob dpon chen po bram ze sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ gang dang gang gi bsam pa yis// mi rnams kyis ni yid sbyar nas// des ni de yi sngon 'gro ba// nor bu sna tshogs gzugs ji bzhin// zhes gsungs/ de ltar 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba 'di la/ jo bo bka' gdams pa kun na re/ bdag med rnam pa gnyis bsgom pas 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba gsung bar gda' ste/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rang gi sems skye ba med par rtogs pas dngos po de mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad las blo ldog /dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad la blo log pas 'khrul pa de nyid gnyis med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su 'char gsungs so// de bas na 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char gsungs so// de bas na 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar byed pa la chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms pas/

dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad la blo log pa zhig dgos gsungs/ de la mdor bsdu na rten gyi gang zag las dang po pa zhig sangs rgya bar byed pa la/ chos chos su 'gro ba zhig dgos/ chos lam du 'gro ba zhig dgos/ lam 'khrul pa sel ba zhig dgos// 'khrul pa ye shes su shar ba zhig dgos/ bzhi po de tshang na rten gyi gang zag cig sangs rgya ba'i lam tshang la ma nor ba zhig yin pas de kho na bzhin du nyams su len par zhu// lnga rgya dus kyi mtshungs med chos kyi rje// sgam po pa yi dam chos tshig bzhi 'di// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa chos kyi rje'i// sras kyi thu bo 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// 'gro ba'i bla ma 'bri gung rin chen gyi// zhal nas byung ba bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos// sgro skur spangs shing gus pas blangs pa yi// bla ma dam pa'i gsung ngag rin po che// rang gi slob mar gyur pa ma gtogs pa// bla ma med kyang dpe 'di sbyin mi bya// bdag gis zhu ba phul ba'i don 'di la// rigs ldan rnams kyang ngag la nyan par zhu// des thob dge ba dri med gang yin des// dri med mchog gi go 'phang gnas thob shog /rdzogs so// //

807) ༄// shrī phug par bum pa'i springs yig gnyis med ma// mkha' gnyis su med pa'i nam mkha' la// 'ja' gnyis su med pa'i gzugs sku shar// yongs su dag pa'i rgyu 'bras de// rang bzhin med kyang mi 'khrul bar// chos rje thub pa rnams kyis gsungs// sku gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed kyis 'bul ba zhabs 'bring dang*// zhabs tog rgya chen bgyis pa rnams// dbus gtsang pre ta'i grong khyer du// bdud rtsi'i char pa chen po phab// gdul bya'i lo tog tshim pa 'dis// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// khyed phyir bdag gis bris pa yi// bstan bcos rgyu mtshan mang po de// rgyu mtshan gnad dang bcas par yang*// thugs su chud pa ngo mtshar che// 'bul ba mdzod dang zhabs tog can// ltem rkyang ma mdzad nyams rtogs can// rgyun ma gcod gcig dad pa can// bdag gi za 'dod a cang ste// so nam bya rgyu 'di las med// phyag byad bzang po thugs la btags// yig rten dbu zhwa gsol 'phro gcig /bskur nas mchis pa bzhes par zhu// // 808) ༄// bstan bcos rang grol ye shes spo spo bkra shis rgyal mtshan la gdams pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyis// dbang bskur bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad// sems can kun la mthun pa'i yid dang ni// phan sems blo gros chos kyi gtam rnams gsungs// lhun grub byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med kyis// gsol ba gang btab 'bras bu 'byin pa yi// drin chen bla ma phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// lar gyis bsgoms kyang rung la ma bsgoms kyang*// rang sems skye med chos skur rtogs// ci bde'i spyod pa babs la rgyur// bla ma'i drin las byung bar go// bzung 'dzin dag pa'i lta ba de// blo las 'das pa'i bsgom pa yin// blo las 'das pa'i bsgom pa de// byed pa med pa'i spyod pa yin// byed pa med pa'i spyod pa de// sgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor yin// bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor de// snang ba med pa'i shes rab yin// bsgom mang po'i nang na mi 'tshol ba// gcig pur 'dug na mi skyo ba// 'khor 'das thams cad mi rtog pa// chos rnams gdod nas ma skyes pa// so rgan nged kyi gsang tshig yin// ngas rnyed dang bkur sti chags pa la// rang don dang gzhan don du ma byas par// sems skye med kyi ngo bo goms par byas// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal tshogs// dag pa'i lus la mi gnas pas// lus yi dam lha la goms par byas// rdzun dang phra ma ngag 'khyal la// pho bzo po'i yang zong ma byas pas// ngag bden pa'i tshig la goms par byas// phyin ci log gi bsam pa yis// chos brgyad kyi kun slong ma byas par// blo bsod nams kyi tshogs la goms par byas// 'khor ba'i snying po chags sdang la// yang dag gi don du ma byas par// blo byang chub sems la goms par byas// mi 'ong dang mi rigs mi 'thad kyi// log lta'i rang shes ma byas par// sems mos gus kyi yid la goms par byas// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa la// rtag pa'i 'du 'dzi ma skyes par// sems mi rtog pa la goms par byas// gang bsags kyi 'bras bu 'byin pa la// rgyu 'bras la khyad gsod ma byas par// blo dkar po'i phyogs la goms par byas// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// dug gsum gyi g.yul ngo 'phral du bzlog

/sems brtul zhugs kyi dpa' bo goms par byas// thos dang bsam pa'i nga rgyal gyis// gzung 'dzin gyi rang sgrog ma bcug par// blo zung 'jug gi gshis la goms par byas// zas phud dang gos phud khong 'dzum gyis// mdzes sdug gi shag po ma btsal bar// blo mnyam pa nyid la goms par byas// spang bya dang gnyen po med pa'i chos// gdod nas ma skyes blo las 'das// spros dang bral bar rtogs phyir dang*// lta ba spyod pa sgom pa gsum// sems skye med chos skur ro gcig pas// gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa med phyir dang*// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel sna tshogs rnams// zhing dang bsam pa dngos po yi// bsam pa'i 'gro ldog yin phyir dang*// thams cad bzang por go bas kun tu bzang*// skyon rnams dag pa'i rang sems kyis// bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin phyir dang*// gdod nas dag pa'i rang sems la// skyon rnams mthong na gti mug yin// snang ba rang sems yin phyir dang*// g.ya' bral me long dag pa la// legs dang ma legs byad rnams blta// gzhan rnams mi bden nga yi bden// phyin ci log gi rang bden can// skyon rnams rang la yod phyir dang*// chos 'di la ltos la skyon 'dug na// ngan rnams thams cad bzod kyi sgrogs// bstan bcos ye shes rang grol 'di// bris pa'i bsod nams bsam mi khyab// bsam gyis mi khyab bsod nams kyis// 'gro rnams sangs rgyas sku gsum shog /rdzogs so// // 809) ༄// bshes gnyen gzhon nu dbang phyug la snying gtam tshig tu brjod pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// bshes gnyen dam pa rin po che// 'khor ba chos skur sgyur mdzad pa// mnyam med bla ma phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// de yi gnyen po gang rung cig /rgyud la skyes pa'i dus kyi tshe// spang bya'i nang du gnyen po de// shi bar gyur na bar chad yin// rang gi rgyud la yod pa des// gzhan gyi nyon mongs spong ba dang*// 'gro ba gzhan la phan gyur na// mar me gcig las mang 'phel dang*// gcig po shi bar ma gyur bzhin// dge sbyor byas pas mthun pa yin// las 'phro can gyi skyes bu des// rnyed dang bkur sti sna tshogs dang*// 'khor dang 'du 'dzi thams cad la// chags dang sdang ba'i blo med pas// sangs rgyas gnyis pa lta bu yi// brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa de// dar zhing rgyas pa'i bsam pa dang*// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can la// lhag pa'i bsam pa g.yo med pas// rang gzhan gcig tu 'dres gyur nas// nags la mched pa me yi rgyud// rtswa dang shing rnams yin pa ltar// g.yo dang mi g.yo rang gzhan kun// gcig tu byas nas brtson pa'i shugs// drag pos dge sbyor nyams blangs na// lha dang bla ma rang nyid gsum// dpang por bzhag pa'i zhe mna' yi// cig car nyams su blangs gyur na// gru dang mnyan pa 'gron po gsum// dus gcig phar khar phyin pa yin// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'dug sa ni// gti mug bdag 'dzin chen po de// sa gzhi'i tshul du gnas gyur cing*// chags dang sdang ba'i sa bon de// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i 'bras bur smin// las nyon mongs gnyis kyi tshul du 'khor// las nyon mongs gnyis kyi rnam bzhag ni// mngon rgyu rags pa'i rnam rtog tu// phra ba'i bag chags thams cad zhi// tshu rol mthong ba'i gang zag rnams// ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar 'dzin// mkhas pa'i rmongs pa mgo skor mkhan// zhi gnas zhes kyang brjod pa yin// kun 'byung 'khor ba'i sa bon yin// nyon mongs zhes kyang de la bya// rags pa'i rnam rtog so so la// lus kyi 'dug lugs so sor grub// phra rags bag chags rkyen du 'gyur// nyon mongs rgyu las 'bras bu las// las las nyon mongs sa bon gyi// thug med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong*// 'di 'khor ba'i 'khor lo'i 'dug lugs yin// mya ngan 'das pa'i 'dug tshul ni// bsags pa mchog ldan gang zag gis// tshad ldan bla mas zin tsam na// cig car 'jug dang rim gyis pa// cig car 'jug pa'i gang zag la// ma bcos phyag rgya chen po bstan// ma bcos pa yi rnam bzhag des// rang bzhin phyag rgya chen po de// 'gyur med lhun gyis grub par rtogs// blo yi yul du ma gyur pas// spros dang bral zhes rje btsun gsung*// stong par 'dug pas rnam rtog la// spros dang bral bar mi bzhed do// spros bral de nyid goms pa las// dug can sman du na 'phos pa// byang chub sems kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// rgyu lnga 'khor lnga 'khor ba'i 'khor lo de// sku lnga rgyan gyi 'khor lor sgyur// sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can// khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du 'grub// dus 'dir rgyu 'bras mngon du 'gyur// snang stong rdo rje chos dbyings zhes// spyod pa'i rgyud du bshad pa de// dus 'dir nyams su myong ba yin// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// gsang ba'i mdzod kha bye ba yin// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su yang*// dus 'dir tshud par gyur pa yin// theg chen rnal 'byor dus 'dir yin// lta kham gyi 'brug sgra zhi ba yin// bzang po'i rang mthong chag pa yin// grub mtha'i phyogs ris med pa yin// kun bzang yangs pa'i spang thang la// yon tan rin chen gyi me tog bkra// sna tshogs ma 'dres dus 'dir gcig /phyogs gcig zhi ba'i rnal 'byor des// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ji ltar 'thob// rgyu las 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung*// rgyu 'bras gcig tu ji ltar mchi// nyams phyi shar nang shar myong ba la// ro gcig gi rnal 'byor mi gsung lags// kun rdzob spangs pa'i pha rol nas// dom dam 'ong zhes mi gsung lags// lus dang sems dang snang ba gsum// tha dad yin zhes mi gsung lags// dbyer med chen po mthar phyin pas// dbyer med rgyal ba'i sku gsum la// ye shes rnam pa lnga yang mnga'// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pas na// lhun grub rgyun chad med pa yi// phrin las jo bo byams pas gsung*// sangs rgyas mya ngan yongs mi 'da'// chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur te// dge 'dun dkon mchog rgyun chad med// bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang*// 'gro drug sems can 'bral ba med// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i gdams ngag 'di// gzhan la bzlas pa ma lags te// bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu des// thos bsam bsgom gsum yon tan gyis// thugs kyi padmo rab bkang ste// blo gros yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// tshad med thugs rje chen po yis// 'gro ba smin pa'i blo mnga' ba// bzang ngan mtho dman gang yin yang*// kun la snyoms pa'i thugs mnga' ba// bshes gnyen gzhon nu dbang phyug la// snying gtam tshig tu brjod pa lags// 'di bris dge bas srid pa yi// mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog/

///// 810) ༄// gar pa byang rdor gyi g.yu khang du zhus pa'i mgur// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sprul sku bdun gyi zhabs kyis bcags// rtogs ldan grangs med bzhugs pa'i gnas// sbyang sdom 'bras bu smin pa'i sa// bde ba'i 'byung gnas phag mo grur// sku gsum ngo bo bla ma dang*// snang sems gnyis su med par mjal// khyed kyi skye ba snga ma yang*// kho bos bla ma bgyis pa dag /nga yin bdag la bka' stsal gsung*// gsung thos pa tsam gyis byin rlabs zhugs// bde stong nyams kyis lus sems gang*// gnyug ma rang ngo rang gis shes// rang sems skye ba med par rtogs// gar pa byang dor gyis g.yu khang du zhus pa'i mgur rdzogs so// rang sems phyag rgya chen po ni// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rgyal po yin// dngos med rnam rtog sna tshogs 'di// rgyal po de yi blon po yin// rgyal blon gnyis su med pa de// rgyal po de yi rgyal chas yin// mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kun// bde chen mchog la bkod pa de// rgyal po de'i rgyal khrims yin// //spyir thabs dang shes rab kyi bsgom de tshig dang mtshon pa yin/ de chos yin rgyu med/ mos gus kyis bla ma de'i tshig des mtshon pa don nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa bskyed de/ de don yin pas skyong ba yin/ dus rtag tu lnga ldan la ldab rkyang byed pa med/ rtog pa'i phreng ba yin/ dang po nang par kho nar lam du gtang*/ 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa bsgom/ sems bskyed/ lha bsgom/ bla ma bsgom/ phyag chen bsgom/ de nas so so'i myong ba gang che blo nges kyi dge sbyor de nyin mtshan phril le bsgom/ bsngo ba 'di yid la dran pa tsam yin/ sa gcig tu yun ring na dge sbyor mi 'phel lo// skyon la bros pas mi phan/ bla ma dang mjal 'dod na mdun gyi nam mkhar gdan bzhi rtsegs kyi steng du bsgom/

yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ de nas bstim/ ༈ oṃ swasti/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen gyi// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun// spros dang bral ba'i sems nyid du// skye ba med cing ro gcig pa// dag pa'i sa la gnas pa yi// byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa yin// gnyis med dbye ba med tshul du// rnam par rtog pa skye ba de// mthar thug mkhyen pa'i ye shes la// sgrib pa shes bya'i sgrib par gsungs// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yi// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa ni// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum du// 'dzin pa'i rig pa brtul nas su// sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid du// zhugs par gyur pa de nyid la// rig pa brtul zhugs zhes su brjod// rgyun chad med par nyams len na// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa yin// de dang 'dul ba'i bslab pa gnyis// gal te so so yin srid na// so so thar pa'i brjod bya ci// sngags dang tshul khrims bslab pa gnyis// gal te so so yin srid na// bde gshegs bka' 'das ltung ba zhes// skyes chen gang la zer ba soms// gang 'dir 'dul ba'i bslab pa las// gsang sngags gzhan zhig yod srid na// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pas na// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos// de 'dra med pa'i sangs rgyas la// sngags kyi sangs rgyas zer ram ci// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud rnams su// legs par gzigs dang go ba skye// //so so thar pa rigs bdun gyis// sdom pas legs par bsdams pa yi// rnal 'byor pa yis ri khrod du// byams pa snying rjes gzhi byas nas// rang gi dge sbyor gang yin la// ma yengs brtson pas nyams blangs pas// tha mal lus ngag yid gsum dang*// bral ba'i dus su shi 'phras byed// 'di yi dus su snying rus kyis// sgom pa gang dang ltas la sogs pa 'jigs su rung ba byung nas/

bla ma dang grogs po la zhus kyang mi phan/ ma zhus kyang mi thub ste dge sbyor de rang gis thub bo// //rab gnas la rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa bsgrig dgos te/ rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ byed pa po phun sum tshogs pa/ nang rdzongs bya rgyu'i rten dang bcas pa rnams phyi'i rten 'brel/ nang gi rten 'brel ting nge 'dzin/ de yang spyir rab phyag rgya chen po/ 'bring byams pa zer/ rab gnas kyi skabs 'dir byams pa rab yin/ phyi nang gnyis po'i rten 'brel de yod na tshogs pa 'grub pa yin/ tshogs pa'i skad cig ma la las sbyor byed pa la/ spyir byams pa bsha' ma zhig rgyud la skyes na rab gnas legs zin pas/ me tog kun ma 'thor yang chog ste/ gzhan snying tshim pa'i ched du gtor ba yin// // 811) ༄// dbang po tha mal pa'i bskyed rdzogs skyong thabs// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe'i dus byed pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis/ slob dpon bdag ngan song du mi 'gro 'am/ 'gro ste 'ong bas bdag ngan song du mi 'gro ba'i thabs yod dam/ yod na zhu zer nas bred sha dang bcas pas zhur byung na/ skyes bu 'jigs mi dgos kyis khyod ngan song du mi 'gro ba'i thabs bdag la yod kyis byas la/ dang por skyabs 'gro bya/ lad mo bzlo mi nus na yid kyis lad mau bzlo bar soms byas la skyabs 'gro bya/ skyabs 'gro rgyas pa'i lad mo bzlo ma nus na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsdus pa byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum brjod/ de yang ma nus na sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes brjod par bya'o// bla ma sa skya pa'i zhal nas/ dbye ba la mkhas na bsdus pa la mkhas pa yin pas/ skyabs 'gro bsdus pa 'di gzhan la med/ bla ma'i lugs la yod pa yin gsung*/ nad pa'i mdun du sdig pa bshags dgos zhes kyang mi bya/ sdig pa'i lo rgyus mi bya la tshogs gsog tu gzhug

dge slong bzhi sde spyan drangs la yi dam lhar mos pa byed du bcug la/ chu gtsang zangs gzhong gang la dmigs la rten 'brel snying po nyi shu rtsa gcig gam brgya rtsa brgyad 'don du gzhug gal te bzhi sde ma tshang na dge tshul chang mi 'thung bas kha bskang la bya'o// de med kyang thabs chag pa ni ma yin no// de nas chu de nye du 'brel pa zhig gam/ gzhan g.yog cig la 'jam par sror bcug la nad pa'i gdong dang lag pa tsam bkru/ de nas nad pa'i mdun du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku gzugs gang yang rung ba zhig dgram/ yi ge brgya pa la sogs pa sdig pa dag pa'i cho ga gzhan 'ga' zhig la bcol lo/ de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dmigs pa'i 'pho ba bstan pa ni/ skyes bu la dbang bskur byas kyang rung*/ ma byas kyang rung*/ chos sgor zhugs kyang rung*/ ma zhugs kyang rung ste/ mdun du bzhugs pa 'di khyod kyi yi dam yin byas la nad pa bltar gzhug /de nas snying gi dbus su yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag bsam du gzhug /hūm̐ yar mgrin pa na yar song bar bsam du gzhug de nas hūm̐ mgrin pa nas tshangs pa'i bu ga nas hūm̐ 'phur ba bzhin du song nas/ lha'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ la ltem gyis thim par bsam du gzhug /de nas mi zhe sdang chung bas tshangs pa'i bu gar sor mos tug tug byas la/ shes pa lha'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ la gtod cig ces yang dang yang du bya'o// de bsam par mi nus par 'dug zer na/ 'o na spyi bo'i lha de yod par soms bya/ de yang mi nus zer na/ khyod kyi bla ma yin pas spyi bor soms la shes pa ma yengs par de la gtod du bzhug par bya'o// yi ge ngo mi shes pa mi nag yin na shing byang la hūm̐ bris la bstan/ 'di 'dra ba zhig snying gi nang du bsgom par bya'o// de ni tshangs pa'i bu ga na yar drod dam rlangs thon nas/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'am/ mkha' spyod kyi gnas su mi skye ba med gsung*/

'on du rgyas pa phul ba'i yon bdag de la yang dge bshes zhung dang 'dan ma gnyis la bstan nas byed du bcug pas/ rlangs pa spyi bor thon/ 'dod pa bzhin du byung ba yin/ ril ba yon bdag stong dpon la slob dpon nyid kyi mdzad pas kyang 'dod pa bzhin du byung gsung*/ spyir bcu tsam la byas gsung*/ 'pho ba'i gdams ngag rdzogs so// //

812) ༄// dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa bla ma dam pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang po tha ma 'bring dang ni// rab kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa ste// tha ma la yang 'pho lugs gsum// tha ma'i tha mas skyabs 'gro bya// de dang 'grogs pas ngan song khegs// 'bring gi rang gis gang thos pa'i// nges shes gang che'i chos nyid bsam// de dang 'grogs pa bde bar skye// tha ma'i rab kyis lha sku bsgom// de dang 'grogs pas rig 'dzin thob// dbang po 'bring gi 'pho ba yang*// rnam pa gsum du shes bya ste// 'bring gi tha mas nyal thabs bya// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yis// bde ba can du nges bar 'gro// 'bring gi 'bring gi 'pho lugs ni// bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang du bsgom// srog ni 'gag par gyur pa na// shes pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro// 'bring gi rab kyi 'pho lugs ni// rang gzhan ma lus he ru kaḥ /zhal brgyad phyag ni bcu drug pa// 'bar ba chen po bsgom par bya// 'chi khar de ltar bsgom byas pas// dkyil 'khor gyi ni bdag por 'gyur// rab kyi 'pho ba rnam gsum ste// rab kyi tha ma'i bar do ni// dus su rang gi sems nyid ni// bde ba chen por bsgom byas pas// mchog gi dngos grub bar mtshams med// rab kyi 'bring gi gang zag gis// bla ma rtogs ldan bsten byas shing*// des gsung mos gus byas gyur na// bsgom dang 'chi ba'i 'od gsal gnyis// ro gcig chen por gyur nas ni// chos sku bor ba med pa 'thob// rab kyi rab kyi gang zag gis// lus ni sgyu ma 'ja' tshon bzhin// sems ni nam mkha' chos kyi sku// ro mnyam chen por skad cig 'gyur// rin po che yi gdams ngag 'di// snod ngan rang nyid mi sgrub cing*// bshad par rloms la byin gyur na// dam tshig nyams nas dmyal bar 'gro// //// 813) ༄// 'pho ba bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi gdams pa//

na mo ratna gu ru/ 'pho bas lam gcod pa la chos bcu gnyis/ 'pho ba'i gang zag bzhi ste/ tha mal pa dang*/ grub mthas blo bsgyur ba dang*/ bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa'o// de dag la'ang yan lag bzhi dgos te/ lha dang bla ma la gus pas bar chad du mi 'gyur ba'i yan lag dang*/ dngos po ci la'ang ma chags pas/ 'khor bar mi skye ba'i yan lag dang*/ smon lam rnam par dag pas nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas su mi skye ba'i yan lag dang*/ gang la yang the tshom mi za bas/ shes pa gar 'dod du skye ba'i yan lag go// de la yang stobs bzhi tshang dgos te/ 'phen pa'i stobs/ sbyor ba'i stobs/ rnal 'byor gyi stobs/ grogs kyi stobs so// bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi gdams ngag 'di/ gzhu'i srang dang 'dra bas na/ 'pho ba kun las mchog tu bsngags// // 814) ༄// dbang po yang rab 'od gsal du 'pho ba'i gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma mchog nyid kyi// zhabs kyi padmor gtsug gis btud byas te// bla med gsang sngags snying po mchog gi don// 'pho ba'i gdams ngag bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri/ 'dir theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis la yun ring du bsgom par bya ba ni 'pho ba sbyong ba ste/ de yang dang por bskyed rdzogs gang yang rung ste mnyam par gzhag pa la yun ring du bslab/ de nas 'gro ba dang*/ 'chag pa dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ 'dug pa dang*/ tshogs mang po dang*/ chang 'thung ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa spyod pa dang*/ gnyid khur tshun chad du yang rgyun chad med par nyams su blangs/ de la goms shing 'byongs pa'i dus su/ da ni las la sbyar bar bya ste/ 'chi kha ma'i dus su/ 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes kyi mdo dang*/ 'du shes bcu bstan pa'i mdo ltar lus longs spyod rdzas yo byad/ dngos po thams cad bla ma dang dkon mchog la dbul/ blos lcogs tshad phan pa dang bde ba 'grub tshad rlabs po che'i dge ba'i rtsa bar bsngo bar bya'o// de'i kha chems bzhag

/de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ de yang shes pa dang 'dres par bsgom/ de nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i bla ma/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa'am/ dbang bskur ba'i bla ma ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur gyi dus kyi bla ma he ru ka gang yang rung ba de/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga'i steng du seng ge'i khri chen po zhig bsam/ de'i steng du sna tshogs padma/ de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bla ma gang yang rung ba bsam la/ bla ma sangs rgyas de la sems ma yengs pa rtse gcig tu gtad/ de ma gsal gyi bar du nan tan chen por bsgom/ gsal ba 'di'i dus su 'ong ba ni/ bla ma'i byin rlabs rang gi mos gus kyi rten 'brel 'dzom pas gsal bar mi 'ong ba min/ de nyid kyi ngang la bzhag pas/ sngon goms pa'i phyag chen pos mdun nas bsu ba ltar rang dbang med par byung nas/ chu la chu gzhag pa dang*/ mar la mar gzhag pa ltar phyag rgya chen po nyid kyi ngang la 'gro ba ni bla ma dam pa'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ rang gi shes pa phyag rgya chen po dbyer med par 'dres par gyur pa yin/ de nyid bsgom pa ma gtogs pa rang gi lus la sems mar ma zhugs pa gal che/ 'pho ba'i gdams ngag 'di mthar thug pa shin tu zab pa yin/ 'di kho na nyams su blang*/ blo gtad thub pa yin/ mi bslu nges pa yin/ snga ma'i nyams len dang rjes su 'brel pas/ su la phan yon che ba yin pas 'di kho na nyams su blang bar bya'o// rtsa a wa dhu tī dang*/ yig 'bru'i rigs tha dad pa dang*/ sgo dgu dgag pa la sogs pa tha dad pa mang po yod kyang*/ thams cad rang gi sems 'ba' zhig las gzhan med/ dbang po rab tu gyur pa'i rten gyi gang zag goms pa dang klong du gyur pa/ ma goms kyang bya sla ba/ 'pho ba 'di kho na gnad che ba yin pas gzhan la yang bstan rang nyid kyi kyang nyams su blang bar bya'o// rtsa rlung yig 'bru la sogs pa byas nas bla ma'i thugs khar 'phos kyang bya ba'i tshul lugs 'di las gzhan med/

gzhan rjes su bzung ba la gzhan gyis spyan 'dren pa la sogs pa byung na rten bkram pa dang*/ mchod pa bshams pa dang*/ bdag nyid gos dang gzi brjid dang ldan par bya ba dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ gong du dbang ma bskur na 'pho ba nags shod ma ltar rten 'brel gyi khrus bya ba/ sngon 'gro rnams rdzogs par byas la yig 'bru la sogs pa de nyid du bstan pa ltar bya ste/ mdor na/ bla ma sangs rgyas spyi bor bsgom pa ni/ rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba'i gdams ngag yin la/ phyag rgya chen por 'gro ba'i dus su de nyid kyi ngang la gzhag pa ni/ gang zag dbang po rab 'od gsal du 'pho ba'i gdams ngag yin pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dgongs pa 'di las lhag pa med pa yin pas nyams su blang bar bya'o// rdo rje'i 'chang gi dgongs pa mchog /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag 'di// 'gro ba kun la phan don du// rin chen gsung bzhin yi ger bris// 'di bris bsod nams dam pa yi// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral nas kyang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog// /āoṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswa hā// //
